+/**
+ * 00-config-utils.js
+ *
+ * Core application constants and low-level utility helpers used by the browser-only ATLAS Align app.
+ * This file should stay dependency-free because many later scripts rely on these helpers during startup.
+ * Auto-generated documentation comments explain function purpose, expected inputs, and module sections without changing runtime behavior.
+ */
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Application constants
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+const ATLAS_APP_NAME = "ATLAS Align";
+const ATLAS_APP_VERSION = "v2.3.8";
+
+/** Populates application-version display targets from the authoritative constant. */
+function atlasRenderAppVersion() {
+  document.querySelectorAll("[data-atlas-app-version]").forEach((target) => {
+    target.textContent = ATLAS_APP_VERSION;
+  });
+}
+
+atlasRenderAppVersion();
+
+// Used for IndexedDB Autosave/restore
+const ATLAS_DB_NAME = "atlasAlignAuditLogicBuilder";
+const ATLAS_DB_VERSION = 1;
+const ATLAS_FLOW_STORE = "flows";
+const ATLAS_AUTOSAVE_ID = "autosave";
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// DOM and formatting utilities
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Returns a DOM element by id.
+ * @param {any} id - Element id or record id to look up.
+ */
+const $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
+
+/**
+ * Escapes text for safe insertion into HTML strings.
+ * @param {any} s - Input used by esc.
+ */
+const esc = (s) =>
+  String(s ?? "").replace(
+    /[&<>"']/g,
+    (c) =>
+      ({ "&": "&amp;", "<": "&lt;", ">": "&gt;", '"': "&quot;", "'": "&#39;" })[
+        c
+      ],
+  );
+
+/**
+ * Generates a short unique id with the requested prefix.
+ * @param {any} prefix - Action label prefix such as THEN or ELSE.
+ */
+const uid = (prefix) =>
+  `${prefix}_${crypto.randomUUID?.().slice(0, 8) || Date.now()}`;
+
+/**
+ * Returns today as an ISO date string.
+ */
+const today = () => new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
+
+/**
+ * Escapes a value for a CSV cell.
+ * @param {any} s - Input used by csvEscape.
+ */
+const csvEscape = (s) => `"${String(s ?? "").replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
+
+/**
+ * Creates and downloads a browser Blob as a file.
+ * @param {any} name - Name, filename, or key used by the operation.
+ * @param {any} content - File contents or text payload to download.
+ * @param {any} type - MIME type, step type, or classification value.
+ */
+function downloadBlob(name, content, type) {
+  const a = document.createElement("a");
+  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(new Blob([content], { type }));
+  a.download = name;
+  a.click();
+  URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Downloads an object as formatted JSON.
+ * @param {any} name - Name, filename, or key used by the operation.
+ * @param {any} obj - Object to serialize.
+ */
+function downloadJson(name, obj) {
+  downloadBlob(name, JSON.stringify(obj, null, 2), "application/json");
+}
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Legacy logic text helpers
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Maps an internal legacy step type to a user-facing label.
+ * @param {any} type - MIME type, step type, or classification value.
+ */
+function stepTypeLabel(type) {
+  return (
+    {
+      source: "Source",
+      create: "Create Field",
+      if: "If / Then",
+      compare: "Compare",
+      join: "Join",
+      transform: "Manipulation",
+    }[type] || type
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * Formats a legacy condition object as a plain sentence fragment.
+ * @param {any} condition - Condition object to format or render.
+ */
+function conditionText(condition) {
+  return `${condition.field || "[field]"} ${condition.operator || "equals"} ${condition.value || "[value]"}`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns the first A-Z letter for alpha rails and grouped lists, or # for non-letters.
+ * @param {any} value - Value to read.
+ */
+function firstLetter(value) {
+  const c = String(value || "")
+    .trim()
+    .charAt(0)
+    .toUpperCase();
+  return /[A-Z]/.test(c) ? c : "#";
+}
+
+/**
+ * Sorts items by a display name without mutating the original array.
+ * @param {Array<any>} items - Items to sort.
+ * @param {Function} getName - Name selector.
+ */
+function alphaSortItems(items, getName) {
+  return [...items].sort((a, b) =>
+    String(getName(a) || "").localeCompare(
+      String(getName(b) || ""),
+      undefined,
+      { sensitivity: "base", numeric: true },
+    ),
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns unique first-letter groups for a sorted list.
+ * @param {Array<any>} items - Items to group.
+ * @param {Function} getName - Name selector.
+ */
+function alphaLetters(items, getName) {
+  return [
+    ...new Set(
+      alphaSortItems(items, getName).map((item) => firstLetter(getName(item))),
+    ),
+  ];
+}
+
+
+================================================================================
+END FILE: js/00-config-utils.js

+================================================================================
+BEGIN FILE: js/00-html-partials-loader.js
+================================================================================
+
+/*
+ * Loads the page HTML partials before the existing application scripts execute.
+ * Synchronous loading is intentional in this first-pass source-organization refactor:
+ * 01-state-dom.js caches DOM references at script evaluation time, and
+ * 06-events-bootstrap.js invokes init() immediately when it is evaluated.
+ */
+(function loadHtmlPartialsBeforeApplicationBootstrap() {
+  const sectionRoot = document.getElementById("page-sections-root");
+  const sectionFiles = [
+    "./sections/my-audits.html",
+    "./sections/group-landing.html",
+    "./sections/inbox.html",
+    "./sections/audit-history.html",
+    "./sections/recently-deleted-publications.html",
+    "./sections/audit-overview.html",
+    "./sections/sources.html",
+    "./sections/logic-builder.html",
+    "./sections/display-fields.html",
+    "./sections/visual-picker.html",
+    "./sections/requirements-preview.html",
+    "./sections/readiness-review.html",
+    "./sections/audit-issues.html",
+    "./sections/publication-preview.html",
+  ];
+
+  if (!sectionRoot)
+    throw new Error("HTML partial root #page-sections-root was not found.");
+
+  const html = sectionFiles.map((file) => {
+    const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
+    request.open("GET", file, false);
+    request.send(null);
+    if (request.status < 200 || request.status >= 300) {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Could not load HTML partial ${file}. HTTP ${request.status}.`,
+      );
+    }
+    const contentType = String(request.getResponseHeader("content-type") || "");
+    if (contentType && !contentType.includes("text/html")) {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Could not load HTML partial ${file}. Unexpected content type ${contentType}.`,
+      );
+    }
+    const responseText = String(request.responseText || "");
+    if (!responseText.trim().startsWith("<")) {
+      throw new Error(
+        `Could not load HTML partial ${file}. Invalid HTML response.`,
+      );
+    }
+    return responseText;
+  });
+
+  sectionRoot.insertAdjacentHTML("beforebegin", html.join(""));
+  sectionRoot.remove();
+})();
+
+
+================================================================================
+END FILE: js/00-html-partials-loader.js
+================================================================================

+    fields: [],
+
+    // User-controlled final output field selections. Logic usage remains derived.
+    displayFields: [],
+
+    // Audit workflow steps, validations, or review activities.
+    steps: [],
+  };

+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// UI feedback and theme state
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Displays a status message in the app status area.
+ * @param {any} message - Status or validation message.
+ * @param {any} kind - Picker or record kind.
+ */
+function status(message, kind = "") {
+  if (!e.status) return;
+  e.status.innerHTML = `<div class="status ${esc(kind)}">${esc(message)}</div>`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns the active light/dark theme.
+ */
+function themeMode() {
+  return document.body.classList.contains("dark") ? "dark" : "light";
+}
+
+/**
+ * Applies the requested light/dark theme and persists the preference.
+ * @param {any} mode - Requested mode value.
+ */
+function setTheme(mode) {
+  const normalizedMode = mode === "dark" ? "dark" : "light";
+  document.body.classList.toggle("dark", normalizedMode === "dark");
+  if (e.theme) e.theme.textContent = normalizedMode === "dark" ? "☀" : "⏾";
+  localStorage.setItem("atlasAlignTheme", normalizedMode);
+  if (typeof scheduleAutosave === "function")
+    scheduleAutosave({ database: false });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns whether an audit has been selected or created.
+ */
+function hasSelectedAudit() {
+  return !!state.auditSelected;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Marks the app as having an active audit and unlocks audit pages.
+ */
+function markAuditSelected() {
+  state.auditSelected = true;
+  document.body.classList.add("audit-selected");
+  document.body.classList.remove("audit-not-selected");
+  updateNavigationLockState?.();
+}
+
+/**
+ * Marks the app as not having an active audit and locks audit pages.
+ */
+function clearAuditSelection() {
+  state.auditSelected = false;
+  document.body.classList.remove("audit-selected");
+  document.body.classList.add("audit-not-selected");
+  updateNavigationLockState?.();
+}
+
+/**
+ * Captures the current audit state as a JSON string for change detection.
+ */
+function auditSnapshot() {
+  capture?.();
+  return JSON.stringify(state.audit || {});
+}
+
+/**
+ * Stores the current audit snapshot as the clean baseline.
+ */
+function updateActiveAuditBaseline() {
+  state.activeAuditBaseline = auditSnapshot();
+}
+
+/**
+ * Compares the current audit snapshot to the saved baseline.
+ */
+function auditHasUnsavedChanges() {
+  if (!hasSelectedAudit()) return false;
+  return auditSnapshot() !== state.activeAuditBaseline;
+}
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Field display mode helpers
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Returns whether raw source names or vanity labels should be displayed.
+ */
+function fieldDisplayMode() {
+  return state.fieldDisplayMode === "vanity" ? "vanity" : "source";
+}
+
+/**
+ * Finds the catalog field record that matches a raw or display field name.
+ * @param {any} value - Value to process or assign.
+ * @param {any} sourceFile - Raw source file name.
+ */
+function findFieldDisplayCandidate(value, sourceFile = "") {
+  const text = String(value || "");
+  if (!text) return null;
+  const pools = [];
+  if (typeof fieldsForSource === "function")
+    pools.push(...fieldsForSource(sourceFile || ""));
+  pools.push(...(state.audit.fields || []));
+  return (
+    pools.find((field) =>
+      [
+        field.fieldName,
+        field.rawFieldName,
+        field.name,
+        field.label,
+        field.vanityLabel,
+      ].some((item) => item && String(item) === text),
+    ) || null
+  );
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns the field name to show based on the active display mode.
+ * @param {any} fieldOrName - Input used by fieldDisplayName.
+ * @param {any} sourceFile - Raw source file name.
+ */
+function fieldDisplayParts(fieldOrName, sourceFile = "") {
+  const fallback = String(typeof fieldOrName === "string" ? fieldOrName : "");
+  if (!fieldOrName) return { raw: "", vanity: "", display: "", alternate: "" };
+  const field =
+    typeof fieldOrName === "string"
+      ? findFieldDisplayCandidate(fieldOrName, sourceFile)
+      : fieldOrName;
+  if (!field)
+    return {
+      raw: fallback,
+      vanity: fallback,
+      display: fallback,
+      alternate: "",
+    };
+  const raw = String(
+    field.fieldName ||
+      field.rawFieldName ||
+      fallback ||
+      field.name ||
+      field.label ||
+      "",
+  );
+  const vanity = String(
+    field.vanityLabel ||
+      (field.name && field.name !== raw ? field.name : "") ||
+      field.label ||
+      raw,
+  );
+  const display =
+    fieldDisplayMode() === "vanity" ? vanity || raw : raw || vanity;
+  const alternate =
+    fieldDisplayMode() === "vanity"
+      ? raw !== display
+        ? raw
+        : ""
+      : vanity !== display
+        ? vanity
+        : "";
+  return { raw, vanity, display, alternate };
+}
+
+function fieldDisplayName(fieldOrName, sourceFile = "") {
+  return fieldDisplayParts(fieldOrName, sourceFile).display;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Updates and persists the field display mode, then re-renders the UI.
+ * @param {any} mode - Requested mode value.
+ */
+function setFieldDisplayMode(mode) {
+  state.fieldDisplayMode = mode === "vanity" ? "vanity" : "source";
+  localStorage.setItem("atlasAlignFieldDisplayMode", state.fieldDisplayMode);
+  atlasInvalidatePages?.(["fields", "steps", "preview", "review"]);
+  atlasRenderActivePage?.({ force: true });
+  renderFieldDisplayModeButton?.();
+}
+
+/**
+ * Switches between raw/source and vanity-label display modes.
+ */
+function toggleFieldDisplayMode() {
+  setFieldDisplayMode(fieldDisplayMode() === "vanity" ? "source" : "vanity");
+}
+
+/**
+ * Maps legacy section names to current page ids.
+ * @param {any} section - Section/page identifier.
+ */
+function pageForSection(section) {
+  if (section === "audit") return "overview";
+  if (section === "logic") return "steps";
+  if (section === "publication") return "save";
+  if (section === "sources") return "fields";
+  return section || "my-audits";
+}
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Page navigation helpers
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Activates a page, updates navigation state, and refreshes page-level controls.
+ * @param {any} section - Section/page identifier.
+ */
+function showSection(section) {
+  // Resolve the requested section into the canonical page name used by the app.
+  let page = pageForSection(section);
+
+  // If no audit is selected, keep users on an allowed landing/setup page.
+  // This prevents navigation into audit-specific pages before an audit context exists.
+  if (!hasSelectedAudit() && page !== "my-audits" && page !== "group")
+    page = "my-audits";
+
+  // Update the active state for navigation buttons in both the top nav and rail.
+  // Each button may identify its target through section, page, or panel metadata.
+  document.querySelectorAll(".navitem, .rail-item").forEach((button) => {
+    const buttonPage = pageForSection(
+      button.dataset.section ||
+        button.dataset.page ||
+        button.dataset.panel ||
+        "",
+    );
+    button.classList.toggle("active", buttonPage === page);
+  });
+
+  // Show the matching main page panel and hide all other page panels.
+  // Supports matching by data-page, page-prefixed id, or direct id for compatibility.
+  document.querySelectorAll(".page").forEach((panel) => {
+    panel.classList.toggle(
+      "active",
+      panel.dataset.page === page ||
+        panel.id === `page-${page}` ||
+        panel.id === page,
+    );
+  });
+
+  // Show the matching setup panel when the selected page maps to setup content.
+  document.querySelectorAll(".setup-panel").forEach((panel) => {
+    panel.classList.toggle("active", panel.dataset.panel === page);
+  });
+
+  // Persist the active section so the app can restore the user's last location later.
+  localStorage.setItem("atlasAlignActiveSection", page);
+
+  // Refresh page-dependent UI elements after navigation changes.
+  // Function checks keep this safe when optional modules are not loaded.
+  if (typeof updateDashboardMetrics === "function") updateDashboardMetrics();
+  if (
+    page === "preview" &&
+    typeof atlasPreviewDirty !== "undefined" &&
+    atlasPreviewDirty
+  ) {
+    atlasRequestRender?.({ preview: true });
+  }
+  if (typeof positionTutorial === "function") positionTutorial();
+  updateNavigationLockState?.();
+  renderFlowNavControls?.();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  renderFieldDisplayModeButton?.();
+  atlasRenderPage?.(page);
+  globalThis.ATLASAuditIssues?.render?.();
+
+  // Return the viewport to the top of the newly displayed section.
+  window.scrollTo({ top: 0, behavior: "auto" });
+}
+

+/**
+ * 04-persistence.js
+ *
+ * IndexedDB persistence layer for saved audits, autosave, import/export bundles, and active audit switching support.
+ * Auto-generated documentation comments explain function purpose, expected inputs, and module sections without changing runtime behavior.
+ */
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Persistence state
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+let autosaveTimer = null;
+let atlasAutosaveDirty = false;
+let atlasAutosaveRevision = 0;
+let atlasAutosaveSavedRevision = 0;
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// IndexedDB helpers
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Opens the IndexedDB database used for saved flows.
+ */
+function openDb() {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    const request = indexedDB.open(ATLAS_DB_NAME, ATLAS_DB_VERSION);
+    request.onupgradeneeded = () => {
+      const db = request.result;
+      if (!db.objectStoreNames.contains(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE))
+        db.createObjectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, { keyPath: "id" });
+    };
+    request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+    request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads all saved flow records from IndexedDB.
+ */
+async function dbAll() {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readonly");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).getAll();
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result || []);
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Writes a saved flow or autosave record to IndexedDB.
+ * @param {any} record - IndexedDB record to write.
+ */
+async function dbPut(record) {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readwrite");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).put(record);
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Reads a saved flow by id from IndexedDB.
+ * @param {any} id - Element id or record id to look up.
+ */
+async function dbGet(id) {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readonly");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).get(id);
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();
+  }
+}
+
+/**
+ * Deletes a saved flow from IndexedDB.
+ * @param {any} id - Element id or record id to look up.
+ */
+async function dbDelete(id) {
+  const db = await openDb();
+  try {
+    return await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+      const tx = db.transaction(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE, "readwrite");
+      const request = tx.objectStore(ATLAS_FLOW_STORE).delete(id);
+      request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
+      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
+    });
+  } finally {
+    db.close();
+  }
+}
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Saved audit operations
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Loads saved flows into state and updates the saved-flow selector.
+ */
+async function refreshSaved() {
+  const all = (await dbAll()).filter(
+    (record) => record.id !== ATLAS_AUTOSAVE_ID,
+  );
+  state.savedFlows = all.sort((a, b) =>
+    String(b.updatedAt).localeCompare(String(a.updatedAt)),
+  );
+  e.flowSelect.innerHTML = state.savedFlows.length
+    ? state.savedFlows
+        .map(
+          (flow) =>
+            `<option value="${flow.id}">${esc(flow.name)} — ${new Date(flow.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}</option>`,
+        )
+        .join("")
+    : '<option value="">No saved audits yet</option>';
+  e.saveStatus.textContent = `${state.savedFlows.length} saved audit${state.savedFlows.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} in this browser.`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Prompts for a name and saves the current audit locally.
+ */
+async function saveFlow() {
+  capture();
+  const id = e.flowSelect.value || uid("flow");
+  const name = prompt(
+    "Name this saved audit:",
+    state.audit.name || "Audit Logic Flow",
+  );
+  if (!name) return;
+  const existing = await dbGet(id);
+  const record = {
+    id,
+    name,
+    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    createdAt: existing?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
+    audit: structuredClone({ ...state.audit, name }),
+  };
+  await dbPut(record);
+  await refreshSaved();
+  e.flowSelect.value = id;
+  state.activeAuditValue = `local:${id}`;
+  updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  status(`Saved audit: ${name}`, "ok");
+}
+
+/**
+ * Saves the active audit before switching when requested.
+ */
+async function saveCurrentAuditForSwitch() {
+  capture?.();
+  const isLocal = String(state.activeAuditValue || "").startsWith("local:");
+  const id = isLocal
+    ? state.activeAuditValue.split(":").slice(1).join(":")
+    : uid("flow");
+  const existing = isLocal ? await dbGet(id) : null;
+  let name = state.audit.name || existing?.name || "Audit Logic Flow";
+  if (!isLocal || !name) {
+    const promptedName = prompt(
+      "Save current audit as:",
+      name || "Audit Logic Flow",
+    );
+    if (!promptedName) return false;
+    name = promptedName;
+  }
+  const record = {
+    id,
+    name,
+    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    createdAt: existing?.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
+    audit: structuredClone({ ...state.audit, name }),
+  };
+  await dbPut(record);
+  await refreshSaved();
+  state.activeAuditValue = `local:${id}`;
+  if (e.flowSelect) e.flowSelect.value = id;
+  updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  status(`Saved audit: ${name}`, "ok");
+  return true;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Loads a locally saved audit.
+ */
+async function loadFlow() {
+  const id = e.flowSelect.value;
+  if (!id) return status("Select a saved audit first.", "warn");
+  const record = await dbGet(id);
+  if (!record) return;
+  state.audit = structuredClone(record.audit);
+  state.selectedStepId = state.audit.steps[0]?.id || null;
+  state.activeAuditValue = `local:${id}`;
+  markAuditSelected();
+  atlasMarkAllPagesDirty?.();
+  showSection("overview");
+  atlasRenderActivePage?.({ force: true });
+  status(`Loaded saved audit: ${record.name}.`, "ok");
+  scheduleAutosave();
+  updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+}
+
+/**
+ * Deletes the selected saved audit.
+ */
+async function deleteFlow() {
+  const id = e.flowSelect.value;
+  if (!id) return status("Select a saved audit first.", "warn");
+  if (!confirm("Delete selected saved audit from this browser?")) return;
+  await dbDelete(id);
+  await refreshSaved();
+  status("Saved audit deleted.", "ok");
+}
+
+/**
+ * Exports the saved audit bundle.
+ */
+async function exportAll() {
+  const bundle = {
+    app: ATLAS_APP_NAME,
+    bundleType: "atlas-align-audit-logic-flows",
+    exportedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    flows: state.savedFlows,
+  };
+  downloadJson(`atlas_align_saved_audits_${today()}.json`, bundle);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Imports one or more saved audits from a JSON file.
+ * @param {any} file - Browser File object to import.
+ */
+async function importAll(file) {
+  const json = JSON.parse(await file.text());
+  const flows = Array.isArray(json.flows)
+    ? json.flows
+    : Array.isArray(json)
+      ? json
+      : [
+          {
+            id: uid("flow"),
+            name: json.name || json.preset_name || "Imported Audit",
+            updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+            audit: json,
+          },
+        ];
+  for (const flow of flows) {
+    await dbPut({
+      id: flow.id || uid("flow"),
+      name: flow.name || flow.audit?.name || "Imported Audit",
+      createdAt: flow.createdAt || new Date().toISOString(),
+      updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+      audit: flow.audit || flow,
+    });
+  }
+  await refreshSaved();
+  status("Imported saved audit flow(s).", "ok");
+}
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Autosave
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Debounces autosave after state changes.
+ */
+function scheduleAutosave(options = {}) {
+  if (state.autosavePaused) return;
+  atlasAutosaveDirty = true;
+  atlasAutosaveRevision += 1;
+  clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
+  autosaveTimer = setTimeout(saveAutosave, 500);
+  if (options.database !== false)
+    atlasMarkDatabaseDirty?.(options.reason || "edit");
+}
+
+/**
+ * Writes the current audit to the autosave record.
+ */
+async function saveAutosave() {
+  if (
+    !atlasAutosaveDirty &&
+    atlasAutosaveSavedRevision === atlasAutosaveRevision
+  )
+    return;
+  const revision = atlasAutosaveRevision;
+  capture();
+  const auditSnapshot = structuredClone(state.audit);
+  await dbPut({
+    id: ATLAS_AUTOSAVE_ID,
+    name: "Autosaved Draft",
+    updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    theme: themeMode(),
+    audit: auditSnapshot,
+  });
+  atlasAutosaveSavedRevision = revision;
+  atlasAutosaveDirty = atlasAutosaveRevision !== revision;
+  e.autosaveStatus.textContent = `Autosaved draft at ${new Date().toLocaleString()}.`;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Restores the autosaved draft if one exists.
+ */
+async function restoreAutosave() {
+  const record = await dbGet(ATLAS_AUTOSAVE_ID);
+  if (record?.audit) {
+    state.autosavePaused = true;
+    state.audit = structuredClone(record.audit);
+    setTheme(
+      record.theme || localStorage.getItem("atlasAlignTheme") || "light",
+    );
+    state.autosavePaused = false;
+    state.selectedStepId = state.audit.steps[0]?.id || null;
+    state.audit.id = state.audit.id || uid("audit");
+    state.activeAuditValue = `draft:${state.audit.id}`;
+    markAuditSelected();
+    updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+    renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+    e.autosaveStatus.textContent = `Restored autosaved draft from ${new Date(record.updatedAt).toLocaleString()}.`;
+    return true;
+  }
+  return false;
+}
+
+/**
+ * Deletes the autosave record.
+ */
+async function clearAutosave() {
+  await dbDelete(ATLAS_AUTOSAVE_ID);
+  e.autosaveStatus.textContent = "Autosaved draft cleared.";
+}
+
+/**
+ * Deletes the IndexedDB database used for saved audits and autosave records.
+ */
+function deleteAtlasDatabase() {
+  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+    if (!window.indexedDB) {
+      resolve();
+      return;
+    }
+    const request = indexedDB.deleteDatabase(ATLAS_DB_NAME);
+    request.onsuccess = () => resolve();
+    request.onerror = () =>
+      reject(
+        request.error ||
+          new Error("Could not delete the local audit database."),
+      );
+    request.onblocked = () =>
+      reject(
+        new Error(
+          "Close other ATLAS Align tabs and try clearing local data again.",
+        ),
+      );
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Removes browser storage used by this app. Repo JSON files are not changed.
+ */
+function clearAtlasBrowserStorage() {
+  const appPrefixes = ["atlasAlign"];
+  [localStorage, sessionStorage].forEach((store) => {
+    if (!store) return;
+    Object.keys(store).forEach((key) => {
+      if (appPrefixes.some((prefix) => key.startsWith(prefix)))
+        store.removeItem(key);
+    });
+  });
+}
+
+/**
+ * Confirms and clears all locally saved app data, then reloads from a clean state.
+ */
+async function resetLocalAppData() {
+  const warning = [
+    "Clear all saved ATLAS Align data from this browser?",
+    "",
+    "This will permanently delete locally saved audits, the autosaved draft, app preferences, and navigation state stored in this browser.",
+    "Repo/source JSON files and downloaded exports will not be changed.",
+    "",
+    "This action cannot be undone. Continue?",
+  ].join("\n");
+  if (!confirm(warning)) return;
+  state.autosavePaused = true;
+  clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
+  await deleteAtlasDatabase();
+  clearAtlasBrowserStorage();
+  window.location.reload();
+}
+
+// PostgreSQL is the only durable audit store. IndexedDB remains crash recovery only.
+refreshSaved = async function refreshDatabaseAudits() {
+  await atlasRefreshDatabaseAudits?.();
+  state.savedFlows = [];
+  if (e.flowSelect)
+    e.flowSelect.innerHTML = (state.databaseAudits || []).length
+      ? state.databaseAudits
+          .map(
+            (audit) =>
+              `<option value="${esc(audit.id)}">${esc(audit.name)} — revision ${audit.currentRevisionNumber || 0}</option>`,
+          )
+          .join("")
+      : '<option value="">No database audits yet</option>';
+  if (e.saveStatus)
+    e.saveStatus.textContent = `${(state.databaseAudits || []).length} audit${(state.databaseAudits || []).length === 1 ? "" : "s"} in the shared database.`;
+};
+saveFlow = async function saveDatabaseAudit() {
+  return atlasSaveCurrentAudit?.();
+};
+saveCurrentAuditForSwitch = async function saveDatabaseAuditForSwitch() {
+  return atlasSaveCurrentAudit?.("Saved before switching audits");
+};
+loadFlow = async function loadDatabaseAuditFromSelect() {
+  const id = e.flowSelect?.value;
+  if (!id) return status("Select a database audit first.", "warn");
+  return atlasLoadDatabaseAudit(id);
+};
+deleteFlow = async function archiveDatabaseAudit() {
+  return atlasArchiveCurrentAudit?.();
+};
+exportAll = async function exportDatabaseAuditIndex() {
+  const payload = await atlasAuditApi("/api/audits");
+  downloadJson(`atlas_align_database_audit_index_${today()}.json`, payload);
+};
+importAll = async function importJsonAuditsToDatabase(file) {
+  return atlasImportAuditJsonFile(file);
+};
+const atlasLocalAutosaveBase = saveAutosave;
+saveAutosave = async function saveRecoveryDraftOnly() {
+  await atlasLocalAutosaveBase();
+  const record = await dbGet(ATLAS_AUTOSAVE_ID);
+  if (record) {
+    record.databaseAuditId = state.auditPersistence?.auditId || null;
+    record.baseRevisionId = state.auditPersistence?.revisionId || null;

+/**
+ * 06-events-bootstrap.js
+ *
+ * Application event bootstrap. This file wires top-level buttons, input/change listeners, navigation, import controls, and startup initialization.
+ * Auto-generated documentation comments explain function purpose, expected inputs, and module sections without changing runtime behavior.

+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Event listener utility
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Attaches an event listener to an element by id if the element exists.
+ * @param {any} id - Element id or record id to look up.
+ * @param {any} eventName - Input used by on.
+ * @param {any} handler - Callback function for an event.
+ */
+function on(id, eventName, handler) {
+  const el = $(id);
+  if (el) el.addEventListener(eventName, handler);
+}
+
+/**
+ * Returns true when a broad body input/change handler should skip a nested UI surface
+ * that has its own specialized event handling.
+ * @param {Event} event - DOM event from a delegated body listener.
+ */
+function shouldSkipBaseBodyEditEvent(event) {
+  const skipSelector = [
+    "[data-live-editor-step-id]",
+    "#completeStatementsToggle",
+    "#includeNotesToggle",
+    "#previewStyle",
+    "[data-preview-tab]",
+    ".visual-picker-modal-backdrop",
+    ".join-picker-backdrop",
+    ".source-replace-backdrop",
+    ".field-replace-backdrop",
+    ".condition-repair-backdrop",
+    ".logic-issue-panel",
+    ".logic-issues-backdrop",
+    ".new-rule-menu-panel",
+    ".tutorial-card",
+    ".tutorial-overlay",
+    ".modal",
+    "[data-my-audits-role]",
+    "#myAuditsSearch",
+  ].join(", ");
+  return !!event.target.closest?.(skipSelector);
+}
+
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Top-level event bindings
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/**
+ * Registers all top-level UI event handlers.
+ */
+function bindEvents() {
+  if (window.__atlasCoreEventsBound) return;
+  window.__atlasCoreEventsBound = true;
+  if (e.completeStatements)
+    e.completeStatements.checked = state.previewStatementMode === "complete";
+  document.querySelectorAll(".rail-item").forEach((button) => {
+    button.onclick = (event) => {
+      if (button.classList.contains("is-locked")) {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        return;
+      }
+      atlasNavigateToSection(button.dataset.section).catch((err) =>
+        status(`Navigation save failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+      );
+    };
+  });
+
+  document.querySelectorAll("[data-my-audits-role]").forEach((button) => {
+    button.addEventListener("click", () => {
+      const role = button.dataset.myAuditsRole;
+      if (
+        ![
+          "assigned",
+          "backup",
+          "developer",
+          "other",
+          "all",
+          "deleted",
+        ].includes(role)
+      )
+        return;
+      state.myAuditsRoleFilter = role;
+      if (role === "deleted") atlasRefreshDeletedAudits().catch(() => {});
+      renderMyAudits?.();
+    });
+  });
+  on("myAuditsSearch", "input", (event) => {
+    state.myAuditsSearch = event.target.value;
+    renderMyAudits?.();
+  });
+  on("myAuditsStatusFilter", "change", (event) => {
+    state.myAuditsStatusFilter = event.target.value;
+    renderMyAudits?.();
+  });
+  on("auditStatus", "change", (event) => {
+    const next = event.target.value;
+    const previous = state.audit.status || "Draft";
+    const message = $("auditStatusMessage");
+    if (["Ready for Review", "Complete"].includes(next)) {
+      globalThis.ATLASAuditIssues?.invalidate?.();
+      const result = globalThis.ATLASAuditIssues?.current?.();
+      if ((result?.counts?.critical || 0) > 0) {
+        event.target.value = previous;
+        if (message)
+          message.textContent =
+            "Resolve all Critical Errors before marking this audit Ready for Review or Complete.";
+        status("Status change blocked by Critical Errors.", "warn");
+        return;
+      }
+    }
+    state.audit.status = next;
+    if (message) message.textContent = "";
+    scheduleAutosave();
+    renderMyAudits?.();
+  });
+  on("createAuditBtn", "click", async () => {
+    const name = prompt("Name the new audit:", "New Audit Logic Flow");
+    if (!name) return;
+    if (!(await atlasSaveIfDirty("new audit"))) return;
+    state.audit = defaultAudit();
+    state.audit.name = name;
+    state.selectedStepId = null;
+    state.activeAuditValue = `draft:${state.audit.id}`;
+    markAuditSelected();
+    renderAll();
+    showSection("overview");
+    scheduleAutosave();
+    updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+    renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+    atlasCreateCurrentAudit("Created audit").catch((err) =>
+      status(`Database create failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    );
+  });
+  on("renameAuditBtn", "click", () => {
+    const name = prompt("Rename active audit:", state.audit.name);
+    if (!name) return;
+    state.audit.name = name;
+    renderAll();
+    scheduleAutosave();
+  });
+  on("auditVersionHistoryBtn", "click", () =>
+    atlasOpenAuditHistory?.().catch((err) => status(err.message, "bad")),
+  );
+  on("stepVersionHistoryBtn", "click", () =>
+    atlasOpenStepHistory?.().catch((err) => status(err.message, "bad")),
+  );
+  on("deleteAuditBtn", "click", () => {
+    atlasArchiveCurrentAudit().catch((error) =>
+      status(
+        `Delete Audit failed: ${error.message} Try again or refresh the audit before retrying.`,
+        "bad",
+      ),
+    );
+  });
+  on("duplicateAuditBtn", "click", async () => {
+    if (!(await atlasSaveIfDirty("duplicate audit"))) return;
+    capture();
+    const clone = structuredClone(state.audit);
+    clone.id = uid("audit");
+    clone.name = `${clone.name} Copy`;
+    clone.steps = clone.steps.map((step) => ({
+      ...step,
+      id: step.autoGeneratedReference
+        ? `reference_${uid("source")}`
+        : uid("step"),
+      parentId: null,
+    }));
+    state.audit = clone;
+    state.selectedStepId = state.audit.steps[0]?.id || null;
+    state.activeAuditValue = `draft:${state.audit.id}`;
+    markAuditSelected();
+    renderAll();
+    showSection("overview");
+    scheduleAutosave();
+    updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+    renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+    atlasCreateCurrentAudit("Duplicated audit").catch((err) =>
+      status(`Database create failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    );
+  });
+  on("newAuditBtn", "click", async () => {
+    if (
+      confirm(
+        "Start a new audit logic flow? Unsaved changes remain in autosave until cleared.",
+      )
+    ) {
+      if (!(await atlasSaveIfDirty("new audit"))) return;
+      state.audit = defaultAudit();
+      state.selectedStepId = null;
+      state.activeAuditValue = `draft:${state.audit.id}`;
+      markAuditSelected();
+      renderAll();
+      showSection("overview");
+      scheduleAutosave();
+      updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+      renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+      atlasCreateCurrentAudit("Created audit").catch((err) =>
+        status(`Database create failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+      );
+    }
+  });
+
+  on("exportCurrentBtn", "click", exportCurrent);
+  on("downloadDocBtn", "click", exportCurrent);
+  on("downloadCsvBtn", "click", exportCsv);
+  on("downloadExcelBtn", "click", () =>
+    exportAuditExcel().catch((err) =>
+      status(`Excel export failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    ),
+  );
+  on("downloadQtestExcelBtn", "click", () =>
+    exportQtestExcel().catch((err) =>
+      status(`Qtest Excel export failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    ),
+  );
+  on("downloadHtmlBtn", "click", exportAuditHtml);
+  on("copyHtmlBtn", "click", () => copyAuditHtml());
+  on("copyMarkdownBtn", "click", copyMarkdown);
+  on("completeStatementsToggle", "change", () => {
+    state.previewStatementMode = e.completeStatements?.checked
+      ? "complete"
+      : "nested";
+    localStorage.setItem(
+      "atlasAlignPreviewStatementMode",
+      state.previewStatementMode,
+    );
+    atlasRequestRender?.({ preview: true });
+  });
+  on("includeNotesToggle", "change", () =>
+    atlasRequestRender?.({ preview: true }),
+  );
+  on("previewStyle", "change", () => atlasRequestRender?.({ preview: true }));
+  on("addStepBtn", "click", (event) => atlasToggleNewRuleTypeMenu?.(event));
+  on("loadLibraryAuditBtn", "click", () =>
+    loadSelectedLibraryAudit().catch((err) =>
+      status(`Audit library load failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    ),
+  );
+  on("refreshLibraryBtn", "click", () =>
+    loadRepoLibrary().catch((err) =>
+      status(`Database audit refresh failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    ),
+  );
+  on("saveFlowBtn", "click", () =>
+    saveFlow().catch((err) => status(err.message, "bad")),
+  );
+  if (!document.__atlasSaveShortcutBound) {
+    document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
+      const isSaveShortcut =
+        String(event.key || "").toLowerCase() === "s" &&
+        (event.ctrlKey || event.metaKey) &&
+        !event.altKey;
+      if (!isSaveShortcut) return;
+      event.preventDefault();
+      if (!hasSelectedAudit?.())
+        return status("Select or create an audit before saving.", "warn");
+      atlasSaveIfDirty("keyboard shortcut").catch((err) =>
+        status(err.message, "bad"),
+      );
+    });
+    document.__atlasSaveShortcutBound = true;
+  }
+  on("loadFlowBtn", "click", () =>
+    loadFlow().catch((err) => status(err.message, "bad")),
+  );
+  on("deleteFlowBtn", "click", () =>
+    deleteFlow().catch((err) => status(err.message, "bad")),
+  );
+  on("exportAllBtn", "click", exportAll);
+  on("clearAutosaveBtn", "click", () => clearAutosave());
+  on("resetLocalDataBtn", "click", () =>
+    resetLocalAppData().catch((err) =>
+      status(`Clear saved data failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    ),
+  );
+  on("activeAuditSelect", "change", () => {
+    state.pendingActiveAuditValue = $("activeAuditSelect")?.value || "";
+    renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  });
+  on("confirmActiveAuditBtn", "click", () => {
+    const value =
+      state.pendingActiveAuditValue || $("activeAuditSelect")?.value || "";
+    if (!value || value === state.activeAuditValue) {
+      renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+      return;
+    }
+    switchActiveAudit(value)
+      .then(() => {
+        state.pendingActiveAuditValue = "";
+        renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+      })
+      .catch((err) => {
+        status(`Audit switch failed: ${err.message}`, "bad");
+        renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+      });
+  });
+  on("fieldDisplayModeBtn", "click", () => {
+    toggleFieldDisplayMode?.();
+    renderFieldDisplayModeButton?.();
+  });
+  on("themeBtn", "click", () =>
+    setTheme(themeMode() === "dark" ? "light" : "dark"),
+  );
+  on("helpBtn", "click", () => startTutorial("global"));
+  on("auditTutorialBtn", "click", () => startTutorial("audit"));
+  on("fieldsTutorialBtn", "click", () => startTutorial("fields"));
+  on("stepsTutorialBtn", "click", () => startTutorial("steps"));
+  on("saveTutorialBtn", "click", () => startTutorial("save"));
+
+  const importAllFile = $("importAllFile");
+  if (importAllFile) {
+    importAllFile.onchange = async (event) => {
+      const file = event.target.files[0];
+      try {
+        if (file) await atlasImportAuditJsonFile(file);
+      } catch (err) {
+        status(`Audit import failed: ${err.message}`, "bad");
+      } finally {
+        event.target.value = "";
+      }
+    };
+  }
+  const importCurrentFile = $("importCurrentFile");
+  if (importCurrentFile) {
+    importCurrentFile.onchange = async (event) => {
+      const file = event.target.files[0];
+      try {
+        if (!file) return;
+        const result = await atlasImportAuditJsonFile(file);
+        const first = result.imported?.[0];
+        if (first?.audit?.id) {
+          await atlasLoadDatabaseAudit(first.audit.id);
+          showSection("overview");
+        }
+      } catch (err) {
+        status(`Audit import failed: ${err.message}`, "bad");
+      } finally {
+        event.target.value = "";
+      }
+    };
+  }
+
+  document.body.addEventListener("input", (event) => {
+    if (shouldSkipBaseBodyEditEvent(event)) return;
+    capture();
+    atlasRequestRender?.({ preview: true });
+    scheduleAutosave();
+  });
+  document.body.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
+    if (event.target.closest("#activeAuditSelect, #auditLibrarySelect")) return;
+    if (shouldSkipBaseBodyEditEvent(event)) return;
+    capture();
+    atlasRequestRender?.({
+      selectedStep: true,
+      preview: true,
+      logicTable: true,
+      validation: true,
+    });
+    scheduleAutosave();
+  });
+  document.body.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+    const restoreButton = event.target.closest("[data-restore-deleted-audit]");
+    if (restoreButton) {
+      atlasRestoreDeletedAudit(restoreButton.dataset.restoreDeletedAudit).catch(
+        (error) => status(error.message, "bad"),
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+    const permanentButton = event.target.closest(
+      "[data-permanently-delete-audit]",
+    );
+    if (permanentButton) {
+      atlasPermanentlyDeleteAudit(
+        permanentButton.dataset.permanentlyDeleteAudit,
+      ).catch((error) => status(error.message, "bad"));
+      return;
+    }
+    const openAuditButton = event.target.closest("[data-open-database-audit]");
+    if (openAuditButton) {
+      const auditId = String(
+        openAuditButton.dataset.openDatabaseAudit || "",
+      ).trim();
+      if (!auditId) return;
+      event.preventDefault();
+      atlasLoadDatabaseAudit(auditId).catch((err) =>
+        status(`Audit load failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+    const card = event.target.closest(".step-card");
+    if (event.target.matches("[data-select-step]") && card) {
+      if (typeof atlasSelectStepWithoutListRender === "function") {
+        atlasSelectStepWithoutListRender(card.dataset.id);
+      } else {
+        state.selectedStepId = card.dataset.id;
+        renderSteps();
+        renderSelectedStep();
+      }
+    }
+    if (event.target.matches("[data-add-child-step]") && card) {
+      capture();
+      const parentStep = state.audit.steps.find(
+        (item) => item.id === card.dataset.id,
+      );
+      if (parentStep?.autoGeneratedReference)
+        return status(
+          "Generated reference steps cannot have child logic steps.",
+          "warn",
+        );
+      if (parentStep) addChildStep(parentStep);
+      return;
+    }
+    if (event.target.matches("[data-delete-step]") && card) {
+      capture();
+      const step = state.audit.steps.find(
+        (item) => item.id === card.dataset.id,
+      );
+      if (step?.autoGeneratedReference)
+        return status(
+          "Generated reference steps are removed by removing the source file.",
+          "warn",
+        );
+      state.audit.steps = state.audit.steps.filter(
+        (item) => item.id !== card.dataset.id,
+      );
+      atlasRequestStructuralStepRender?.();
+      scheduleAutosave();
+    }
+    if (event.target.matches("[data-indent]") && card) {
+      capture();
+      const step = state.audit.steps.find(
+        (item) => item.id === card.dataset.id,
+      );
+      if (step?.autoGeneratedReference)
+        return status("Generated reference steps cannot be nested.", "warn");
+      if (!makeChildOfPrevious(step))
+        status("This step cannot be nested under the previous step.", "warn");
+      atlasRequestStructuralStepRender?.();
+      scheduleAutosave();
+    }
+    if (event.target.matches("[data-outdent]") && card) {
+      capture();
+      const step = state.audit.steps.find(
+        (item) => item.id === card.dataset.id,
+      );
+      if (!outdentStep(step)) status("This step is already top-level.", "warn");
+      atlasRequestStructuralStepRender?.();
+      scheduleAutosave();
+    }
+  });
+  window.addEventListener("resize", positionTutorial);
+  if (!window.__atlasPageHideSaveBound) {
+    window.addEventListener("pagehide", atlasSaveOnPageHide);
+    window.__atlasPageHideSaveBound = true;
+  }
+}

+/**

+ */
+async function init() {

+  updateNavigationLockState?.();
+  renderFlowNavControls?.();
+
+  const essentialStartup = await Promise.allSettled([
+    initPhraseCatalog?.(),
+    atlasInitSourceDatabase?.(),
+    atlasInitAuditDatabase?.({ render: false }),
+    atlasLoadCurrentUser?.({ render: false }),
+  ]);

+  renderMyAudits?.();

+  const restored = await restoreAutosave().catch(() => false);
+  if (!restored) state.selectedStepId = state.audit.steps[0]?.id || null;
+  syncAutoReferenceSteps?.();
+  updateNavigationLockState?.();
+  renderFlowNavControls?.();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  renderFieldDisplayModeButton?.();

+  const startupFailures = essentialStartup.filter(
+    (result) => result.status === "rejected",

+  status(
+    startupFailures.length
+      ? "Ready with startup warnings. Review the visible loading or error messages."
+      : "Ready. Select source files, build logic steps, and export the audit.",
+    startupFailures.length ? "warn" : "ok",
+  );

+================================================================================
+BEGIN FILE: js/15h-visual-picker.js
+================================================================================
+
+/**
+ * Shared, persistence-free Visual Picker foundation.
+ *
+ * The component owns picker rendering, search, sorting, selection UI, and
+ * keyboard/focus behavior. Callers remain responsible for supplying entries
+ * and for handling the selected value in `onSelect`.
+ *
+ * Required markup:
+ * - A host with id `atlas-visual-picker-root`.
+ * - The child IDs referenced by `element()` below, as provided by the shared
+ *   Visual Picker HTML partial.
+ *
+ * Basic usage:
+ *
+ *   window.ATLASVisualPicker.open({
+ *     mode: "field",
+ *     title: "Choose Field",
+ *     guidance: "Select an available field.",
+ *     entries: [
+ *       {
+ *         key: "source-key::field-name",
+ *         label: "Friendly field name",
+ *         rawName: "field_name",
+ *         sourceKey: "source-key",
+ *         sourceLabel: "Source name",
+ *         sourceColor: "#667085",
+ *         custom: false,
+ *         disabled: false,
+ *       },
+ *     ],
+ *     onSelect(originalEntry, key) {
+ *       // Persist or apply the selection in the calling workflow.
+ *     },
+ *   });
+ *
+ * Public API:
+ * - open(config): configure, render, and open the picker.
+ * - close(reason): close the picker and restore focus.
+ * - refresh(): re-render from the current internal state.
+ * - isOpen(): report whether the shared host is visible.
+ */
+(function initializeAtlasVisualPicker(global) {
+  "use strict";
+
+  // The shared HTML partial provides one host with this ID.
+  const ROOT_ID = "atlas-visual-picker-root";
+
+  // Ephemeral UI state only. Audit or application persistence stays with callers.
+  const state = {
+    config: null,
+    entries: [],
+    query: "",
+    sort: "source",
+    vanityLabels: false,
+    selectedKey: null,
+    message: "",
+    restoreFocus: null,
+  };
+
+  /** Return the shared picker host, or null when the partial is unavailable. */
+  function root() {
+    return document.getElementById(ROOT_ID);
+  }
+  /** Look up a required picker element by its stable DOM ID. */
+  function element(id) {
+    return document.getElementById(id);
+  }
+  /** Convert a value to display text while preserving an explicit fallback. */
+  function text(value, fallback = "") {
+    return value == null ? fallback : String(value);
+  }
+  /**
+   * Resolve the label currently shown for an entry.
+   * `vanityLabels` switches between the Vanity Label/Field Display Name and Source Field Name.
+   */
+  function labelFor(entry) {
+    const display = text(
+      entry.label ?? entry.displayName,
+      text(entry.rawName, text(entry.key)),
+    );
+    return state.vanityLabels ? display : text(entry.rawName, display);
+  }
+  /**
+   * Normalize caller-provided entries into the component's internal shape.
+   * Entries without a key are ignored, and duplicate keys keep the first item.
+   * The original caller object is retained for the `onSelect` callback.
+   */
+  function normalizedEntries(entries) {
+    const seen = new Set();
+    return (Array.isArray(entries) ? entries : []).reduce((result, item) => {
+      if (!item || item.key == null) return result;
+      const key = String(item.key);
+      if (seen.has(key)) return result;
+      seen.add(key);
+      result.push({
+        key,
+        label: text(item.label ?? item.displayName, text(item.rawName, key)),
+        rawName: text(item.rawName, text(item.label ?? item.displayName, key)),
+        sourceKey: text(item.sourceKey ?? item.source, "other"),
+        sourceLabel: text(
+          item.sourceLabel ?? item.sourceName ?? item.source,
+          "Other",
+        ),
+        sourceColor: text(item.sourceColor ?? item.color, "#667085"),
+        custom: Boolean(item.custom),
+        badge: text(item.badge, item.custom ? "Custom" : ""),
+        disabled: Boolean(item.disabled),
+        avatar: text(item.avatar),
+        initials: text(item.initials),
+        detail: text(item.detail),
+        optionClass: text(item.optionClass),
+        original: item,
+      });
+      return result;
+    }, []);
+  }
+  /**
+   * Return entries matching the current query, sorted by their visible label.
+   * Search covers friendly labels, raw names, and source labels.
+   */
+  function visibleEntries() {
+    const query = state.query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
+    const matches = state.entries.filter(
+      (entry) =>
+        !query ||
+        [entry.label, entry.rawName, entry.sourceLabel].some((value) =>
+          value.toLocaleLowerCase().includes(query),
+        ),
+    );
+    return matches.sort((a, b) =>
+      labelFor(a).localeCompare(labelFor(b), undefined, {
+        sensitivity: "base",
+      }),
+    );
+  }
+  /**
+   * Build one selectable result button, including selected, disabled, color,
+   * and optional badge presentation. The function only creates DOM elements.
+   */
+  function optionButton(entry) {
+    const button = document.createElement("button");
+    button.type = "button";
+    button.className = `atlas-visual-picker-option${entry.optionClass ? ` ${entry.optionClass}` : ""}`;
+    button.role = "option";
+    button.dataset.atlasPickerKey = entry.key;
+    button.disabled = entry.disabled;
+    button.setAttribute(
+      "aria-selected",
+      String(entry.key === state.selectedKey),
+    );
+    button.style.setProperty("--atlas-source-color", entry.sourceColor);
+    if (entry.avatar || entry.initials) {
+      const avatar = document.createElement("span");
+      avatar.className = "atlas-visual-picker-user-avatar";
+      avatar.textContent = entry.initials || "?";
+      avatar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
+      if (entry.avatar) {
+        const image = document.createElement("img");
+        image.src = entry.avatar;
+        image.alt = "";
+        image.loading = "lazy";
+        image.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
+        image.addEventListener("error", () => image.remove(), { once: true });
+        avatar.append(image);
+      }
+      button.append(avatar);
+    }
+    const content = document.createElement("span");
+    content.className = "atlas-visual-picker-option-content";
+    const label = document.createElement("span");
+    label.className = "atlas-visual-picker-option-label";
+    label.textContent = labelFor(entry);
+    content.append(label);
+    if (entry.detail) {
+      const detail = document.createElement("small");
+      detail.className = "atlas-visual-picker-option-detail";
+      detail.textContent = entry.detail;
+      content.append(detail);
+    }
+    button.append(content);
+    if (entry.badge) {
+      const badge = document.createElement("span");
+      badge.className = "atlas-visual-picker-badge";
+      badge.textContent = entry.badge;
+      button.append(badge);
+    }
+    return button;
+  }
+  /** Render one source/result group and append all entry buttons to it. */
+  function renderGroup(container, heading, color, entries) {
+    const group = document.createElement("section");
+    group.className = "atlas-visual-picker-group";
+    const title = document.createElement("h3");
+    title.className = "atlas-visual-picker-group-heading";
+    title.style.setProperty("--atlas-source-color", color);
+    const dot = document.createElement("span");
+    dot.className = "atlas-visual-picker-source-dot";
+    dot.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
+    const name = document.createElement("span");
+    name.textContent = heading;
+    const count = document.createElement("span");
+    count.className = "atlas-visual-picker-count";
+    count.textContent = `(${entries.length})`;
+    title.append(dot, name, count);
+    const options = document.createElement("div");
+    options.className = "atlas-visual-picker-options";
+    entries.forEach((entry) => options.append(optionButton(entry)));
+    group.append(title, options);
+    container.append(group);
+  }
+  /**
+   * Re-render the result area from current state.
+   * Use `ATLASVisualPicker.refresh()` after changing state through the public
+   * lifecycle; callers normally do not need to call this directly.
+   * Returns false if the shared results markup is unavailable.
+   */
+  function refresh() {
+    const container = element("atlas-visual-picker-results");
+    const empty = element("atlas-visual-picker-empty");
+    if (!container || !empty) return false;
+    const entries = visibleEntries();
+    container.replaceChildren();
+    if (state.sort === "alpha") {
+      const groups = new Map();
+      entries.forEach((entry) => {
+        const letter = firstLetter(labelFor(entry));
+        if (!groups.has(letter)) groups.set(letter, []);
+        groups.get(letter).push(entry);
+      });
+      [...groups.entries()]
+        .sort(([a], [b]) => {
+          if (a === "#") return -1;
+          if (b === "#") return 1;
+          return a.localeCompare(b, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" });
+        })
+        .forEach(([letter, groupEntries]) =>
+          renderGroup(container, letter, "#667085", groupEntries),
+        );
+    } else {
+      const groups = new Map();
+      entries.forEach((entry) => {
+        if (!groups.has(entry.sourceKey))
+          groups.set(entry.sourceKey, {
+            label: entry.sourceLabel,
+            color: entry.sourceColor,
+            entries: [],
+          });
+        groups.get(entry.sourceKey).entries.push(entry);
+      });
+      [...groups.values()]
+        .sort((a, b) =>
+          a.label.localeCompare(b.label, undefined, { sensitivity: "base" }),
+        )
+        .forEach((group) =>
+          renderGroup(container, group.label, group.color, group.entries),
+        );
+    }
+    empty.textContent =
+      state.message || state.config?.emptyMessage || "No matching options.";
+    empty.classList.toggle("is-error", state.config?.messageKind === "error");
+    empty.hidden = entries.length !== 0;
+    container.hidden = entries.length === 0;
+    return true;
+  }
+  /**
+   * Close the picker, remove the temporary document key handler, invoke the
+   * optional `onClose(reason)` callback, and restore focus to the opener.
+   * Returns false when the picker is already closed or the host is unavailable.
+   */
+  function close(reason = "close") {
+    const host = root();
+    if (!host || host.hidden) return false;
+    host.hidden = true;
+    document.removeEventListener("keydown", onDocumentKeydown, true);
+    if (typeof state.config?.onClose === "function")
+      state.config.onClose(reason);
+    const restore = state.restoreFocus;
+    state.config = null;
+    state.restoreFocus = null;
+    if (
+      restore &&
+      document.contains(restore) &&
+      typeof restore.focus === "function"
+    )
+      restore.focus();
+    return true;
+  }
+  /**
+   * Handle modal keyboard behavior while open: Escape closes the picker and
+   * Tab/Shift+Tab are wrapped within the picker controls.
+   */
+  function onDocumentKeydown(event) {
+    if (event.key === "Escape") {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      close("escape");
+      return;
+    }
+    if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
+    const host = root();
+    const focusable = [
+      ...host.querySelectorAll(
+        'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
+      ),
+    ].filter((node) => !node.hidden);
+    if (!focusable.length) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      element("atlas-visual-picker-dialog")?.focus();
+      return;
+    }
+    const first = focusable[0];
+    const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
+    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      last.focus();
+    } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      first.focus();
+    }
+  }
+  /**
+   * Select an enabled entry by key, notify `onSelect(originalEntry, key)`, and
+   * close unless the caller explicitly sets `closeOnSelect: false`.
+   */
+  function selectEntry(key) {
+    const entry = state.entries.find((candidate) => candidate.key === key);
+    if (!entry || entry.disabled) return;
+    state.selectedKey = entry.key;
+    refresh();
+    if (typeof state.config?.onSelect === "function")
+      state.config.onSelect(entry.original, entry.key);
+    if (state.config?.closeOnSelect !== false) close("select");
+  }
+  /**
+   * Bind host, search, label-mode, and sort events exactly once.
+   * The `data-atlas-picker-bound` flag prevents duplicate listeners when the
+   * same singleton picker is opened repeatedly.
+   */
+  function bindHost(host) {
+    if (host.dataset.atlasPickerBound === "true") return;
+    host.dataset.atlasPickerBound = "true";
+    host.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+      const closeControl = event.target.closest("[data-atlas-picker-close]");
+      if (closeControl) {
+        close("dismiss");
+        return;
+      }
+      const option = event.target.closest("[data-atlas-picker-key]");
+      if (option) selectEntry(option.dataset.atlasPickerKey);
+    });
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-search")?.addEventListener(
+      "input",
+      (event) => {
+        state.query = event.target.value;
+        refresh();
+        if (typeof state.config?.onQueryChange === "function")
+          state.config.onQueryChange(state.query);
+      },
+    );
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-label-mode")?.addEventListener(
+      "click",
+      (event) => {
+        if (typeof state.config?.onAction === "function") {
+          state.config.onAction(state.query);
+          return;
+        }
+        state.vanityLabels = !state.vanityLabels;
+        if (state.config?.mode === "field") {
+          localStorage.setItem(
+            "atlasAlignVisualPickerFieldDisplayMode",
+            state.vanityLabels ? "vanity" : "source",
+          );
+        }
+        const nextLabel = state.vanityLabels
+          ? "Display Source Field Name"
+          : "Display Vanity Label/Field Display Name";
+        event.currentTarget.setAttribute(
+          "aria-pressed",
+          String(state.vanityLabels),
+        );
+        event.currentTarget.setAttribute("aria-label", nextLabel);
+        event.currentTarget.title = nextLabel;
+        refresh();
+      },
+    );
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-sort-source")?.addEventListener("click", () =>
+      setSort("source"),
+    );
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-sort-alpha")?.addEventListener("click", () =>
+      setSort("alpha"),
+    );
+  }
+  /**
+   * Set the active result organization (`source` or `alpha`), synchronize the
+   * controls' aria-pressed states, and refresh the results.
+   */
+  function setSort(sort) {
+    state.sort = sort;
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-sort-source")?.setAttribute(
+      "aria-pressed",
+      String(sort === "source"),
+    );
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-sort-alpha")?.setAttribute(
+      "aria-pressed",
+      String(sort === "alpha"),
+    );
+    refresh();
+  }
+  /**
+   * Configure and open the shared picker.
+   *
+   * Required config:
+   * - entries: array of uniquely keyed caller entries.
+   *
+   * Common optional config:
+   * - mode: `source` or `field`, used for the default title.
+   * - title, guidance, searchPlaceholder: user-facing text.
+   * - query: initial search text.
+   * - sort: `alpha`; all other values default to `source`.
+   * - vanityLabels: start in vanity-label mode when true. Field pickers otherwise use the independent persisted preference, falling back to the app-wide field display mode only when uninitialized.
+   * - selectedKey: key to expose with aria-selected="true".
+   * - closeOnSelect: set false when the caller closes after a successful commit.
+   * - onSelect(originalEntry, key): apply the selected entry.
+   * - onClose(reason): respond to `close`, `escape`, `dismiss`, or caller reasons.
+   *
+   * Returns true when opened, or false when required host/config data is absent.
+   */
+  function open(config = {}) {
+    const host = root();
+    if (!host) {
+      console.error("ATLAS Visual Picker: host partial is not loaded.");
+      return false;
+    }
+    if (!config || !Array.isArray(config.entries)) {
+      console.error("ATLAS Visual Picker: open() requires an entries array.");
+      return false;
+    }
+    bindHost(host);
+    state.config = config;
+    state.entries = normalizedEntries(config.entries);
+    state.query = text(config.query);
+    state.sort = config.sort === "alpha" ? "alpha" : "source";
+    const storedFieldMode =
+      config.mode === "field"
+        ? localStorage.getItem("atlasAlignVisualPickerFieldDisplayMode")
+        : null;
+    state.vanityLabels =
+      storedFieldMode === "vanity"
+        ? true
+        : storedFieldMode === "source"
+          ? false
+          : typeof config.vanityLabels === "boolean"
+            ? config.vanityLabels
+            : config.mode === "field" &&
+                typeof global.fieldDisplayMode === "function"
+              ? global.fieldDisplayMode() === "vanity"
+              : false;
+    state.selectedKey =
+      config.selectedKey == null ? null : String(config.selectedKey);
+    state.message = text(config.message);
+    state.restoreFocus = document.activeElement;
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-title").textContent = text(
+      config.title,
+      config.mode === "source" ? "Select a source" : "Select a field",
+    );
+    element("atlas-visual-picker-guidance").textContent = text(
+      config.guidance,
+      "Search or browse the available options.",
+    );
+    const search = element("atlas-visual-picker-search");
+    search.value = state.query;
+    search.placeholder = text(config.searchPlaceholder, "Search");
+    const labelMode = element("atlas-visual-picker-label-mode");
+    labelMode.hidden = config.hideLabelMode === true;
+    labelMode.textContent = text(config.actionLabel, "Aa");
+    labelMode.title = text(
+      config.actionTitle,
+      state.vanityLabels
+        ? "Display Source Field Name"
+        : "Display Vanity Label/Field Display Name",
+    );
+    labelMode.setAttribute(
+      "aria-label",
+      state.vanityLabels
+        ? "Display Source Field Name"
+        : "Display Vanity Label/Field Display Name",
+    );
+    labelMode.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(state.vanityLabels));
+    setSort(state.sort);
+    host.hidden = false;
+    document.addEventListener("keydown", onDocumentKeydown, true);
+    requestAnimationFrame(() => search.focus());
+    return true;
+  }
+  /** Replace picker entries without reopening or changing focus. */
+  function setEntries(entries, options = {}) {
+    if (!state.config || !Array.isArray(entries)) return false;
+    state.entries = normalizedEntries(entries);
+    state.message = text(options.message);
+    state.config.messageKind = text(options.kind);
+    if (options.emptyMessage != null)
+      state.config.emptyMessage = text(options.emptyMessage);
+    return refresh();
+  }
+  /** Update the visible empty/loading/error message. */
+  function setMessage(message, kind = "") {
+    if (!state.config) return false;
+    state.message = text(message);
+    state.config.messageKind = text(kind);
+    return refresh();
+  }
+  /** Return true only when the shared picker host exists and is visible. */
+  function isOpen() {
+    const host = root();
+    return Boolean(host && !host.hidden);
+  }
+
+  // Publish one immutable singleton API without replacing an existing instance.
+  if (!global.ATLASVisualPicker)
+    global.ATLASVisualPicker = Object.freeze({
+      open,
+      close,
+      refresh,
+      setEntries,
+      setMessage,
+      isOpen,
+    });
+})(window);
+
+

+END FILE: js/15h-visual-picker.js

+/**
+ * Sets textContent for an element by id.
+ * @param {any} id - Element id or record id to look up.
+ * @param {any} value - Value to process or assign.
+ */
+function setText(id, value) {
+  const el = $(id);
+  if (el) el.textContent = value;
+}

+/**
+ * Updates dashboard, overview, and group snapshot metrics.
+ */
+function updateDashboardMetrics() {
+  const repoAudits = repoLibraryState?.audits?.length || 0;
+  const savedAudits = state.savedFlows?.length || 0;
+  const selectedSources = state.audit.sources?.length || 0;
+  const logicSteps = state.audit.steps?.length || 0;
+  const sourceFiles = repoLibraryState?.sourceFiles?.length || 0;
+  const vanityLabels = repoLibraryState?.vanityLabels?.length || 0;
+  const sourceAliases = repoLibraryState?.sourceAliases?.length || 0;
+  const fieldCount =
+    (state.audit.fields || []).length ||
+    (state.audit.sources || []).reduce(
+      (total, source) =>
+        total +
+        (typeof fieldsForSource === "function"
+          ? fieldsForSource(source.name).length
+          : 0),
+      0,
+    );
+
+  setText("metricRepoAudits", repoAudits.toLocaleString());
+  setText("metricSavedAudits", savedAudits.toLocaleString());
+  setText("metricSelectedSources", selectedSources.toLocaleString());
+  setText("metricLogicSteps", logicSteps.toLocaleString());
+  setText("metricSourceFiles", sourceFiles.toLocaleString());
+  setText("metricVanityLabels", vanityLabels.toLocaleString());
+  setText("metricSourceAliases", sourceAliases.toLocaleString());
+  setText("overviewSourceCount", selectedSources.toLocaleString());
+  setText("overviewFieldCount", fieldCount.toLocaleString());
+  setText("overviewStepCount", logicSteps.toLocaleString());
+  setText("selectedSourceBadge", selectedSources.toLocaleString());
+  const deleteAuditButton = $("deleteAuditBtn");
+  if (deleteAuditButton) {
+    const canArchive = Boolean(
+      hasSelectedAudit?.() &&
+      state.auditPersistence?.auditId === state.audit?.id &&
+      state.auditPersistence?.revisionId &&
+      state.auditPersistence?.access?.canArchive,
+    );
+    deleteAuditButton.hidden = !canArchive;
+    if (!deleteAuditButton.matches('[aria-busy="true"]'))
+      deleteAuditButton.disabled = !canArchive;
+  }
+
+  const progress = Math.min(
+    100,
+    Math.round(
+      ([
+        state.audit.name && state.audit.name !== "New Audit Logic Flow",
+        !!state.audit.purpose,
+        selectedSources > 0,
+        fieldCount > 0,
+        logicSteps > 0,
+      ].filter(Boolean).length /
+        5) *
+        100,
+    ),
+  );
+  setText("overviewProgressBadge", `${progress}% ready`);
+
+  const snapshot = $("groupAuditSnapshot");
+  if (snapshot) {
+    snapshot.innerHTML = `
+      <div class="package"><span>Audit</span><strong>${esc(state.audit.name || "Untitled Audit")}</strong></div>
+      <div class="package"><span>Purpose</span><strong>${state.audit.purpose ? "Entered" : "Missing"}</strong></div>
+      <div class="package"><span>Sources</span><strong>${selectedSources.toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
+      <div class="package"><span>Logic steps</span><strong>${logicSteps.toLocaleString()}</strong></div>
+    `;
+  }
+  const savedList = $("groupSavedAuditList");
+  if (savedList) {
+    const flows = (state.savedFlows || []).slice(0, 6);
+    savedList.innerHTML = flows.length
+      ? flows
+          .map(
+            (flow) =>
+              `<div class="package"><span>${esc(flow.name || "Saved Audit")}</span><small>${esc(flow.updatedAt ? new Date(flow.updatedAt).toLocaleString() : "")}</small></div>`,
+          )
+          .join("")
+      : '<p class="hint">Saved audits will appear here after local saves are loaded.</p>';
+  }
+}

+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

+/**
+ * Builds audit options for the topbar selector.
+ */
+function topbarAuditOptions() {
+  const options = [];
+  (repoLibraryState?.audits || []).forEach((audit) =>
+    options.push({
+      group: "Repo Audits",
+      value: `repo:${audit.id}`,
+      label: audit.name || audit.id,
+    }),
+  );
+  (state.savedFlows || []).forEach((flow) =>
+    options.push({
+      group: "Local Saved Audits",
+      value: `local:${flow.id}`,
+      label: flow.name || "Saved audit",
+    }),
+  );
+  if (typeof workbookState !== "undefined" && workbookState.loaded) {
+    (workbookState.auditSheets || []).forEach((name) =>
+      options.push({
+        group: "Workbook Imports",
+        value: `workbook:${name}`,
+        label: name,
+      }),
+    );
+  }
+  if (
+    hasSelectedAudit() &&
+    String(state.activeAuditValue || "").startsWith("draft:") &&
+    !options.some((option) => option.value === state.activeAuditValue)
+  ) {
+    options.push({
+      group: "Current Draft",
+      value: state.activeAuditValue,
+      label: state.audit.name || "Unsaved Draft",
+    });
+  }
+  if (
+    hasSelectedAudit() &&
+    state.activeAuditValue &&
+    !options.some((option) => option.value === state.activeAuditValue) &&
+    state.audit.name
+  ) {
+    options.push({
+      group: "Current Audit",
+      value: state.activeAuditValue,
+      label: state.audit.name,
+    });
+  }
+  return options;
+}

+/**
+ * Renders the topbar active-audit selector.
+ */
+function renderActiveAuditSelect() {
+  const select = $("activeAuditSelect");
+  const confirmButton = $("confirmActiveAuditBtn");
+  renderTopbarAuditSwitcherVisibility();
+  if (!select) return;
+  const options = topbarAuditOptions();
+  const stagedValue = state.pendingActiveAuditValue || "";
+  if (!hasSelectedAudit()) {
+    const placeholder = options.length
+      ? "Select an audit..."
+      : "No audit selected";
+    const groups = [...new Set(options.map((option) => option.group))];
+    select.innerHTML =
+      `<option value="">${esc(placeholder)}</option>` +
+      groups
+        .map(
+          (group) =>
+            `<optgroup label="${esc(group)}">${options
+              .filter((option) => option.group === group)
+              .map(
+                (option) =>
+                  `<option value="${esc(option.value)}">${esc(option.label)}</option>`,
+              )
+              .join("")}</optgroup>`,
+        )
+        .join("");
+    select.disabled = !options.length;
+    select.value =
+      stagedValue && options.some((option) => option.value === stagedValue)
+        ? stagedValue
+        : "";
+    if (confirmButton) confirmButton.disabled = !select.value;
+    return;
+  }
+  let renderOptions = options;
+  if (
+    state.activeAuditValue &&
+    state.audit.name &&
+    !renderOptions.some((option) => option.value === state.activeAuditValue)
+  ) {
+    renderOptions = [
+      {
+        group: "Current Audit",
+        value: state.activeAuditValue,
+        label: state.audit.name,
+      },
+      ...renderOptions,
+    ];
+  }
+  const groups = [...new Set(renderOptions.map((option) => option.group))];
+  select.innerHTML = groups
+    .map(
+      (group) =>
+        `<optgroup label="${esc(group)}">${renderOptions
+          .filter((option) => option.group === group)
+          .map(
+            (option) =>
+              `<option value="${esc(option.value)}">${esc(option.label)}</option>`,
+          )
+          .join("")}</optgroup>`,
+    )
+    .join("");
+  select.disabled = !renderOptions.length;
+  const valueToShow =
+    stagedValue && renderOptions.some((option) => option.value === stagedValue)
+      ? stagedValue
+      : state.activeAuditValue;
+  if (
+    valueToShow &&
+    renderOptions.some((option) => option.value === valueToShow)
+  )
+    select.value = valueToShow;
+  if (confirmButton)
+    confirmButton.disabled =
+      !select.value || select.value === state.activeAuditValue;
+}

+/**
+ * Locks or unlocks navigation based on active audit state.
+ */
+function updateNavigationLockState() {
+  const unlockedPages = new Set(["my-audits", "group"]);
+  const locked = !hasSelectedAudit();
+  document.body.classList.toggle("audit-selected", !locked);
+  document.body.classList.toggle("audit-not-selected", locked);
+  document.querySelectorAll(".navitem, .rail-item").forEach((button) => {
+    const targetPage = pageForSection(
+      button.dataset.section ||
+        button.dataset.page ||
+        button.dataset.panel ||
+        "",
+    );
+    const shouldLock = locked && !unlockedPages.has(targetPage);
+    button.classList.toggle("is-locked", shouldLock);
+    if (shouldLock) {
+      button.setAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
+      button.setAttribute("title", "Select or create an audit first.");
+    } else {
+      button.removeAttribute("aria-disabled");
+      button.removeAttribute("title");
+    }
+  });
+  renderFlowNavControls?.();
+}

+/**
+ * Renders Back/Next controls for the audit workflow.
+ */
+function renderFlowNavControls() {
+  const controls = $("flowNavControls");
+  const back = $("flowBackBtn");
+  const next = $("flowNextBtn");
+  if (!controls || !back || !next) return;
+  const currentPage = activeAuditFlowPage();
+  const currentIndex = AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES.findIndex(
+    (item) => item.page === currentPage,
+  );
+  const showControls = hasSelectedAudit() && currentIndex >= 0;
+  controls.hidden = !showControls;
+  if (!showControls) {
+    back.hidden = true;
+    next.hidden = true;
+    back.removeAttribute("data-flow-target");
+    next.removeAttribute("data-flow-target");
+    return;
+  }
+  const previous = AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES[currentIndex - 1];
+  const current = AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES[currentIndex];
+  const nextPage = AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES[currentIndex + 1];
+  back.hidden = !previous;
+  if (previous) {
+    back.textContent = `Back: ${previous.label}`;
+    back.dataset.flowTarget = previous.page;
+  } else {
+    back.removeAttribute("data-flow-target");
+  }
+  next.hidden = !nextPage;
+  if (nextPage) {
+    next.textContent = `Next: ${current.nextLabel || nextPage.label}`;
+    next.dataset.flowTarget = nextPage.page;
+  } else {
+    next.removeAttribute("data-flow-target");
+  }
+}
