+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Page shell event handlers
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+  const flowNav = event.target.closest("[data-flow-target]");
+  if (flowNav) {
+    event.preventDefault();
+    atlasNavigateToSection(flowNav.dataset.flowTarget).catch((err) =>
+      status(`Navigation save failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    );
+    renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+    renderFieldDisplayModeButton?.();
+    return;
+  }
+  const nav = event.target.closest(".navitem");
+  if (nav) {
+    if (nav.classList.contains("is-locked")) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      event.stopPropagation();
+      return;
+    }
+    event.preventDefault();
+    atlasNavigateToSection(nav.dataset.section).catch((err) =>
+      status(`Navigation save failed: ${err.message}`, "bad"),
+    );
+    renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+    renderFieldDisplayModeButton?.();
+    return;
+  }
+  if (event.target.closest("#collapseNavBtn")) {
+    $("sidebar")?.classList.toggle("collapsed");
+    $("main")?.classList.toggle("expanded");
+    localStorage.setItem(
+      "atlasAlignNavCollapsed",
+      $("sidebar")?.classList.contains("collapsed") ? "Yes" : "No",
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+  if (event.target.closest("#myAuditsNewAuditBtn")) {
+    $("newAuditBtn")?.click();
+    return;
+  }
+  const previewTab = event.target.closest("[data-preview-tab]");
+  if (previewTab) {
+    document
+      .querySelectorAll("[data-preview-tab]")
+      .forEach((tab) => tab.classList.toggle("active", tab === previewTab));
+    if (e.previewStyle) e.previewStyle.value = previewTab.dataset.previewTab;
+    renderPreview?.();
+  }
+});

+  displayName: atlasDisplayUser,

+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+// Final audit switcher override
+// -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
+/* Final audit switcher rendering and Switch button refinements */
+function atlasOptionHtml(option) {
+  return `<option value="${esc(option.value)}">${esc(option.label || option.value)}</option>`;
+}
+/**
+ * Groups audit options for the topbar selector.
+ * @param {any} options - Configuration/options object.
+ * @param {any} includePlaceholder - Input used by atlasGroupedAuditOptionsHtml.
+ * @param {any} placeholder - Input used by atlasGroupedAuditOptionsHtml.
+ */
+function atlasGroupedAuditOptionsHtml(
+  options,
+  includePlaceholder = false,
+  placeholder = "Select an audit...",
+) {
+  const groups = [
+    ...new Set((options || []).map((option) => option.group || "Audits")),
+  ];
+  const placeholderHtml = includePlaceholder
+    ? `<option value="">${esc(placeholder)}</option>`
+    : "";
+  return (
+    placeholderHtml +
+    groups
+      .map(
+        (group) =>
+          `<optgroup label="${esc(group)}">${options
+            .filter((option) => (option.group || "Audits") === group)
+            .map(atlasOptionHtml)
+            .join("")}</optgroup>`,
+      )
+      .join("")
+  );
+}
+/**
+ * Renders the topbar active-audit selector.
+ */
+renderActiveAuditSelect = function renderActiveAuditSelectFinal() {
+  const select = $("activeAuditSelect");
+  const confirmButton = $("confirmActiveAuditBtn");
+  renderTopbarAuditSwitcherVisibility?.();
+  if (!select) return;
+  const options = topbarAuditOptions?.() || [];
+  const hasOptions = options.length > 0;
+  let renderOptions = options;
+  if (
+    hasSelectedAudit?.() &&
+    state.activeAuditValue &&
+    state.audit?.name &&
+    !renderOptions.some((option) => option.value === state.activeAuditValue)
+  ) {
+    renderOptions = [
+      {
+        group: "Current Audit",
+        value: state.activeAuditValue,
+        label: state.audit.name,
+      },
+      ...renderOptions,
+    ];
+  }
+  const stagedValue = state.pendingActiveAuditValue || "";
+  const includePlaceholder = !hasSelectedAudit?.();
+  const placeholder = hasOptions ? "Select an audit..." : "No audit selected";
+  select.innerHTML = atlasGroupedAuditOptionsHtml(
+    renderOptions,
+    includePlaceholder,
+    placeholder,
+  );
+  select.disabled = !renderOptions.length;
+  const valueToShow =
+    stagedValue && renderOptions.some((option) => option.value === stagedValue)
+      ? stagedValue
+      : state.activeAuditValue || "";
+  if (
+    valueToShow &&
+    renderOptions.some((option) => option.value === valueToShow)
+  )
+    select.value = valueToShow;
+  else select.value = includePlaceholder ? "" : renderOptions[0]?.value || "";
+  if (confirmButton) {
+    confirmButton.textContent = "Switch";
+    confirmButton.title = "Switch audit";
+    confirmButton.setAttribute("aria-label", "Switch audit");
+    confirmButton.classList.remove("secondary", "icon-button");
+    confirmButton.classList.add("primary");
+    confirmButton.disabled =
+      !select.value || select.value === state.activeAuditValue;
+  }
+};

+// Database-only audit selectors and metrics.
+topbarAuditOptions = function topbarDatabaseAuditOptions() {
+  const options = (state.databaseAudits || []).map((audit) => ({
+    group: "Database Audits",
+    value: `database:${audit.id}`,
+    label: `${audit.name || audit.id} · r${audit.currentRevisionNumber || 0}`,
+  }));
+  if (typeof workbookState !== "undefined" && workbookState.loaded)
+    (workbookState.auditSheets || []).forEach((name) =>
+      options.push({
+        group: "Workbook Imports",
+        value: `workbook:${name}`,
+        label: name,
+      }),
+    );
+  if (
+    hasSelectedAudit() &&
+    String(state.activeAuditValue || "").startsWith("draft:")
+  )
+    options.push({
+      group: "Current Draft",
+      value: state.activeAuditValue,
+      label: state.audit.name || "Unsaved Draft",
+    });
+  return options;
+};
+const atlasDatabaseMetricsBase = updateDashboardMetrics;

+          )
+          .join("")
+      : '<p class="hint">No database audits yet.</p>';
+  }
+};

+const ATLAS_ASSIGNMENT_ROLES = ["assigned", "backup", "developer"];
+
+// Assignment search state is required by the initial page-shell render and by
+// the input handlers registered later during bootstrap.
+state.assignmentUserSearch = state.assignmentUserSearch || {};
+ATLAS_ASSIGNMENT_ROLES.forEach((role) => {
+  state.assignmentUserSearch[role] = state.assignmentUserSearch[role] || {
+    query: "",
+    results: [],
+    loading: false,
+    error: "",
+    source: "recent",
+    controller: null,
+  };
+});
+// Signed-in profile, personal audit work queue, and assignment editor.
+function atlasUserInitials(user) {
+  const source = String(user?.fullName || user?.username || "").trim();
+  if (!source) return "?";
+  const parts = source.split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean);
+  return (
+    parts.length > 1 ? parts[0][0] + parts.at(-1)[0] : source.slice(0, 2)
+  ).toUpperCase();
+}
+function atlasDisplayUser(user) {
+  return String(user?.fullName || user?.username || "Unknown user");
+}
+function atlasUserMatches(left, right) {
+  const leftId = String(left?.id || "").trim(),
+    rightId = String(right?.id || "").trim();
+  if (leftId && rightId) return leftId === rightId;
+  const a = String(left?.username || "")
+      .trim()
+      .toLowerCase(),
+    b = String(right?.username || "")
+      .trim()
+      .toLowerCase();
+  return !!a && a === b;
+}
+function atlasAssignmentRole(role) {
+  return ATLAS_ASSIGNMENT_ROLES.includes(role) ? role : "";
+}
+function atlasEnsureAuditAssignments() {
+  const assignments = normalizeAuditAssignments?.(state.audit?.assignments) || {
+    assigned: [],
+    backup: [],
+    developer: [],
+  };
+  state.audit.assignments = assignments;
+  return assignments;
+}
+function atlasCommitAssignmentMutation(role) {
+  renderAssignmentEditor();
+  renderMyAudits();
+  atlasInvalidatePages?.(["my-audits", "overview"]);
+  scheduleAutosave?.();
+  globalThis.ATLASAuditIssues?.invalidate?.();
+  const roleLabel =
+    {
+      assigned: "Assigned Analysts",
+      backup: "Backup Analysts",
+      developer: "Developers",
+    }[role] || "Audit Assignments";
+  status?.(`${roleLabel} updated.`, "ok");
+}
+function atlasAddAuditAssignment(role, user) {
+  const validRole = atlasAssignmentRole(role);
+  const normalizedUser = normalizeAssignmentUser?.(user);
+  if (!validRole || !normalizedUser || user?.disabled === true) return false;
+  const assignments = atlasEnsureAuditAssignments();
+  if (
+    assignments[validRole].some((value) =>
+      atlasUserMatches(value, normalizedUser),
+    )
+  )
+    return false;
+  assignments[validRole].push(normalizedUser);
+  atlasCommitAssignmentMutation(validRole);
+  return true;
+}
+function atlasRemoveAuditAssignment(role, identity) {
+  const validRole = atlasAssignmentRole(role);
+  if (!validRole) return false;
+  const assignments = atlasEnsureAuditAssignments();
+  const current = assignments[validRole];
+  const next = current.filter((user) => !atlasUserMatches(user, identity));
+  if (next.length === current.length) return false;
+  assignments[validRole] = next;
+  atlasCommitAssignmentMutation(validRole);
+  return true;
+}
+function atlasAuditMembership(audit) {
+  const current = state.currentUser,
+    assignments = normalizeAuditAssignments?.(audit?.assignments) || {
+      assigned: [],
+      backup: [],
+      developer: [],
+    };
+  if (!current || state.currentUserStatus !== "ready")
+    return { assigned: false, backup: false, developer: false, role: "Other" };
+  const assigned = assignments.assigned.some((user) =>
+    atlasUserMatches(user, current),
+  );
+  const backup = assignments.backup.some((user) =>
+    atlasUserMatches(user, current),
+  );
+  const developer = assignments.developer.some((user) =>
+    atlasUserMatches(user, current),
+  );
+
+  return {
+    assigned,
+    backup,
+    developer,
+    role: assigned
+      ? "Assigned Analyst"
+      : backup
+        ? "Backup Analyst"
+        : developer
+          ? "Developer"
+          : "Other",
+  };
+}
+
+function renderCurrentUserProfile() {
+  const root = $("currentUserProfile");
+  if (!root) return;
+  root.replaceChildren();
+  if (
+    state.currentUserStatus === "loading" ||
+    state.currentUserStatus === "idle"
+  ) {
+    root.textContent = "Loading profile…";
+    root.setAttribute("aria-label", "Loading signed-in user profile");
+    return;
+  }
+  if (state.currentUserStatus !== "ready" || !state.currentUser) {
+    root.textContent = "Profile unavailable";
+    root.setAttribute("aria-label", "Signed-in user profile unavailable");
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const user = state.currentUser,
+    avatar = document.createElement("span");
+  avatar.className = "avatar profile-avatar";
+  avatar.textContent = atlasUserInitials(user);
+  avatar.setAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
+
+  if (user.avatar) {
+    const img = document.createElement("img");
+    img.src = user.avatar;
+    img.alt = `${atlasDisplayUser(user)} profile photo`;
+    img.addEventListener("error", () => img.remove(), { once: true });
+    avatar.append(img);
+  }
+
+  const text = document.createElement("span");
+  text.className = "profile-text";
+  const primary = document.createElement("strong");
+  primary.textContent = atlasDisplayUser(user);
+  const secondary = document.createElement("span");
+  secondary.className = "profile-secondary";
+  secondary.textContent = user.username || user.email || "";
+  text.append(primary, secondary);
+  root.append(avatar, text);
+  if (user.debugMetadata && typeof user.debugMetadata === "object") {
+    // TEMP DEBUG: remove with the server-side user metadata debug payload.
+    try {
+      const tooltip = document.createElement("span");
+      tooltip.className = "profile-debug-tooltip";
+      tooltip.setAttribute("role", "tooltip");
+      const label = document.createElement("strong");
+      label.className = "profile-debug-tooltip-label";
+      label.textContent = "Temporary user metadata debug";
+      const json = document.createElement("pre");
+      json.className = "profile-debug-tooltip-json";
+      json.textContent = JSON.stringify(user.debugMetadata, null, 2);
+      tooltip.append(label, json);
+      root.append(tooltip);
+      root.setAttribute("aria-describedby", "currentUserDebugMetadata");
+      tooltip.id = "currentUserDebugMetadata";
+    } catch (_error) {
+      root.removeAttribute("aria-describedby");
+    }
+  } else {
+    root.removeAttribute("aria-describedby");
+  }
+  root.setAttribute("aria-label", `Signed in as ${atlasDisplayUser(user)}`);
+}
+function atlasAssignmentNames(users) {
+  return (users || []).map(atlasDisplayUser).join(", ") || "None";
+}
+function atlasAuditSearchText(audit) {
+  const a = normalizeAuditAssignments?.(audit.assignments) || {
+    assigned: [],
+    backup: [],
+    developer: [],
+  };
+
+  return [
+    audit.name,
+    audit.id,
+    audit.purpose,
+    audit.description,
+    ...a.assigned.flatMap((u) => [u.fullName, u.username]),
+    ...a.backup.flatMap((u) => [u.fullName, u.username]),
+    ...a.developer.flatMap((u) => [u.fullName, u.username]),
+  ]
+    .join(" ")
+    .toLowerCase();
+}
+
+function renderMyAudits() {
+  const body = $("myAuditsTableBody"),
+    stateHost = $("myAuditsState");
+  if (!body || !stateHost) return;
+
+  const activeAudits = state.databaseAudits || [],
+    deletedAudits = state.deletedAudits || [],
+    identityReady = state.currentUserStatus === "ready",
+    canManageDeletedAudits = Boolean(
+      identityReady && state.currentUser?.access?.canManageDeletedAudits,
+    ),
+    requestedDeletedMode = state.myAuditsRoleFilter === "deleted",
+    deletedMode = requestedDeletedMode && canManageDeletedAudits,
+    effectiveFilter =
+      requestedDeletedMode && !canManageDeletedAudits
+        ? "all"
+        : state.myAuditsRoleFilter,
+    audits = deletedMode ? deletedAudits : activeAudits,
+    listStatus = deletedMode
+      ? state.deletedAuditsStatus
+      : state.databaseAuditsStatus,
+    listError = deletedMode
+      ? state.deletedAuditsError
+      : state.databaseAuditsError;
+
+  const metrics = {
+    assigned: 0,
+    backup: 0,
+    developer: 0,
+    other: 0,
+    all: activeAudits.length,
+  };
+
+  activeAudits.forEach((audit) => {
+    const membership = atlasAuditMembership(audit);
+    if (identityReady && membership.assigned) metrics.assigned++;
+    if (identityReady && membership.backup) metrics.backup++;
+    if (identityReady && membership.developer) metrics.developer++;
+    if (
+      !identityReady ||
+      (!membership.assigned && !membership.backup && !membership.developer)
+    )
+      metrics.other++;
+  });
+
+  Object.entries(metrics).forEach(([key, value]) =>
+    setText(`myAuditsMetric${key[0].toUpperCase() + key.slice(1)}`, value),
+  );
+
+  const deletedFilter = $("myAuditsDeletedFilter");
+  if (deletedFilter) deletedFilter.hidden = !canManageDeletedAudits;
+  setText("myAuditsDeletedCount", String(deletedAudits.length));
+
+  document.querySelectorAll("[data-my-audits-role]").forEach((button) => {
+    const filter = button.dataset.myAuditsRole;
+    const active = filter === effectiveFilter;
+    button.classList.toggle("active", active);
+    button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(active));
+    button.disabled =
+      (filter === "deleted" && !canManageDeletedAudits) ||
+      (!identityReady && filter !== "all");
+  });
+
+  if (listStatus === "loading") {
+    body.replaceChildren();
+    stateHost.textContent = deletedMode
+      ? "Loading Deleted Items…"
+      : "Loading database audits…";
+    stateHost.className = "my-audits-state loading";
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (listStatus === "error") {
+    body.replaceChildren();
+    const label = deletedMode ? "Deleted Items" : "Audit list";
+    stateHost.textContent = `${label} could not be loaded. ${listError || ""}`;
+    stateHost.className = "my-audits-state error";
+    return;
+  }
+
+  if (!identityReady && effectiveFilter !== "all") {
+    body.replaceChildren();
+    stateHost.textContent =
+      "Personalized audit filters are unavailable because your profile could not be loaded. Choose All to browse audits.";
+    stateHost.className = "my-audits-state error";
+    return;
+  }
+
+  const statusFilter = state.myAuditsStatusFilter || "all";
+  const statusControl = $("myAuditsStatusFilter");
+  if (statusControl) statusControl.value = statusFilter;
+  const query = String(state.myAuditsSearch ?? "")
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+  const filtered = audits.filter((audit) => {
+    const searchMatches = !query || atlasAuditSearchText(audit).includes(query);
+    if (deletedMode) return searchMatches;
+    const statusMatches =
+      statusFilter === "all" || (audit.status || "Draft") === statusFilter;
+
+    const membership = atlasAuditMembership(audit);
+    const filterMatches =
+      effectiveFilter === "all" ||
+      (effectiveFilter === "assigned" && membership.assigned) ||
+      (effectiveFilter === "backup" && membership.backup) ||
+      (effectiveFilter === "developer" && membership.developer) ||
+      (effectiveFilter === "other" &&
+        !membership.assigned &&
+        !membership.backup &&
+        !membership.developer);
+    return filterMatches && statusMatches && searchMatches;
+  });
+
+  body.replaceChildren();
+  stateHost.textContent = "";
+  stateHost.className = "my-audits-state";
+
+  filtered.forEach((audit) => {
+    const membership = atlasAuditMembership(audit),
+      assignments = normalizeAuditAssignments?.(audit.assignments) || {
+        assigned: [],
+        backup: [],
+        developer: [],
+      },
+      row = document.createElement("tr");
+    const cells = [
+      [audit.name || audit.id, audit.id],
+      [membership.role, ""],
+      [audit.status || "Draft", ""],
+      [atlasAssignmentNames(assignments.assigned), ""],
+      [atlasAssignmentNames(assignments.backup), ""],
+      [atlasAssignmentNames(assignments.developer), ""],
+      [
+        audit.updatedAt
+          ? new Date(audit.updatedAt).toLocaleString()
+          : "Not set",
+        "",
+      ],
+    ];
+
+    cells.forEach(([main, sub], index) => {
+      const cell = document.createElement("td");
+      if (index === 1) {
+        const badge = document.createElement("span");
+        badge.className = "badge role-badge";
+        badge.textContent = main;
+        cell.append(badge);
+      } else if (index === 2) {
+        const statusValue = String(main || "").trim() || "Draft";
+        const statusClasses = {
+          Draft: "draft",
+          "Requirement Gathering": "requirement-gathering",
+          "Ready for Review": "ready-for-review",
+          Complete: "complete",
+        };
+        const statusText = document.createElement("span");
+        statusText.textContent = statusValue;
+        if (statusClasses[statusValue])
+          statusText.className = `audit-status-pill audit-status-pill-${statusClasses[statusValue]}`;
+        cell.append(statusText);
+        cell.title = statusValue;
+      } else {
+        const mainText = document.createElement(
+          index === 0 ? "strong" : "span",
+        );
+        mainText.textContent = main;
+        cell.append(mainText);
+        if (sub) {
+          const secondaryText = document.createElement("small");
+          secondaryText.textContent = sub;
+          cell.append(secondaryText);
+        }
+        cell.title = main;
+      }
+      row.append(cell);
+    });
+
+    const action = document.createElement("td");
+    if (deletedMode) {
+      const restore = document.createElement("button");
+      restore.type = "button";
+      restore.className = "btn secondary small";
+      restore.dataset.restoreDeletedAudit = audit.id;
+      restore.textContent = "Restore";
+
+      const remove = document.createElement("button");
+      remove.type = "button";
+      remove.className = "btn secondary small";
+      remove.dataset.permanentlyDeleteAudit = audit.id;
+      remove.textContent = "Delete permanently";
+      action.append(restore, document.createTextNode(" "), remove);
+    } else {
+      const open = document.createElement("button");
+      open.type = "button";
+      open.className = "btn primary small";
+      open.dataset.openDatabaseAudit = audit.id;
+      open.textContent = "Open";
+      action.append(open);
+      if ((audit.status || "Draft") === "Complete") {
+        const publish = document.createElement("details");
+        publish.className = "audit-publish-menu";
+        const summary = document.createElement("summary");
+        summary.className = "btn secondary small";
+        summary.textContent = "Publish";
+        const menu = document.createElement("div");
+        menu.className = "audit-publish-menu-panel";
+        [
+          ["json", "Current Audit JSON"],
+          ["excel", "Excel Table View"],
+          ["qtest", "Qtest Excel Template"],
+          ["html", "Confluence HTML"],
+          ["clipboard", "Clipboard HTML"],
+        ].forEach(([format, label]) => {
+          const button = document.createElement("button");
+          button.type = "button";
+          button.className = "btn ghost small";
+          button.dataset.publishAudit = audit.id;
+          button.dataset.publishFormat = format;
+          button.textContent = label;
+          menu.append(button);
+        });
+        publish.append(summary, menu);
+        publish.addEventListener("toggle", () => {
+          if (!publish.open) {
+            menu.removeAttribute("style");
+            menu.removeAttribute("data-positioned");
+            return;
+          }
+          document
+            .querySelectorAll(".audit-publish-menu[open]")
+            .forEach((other) => {
+              if (other !== publish) other.open = false;
+            });
+          const margin = 8;
+          const gap = 6;
+          menu.style.visibility = "hidden";
+          menu.style.left = "0px";
+          menu.style.top = "0px";
+          menu.style.maxHeight = `${Math.max(120, window.innerHeight - margin * 2)}px`;
+          const triggerRect = summary.getBoundingClientRect();
+          const panelRect = menu.getBoundingClientRect();
+          const left = Math.min(
+            Math.max(margin, triggerRect.right - panelRect.width),
+            Math.max(margin, window.innerWidth - panelRect.width - margin),
+          );
+          const availableBelow =
+            window.innerHeight - triggerRect.bottom - margin;
+          const availableAbove = triggerRect.top - margin;
+          const openAbove =
+            panelRect.height > availableBelow &&
+            availableAbove > availableBelow;
+          const availableHeight = Math.max(
+            120,
+            openAbove ? availableAbove - gap : availableBelow - gap,
+          );
+          const top = openAbove
+            ? Math.max(
+                margin,
+                triggerRect.top -
+                  Math.min(panelRect.height, availableHeight) -
+                  gap,
+              )
+            : Math.min(triggerRect.bottom + gap, window.innerHeight - margin);
+          menu.style.left = `${left}px`;
+          menu.style.top = `${top}px`;
+          menu.style.maxHeight = `${availableHeight}px`;
+          menu.style.visibility = "visible";
+          menu.dataset.positioned = "true";
+        });
+        publish.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
+          if (event.key !== "Escape" || !publish.open) return;
+          event.preventDefault();
+          publish.open = false;
+          summary.focus();
+        });
+        action.append(document.createTextNode(" "), publish);
+      }
+    }
+    row.append(action);
+    body.append(row);
+  });
+
+  if (!filtered.length) {
+    const messages = {
+      assigned: "No audits are currently assigned to you.",
+      backup: "You are not currently listed as backup on any audits.",
+      developer: "You are not listed as Developer for any audits.",
+      other: "No other audits are available.",
+      all: "No database audits are available.",
+      deleted: "Deleted Items is empty.",
+    };
+    stateHost.textContent = messages[effectiveFilter] || messages.all;
+    stateHost.className = "my-audits-state empty";
+  }
+}

+    const img = document.createElement("img");
+    img.src = resolved.avatar;
+    img.alt = "";
+    img.loading = "lazy";
+    img.referrerPolicy = "no-referrer";
+    img.addEventListener("error", () => img.remove(), { once: true });
+    span.append(img);
+  }
+  return span;

+state.assignmentProfileCache = state.assignmentProfileCache || new Map();
+state.assignmentRecentUsers = state.assignmentRecentUsers || [];

+function atlasUserProfileKey(user) {
+  return String(user?.id || user?.username || "")
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+}
+function atlasCacheAssignmentProfiles(users) {
+  (users || []).forEach((user) => {
+    const key = atlasUserProfileKey(user);
+    if (key) state.assignmentProfileCache.set(key, user);
+  });
+}
+function atlasResolvedAssignmentUser(user) {
+  const byId = String(user?.id || "")
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+  const byUsername = String(user?.username || "")
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+  return (
+    state.assignmentProfileCache.get(byId) ||
+    state.assignmentProfileCache.get(byUsername) ||
+    user
+  );
+}
+function atlasMergeAssignmentUsers(...lists) {
+  const result = [];
+  lists.flat().forEach((user) => {
+    if (!user || result.some((item) => atlasUserMatches(item, user))) return;
+    result.push(user);
+  });
+  return result;
+}
+async function atlasLoadRecentAssignmentUsers(role, query = "") {
+  const search = state.assignmentUserSearch[role];
+  if (!search) return;
+  search.controller?.abort?.();
+  search.controller = new AbortController();
+  search.query = String(query || "").trim();
+  search.loading = true;
+  search.error = "";
+  search.source = "recent";
+  renderAssignmentSearchResults(role);
+  try {
+    const payload = await atlasSearchCachedUsers(search.query, {
+      size: 20,
+      signal: search.controller.signal,
+    });
+    const items = Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [];
+    atlasCacheAssignmentProfiles(items);
+    state.assignmentRecentUsers = items;
+    search.results = items;
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error.name !== "AbortError") search.error = error.message;
+  } finally {
+    search.loading = false;
+    renderAssignmentSearchResults(role);
+  }
+}
+async function atlasSearchAllDirectoryUsers(role) {
+  const search = state.assignmentUserSearch[role];
+  if (!search || search.query.length < 2) {
+    if (search)
+      search.error =
+        "Enter at least 2 characters before searching all Disney users.";
+    renderAssignmentSearchResults(role);
+    return;
+  }
+  search.controller?.abort?.();
+  search.controller = new AbortController();
+  search.loading = true;
+  search.error = "";
+  search.source = "directory";
+  renderAssignmentSearchResults(role);
+  try {
+    const payload = await atlasSearchDirectoryProfiles(search.query, {
+      size: 20,
+      signal: search.controller.signal,
+    });
+    const items = Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [];
+    atlasCacheAssignmentProfiles(items);
+    search.results = atlasMergeAssignmentUsers(search.results, items);
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error.name !== "AbortError") search.error = error.message;
+  } finally {
+    search.loading = false;
+    renderAssignmentSearchResults(role);
+  }
+}
+function atlasAssignedUsersForHydration() {
+  const assignments =
+    normalizeAuditAssignments?.(state.audit?.assignments) || {};
+  return atlasMergeAssignmentUsers(
+    assignments.assigned || [],
+    assignments.backup || [],
+    assignments.developer || [],
+  );
+}
+const atlasProfileHydrationInFlight = new Map();
+async function atlasHydrateAssignedUserProfiles() {
+  const auditId = state.audit?.id || "";
+  const users = atlasAssignedUsersForHydration().filter(
+    (user) => !state.assignmentProfileCache.has(atlasUserProfileKey(user)),
+  );
+  if (!users.length) return [];
+  const key = users.map(atlasUserProfileKey).filter(Boolean).sort().join("|");
+  if (atlasProfileHydrationInFlight.has(key))
+    return atlasProfileHydrationInFlight.get(key);
+  const request = atlasMeasure?.("atlas.profile.hydrate", async () => {
+    try {
+      const payload = await atlasResolveUserProfiles(users);
+      const items = Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [];
+      atlasCacheAssignmentProfiles(items);
+      if (state.audit?.id === auditId) {
+        renderAssignmentEditor();
+        if (atlasActivePage?.() === "my-audits") renderMyAudits();
+      }
+      return items;
+    } catch (_error) {
+      return [];
+    } finally {
+      atlasProfileHydrationInFlight.delete(key);
+    }
+  });
+  atlasProfileHydrationInFlight.set(key, request);
+  return request;
+}
+const ATLAS_ASSIGNMENT_PICKER_LABELS = Object.freeze({
+  assigned: "Assigned Analyst",
+  backup: "Backup Analyst",
+  developer: "Developer",
+});
+let atlasAssignmentPickerRequest = 0;
+let atlasAssignmentPickerTimer = null;
+function atlasAssignmentPickerEntries(role, users) {
+  const selected = atlasEnsureAuditAssignments()[role] || [];
+  return atlasMergeAssignmentUsers(users).map((user) => {
+    const resolved = atlasResolvedAssignmentUser(user);
+    const already = selected.some((value) => atlasUserMatches(value, resolved));
+    return {
+      key: atlasUserProfileKey(resolved),
+      label: atlasDisplayUser(resolved),
+      rawName: resolved.username || atlasDisplayUser(resolved),
+      detail:
+        resolved.username && resolved.username !== atlasDisplayUser(resolved)
+          ? resolved.username
+          : "",
+      sourceKey: "atlas-users",
+      sourceLabel: "ATLAS Users",
+      sourceColor: "#4d6fa9",
+      avatar: resolved.avatar || "",
+      initials: atlasUserInitials(resolved),
+      disabled: already || resolved.disabled === true,
+      badge: already
+        ? "Assigned"
+        : resolved.disabled === true
+          ? "Unavailable"
+          : "",
+      user: resolved,
+    };
+  });
+}
+function atlasAssignmentPickerIsCurrent(context) {
+  return Boolean(
+    context &&
+    state.audit?.id === context.auditId &&
+    state.activeAuditValue === context.activeAuditValue,
+  );
+}
+async function atlasRefreshAssignmentPicker(
+  context,
+  query = "",
+  directory = false,
+) {
+  if (
+    !atlasAssignmentPickerIsCurrent(context) ||
+    !window.ATLASVisualPicker?.isOpen?.()
+  )
+    return false;
+  const request = ++atlasAssignmentPickerRequest;
+  context.controller?.abort?.();
+  context.controller = new AbortController();
+  const text = String(query || "").trim();
+  if (directory && text.length < 2) {
+    window.ATLASVisualPicker.setMessage(
+      "Enter at least 2 characters before searching all Disney users.",
+      "error",
+    );
+    return false;
+  }
+  window.ATLASVisualPicker.setEntries([], {
+    message: directory
+      ? "Searching the Disney directory…"
+      : "Loading recent ATLAS users…",
+  });
+  try {
+    const payload = await (directory
+      ? atlasSearchDirectoryProfiles(text, {
+          size: 20,
+          signal: context.controller.signal,
+        })
+      : atlasSearchCachedUsers(text, {
+          size: 20,
+          signal: context.controller.signal,
+        }));
+    if (
+      request !== atlasAssignmentPickerRequest ||
+      !atlasAssignmentPickerIsCurrent(context)
+    )
+      return false;
+    const items = Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [];
+    atlasCacheAssignmentProfiles(items);
+    context.users = directory
+      ? atlasMergeAssignmentUsers(context.users, items)
+      : items;
+    window.ATLASVisualPicker.setEntries(
+      atlasAssignmentPickerEntries(context.role, context.users),
+      {
+        emptyMessage: directory
+          ? "No matching Disney users were found."
+          : "No matching recent ATLAS users were found.",
+      },
+    );
+    return true;
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (error.name === "AbortError") return false;
+    console.error("ATLAS Assignment Picker: user search failed safely.", {
+      directory,
+      message: error.message,
+    });
+    if (request === atlasAssignmentPickerRequest)
+      window.ATLASVisualPicker.setEntries([], {
+        message: directory
+          ? "The Disney directory is unavailable. Try again."
+          : "Recent ATLAS users could not be loaded. Try again.",
+        kind: "error",
+      });
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+function atlasOpenAssignmentPicker(role, options = {}) {
+  const validRole = atlasAssignmentRole(role);
+  const picker = window.ATLASVisualPicker;
+  if (!validRole || !picker?.open) return false;
+  const context = {
+    role: validRole,
+    auditId: state.audit?.id || "",
+    activeAuditValue: state.activeAuditValue || "",
+    users: [],
+    controller: null,
+  };
+  const label = ATLAS_ASSIGNMENT_PICKER_LABELS[validRole];
+  const opened = picker.open({
+    mode: "user",
+    title: `Add ${label}`,
+    guidance: "Choose a recent ATLAS user or search the full Disney directory.",
+    searchPlaceholder: "Search recent ATLAS users",
+    entries: [],
+    sort: "alpha",
+    actionLabel: "Search all Disney users",
+    actionTitle: "Search the full Disney directory",
+    closeOnSelect: false,
+    emptyMessage: "Loading recent ATLAS users…",
+    onQueryChange(query) {
+      clearTimeout(atlasAssignmentPickerTimer);
+      atlasAssignmentPickerTimer = setTimeout(
+        () => atlasRefreshAssignmentPicker(context, query, false),
+        180,
+      );
+    },
+    onAction(query) {
+      atlasRefreshAssignmentPicker(context, query, true);
+    },
+    onSelect(entry) {
+      if (
+        !atlasAssignmentPickerIsCurrent(context) ||
+        options.validateSelection?.() === false
+      ) {
+        picker.close("stale");
+        globalThis.ATLASAuditIssues?.invalidate?.();
+        status?.(
+          "The audit or issue changed. Reopen the assignment picker and try again.",
+          "warn",
+        );
+        return;
+      }
+      const user = entry?.user || entry;
+      if (!atlasAddAuditAssignment(validRole, user)) {
+        picker.setMessage(
+          "That user is already assigned to this role or is unavailable.",
+          "error",
+        );
+        return;
+      }
+      options.onAssigned?.(user, validRole);
+      picker.close("select");
+    },
+    onClose() {
+      clearTimeout(atlasAssignmentPickerTimer);
+      context.controller?.abort?.();
+    },
+  });
+  if (opened) atlasRefreshAssignmentPicker(context, "", false);
+  return opened;
+}

+/** Durable database audit persistence. IndexedDB remains local crash recovery only. */
+async function atlasAuditApi(path, options = {}) {
+  const response = await fetch(path, {
+    cache: "no-store",
+    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", ...(options.headers || {}) },
+    ...options,
+  });
+  let payload = null;
+  try {
+    payload = await response.json();
+  } catch (_error) {}
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    const error = new Error(
+      payload?.error || `Request failed with status ${response.status}.`,
+    );
+    error.status = response.status;
+    error.currentRevisionId = payload?.currentRevisionId;
+    throw error;
+  }
+  return payload;
+}
+function atlasApplyLoadedAudit(payload, source = "database", options = {}) {
+  state.audit = normalizeLoadedAudit(payload.audit, source);
+  state.selectedStepId = state.audit.steps?.[0]?.id || null;
+  state.activeAuditValue = `database:${state.audit.id}`;
+  state.auditPersistence = {
+    auditId: state.audit.id,
+    revisionId: payload.revision?.id || null,
+    revisionNumber: payload.revision?.number || 0,
+    access: payload.access || null,
+    saving: false,
+    conflict: null,
+  };
+  markAuditSelected();
+  atlasInvalidateSourceDerivedState?.();
+  globalThis.ATLASAuditIssues?.invalidate?.();
+  atlasMarkAllPagesDirty?.();
+  const targetPage = options.targetPage || atlasActivePage?.() || "overview";
+  showSection(targetPage);
+  updateActiveAuditBaseline();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  atlasResetDatabaseWriteState?.(state.audit.id, { acknowledged: true });
+}
+async function atlasLoadCurrentUser(options = {}) {
+  const { render = true } = options;
+  state.currentUserStatus = "loading";
+  state.currentUserError = "";
+  if (render) {
+    renderCurrentUserProfile?.();
+    renderMyAudits?.();
+  }
+  try {
+    state.currentUser = await atlasAuditApi("/api/me");
+    state.currentUserStatus = "ready";
+    await atlasAuditApi("/api/user-profiles/me", {
+      method: "POST",
+      body: "{}",
+    });
+  } catch (error) {
+    state.currentUser = null;
+    state.currentUserStatus = "error";
+    state.currentUserError = error.message;
+  }
+  if (render) {
+    renderCurrentUserProfile?.();
+    renderMyAudits?.();
+  }
+  return state.currentUser;
+}
+async function atlasSearchUsers(query, options = {}) {
+  const q = String(query || "").trim();
+  if (q.length < 2) return { items: [] };
+  return atlasAuditApi(
+    `/api/users?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&page=${options.page || 1}&size=${Math.min(25, options.size || 10)}`,
+    { signal: options.signal },
+  );
+}
+function atlasSetAuditLibraryLoading(loading) {
+  const spinner = document.querySelector("[data-audit-loading-spinner]");
+  if (spinner) spinner.hidden = !loading;
+}
+function atlasSetAuditLibraryStatus(message) {
+  const text = document.querySelector("[data-audit-library-status-text]");
+  if (text) text.textContent = message;
+}
+async function atlasRefreshDatabaseAudits(options = {}) {
+  const { render = true } = options;
+  state.databaseAuditsStatus = "loading";
+  state.databaseAuditsError = "";
+  if (render) renderMyAudits?.();
+  atlasSetAuditLibraryLoading(true);
+  atlasSetAuditLibraryStatus("Database audit library has not loaded yet.");
+  try {
+    const payload = await atlasAuditApi("/api/audits");
+    state.databaseAudits = Array.isArray(payload.audits) ? payload.audits : [];
+    state.databaseAuditsStatus = "ready";
+    if (render) renderMyAudits?.();
+    atlasSetAuditLibraryStatus(
+      `Loaded ${state.databaseAudits.length} database audit(s).`,
+    );
+    return state.databaseAudits;
+  } catch (error) {
+    state.databaseAuditsStatus = "error";
+    state.databaseAuditsError = error.message;
+    if (render) renderMyAudits?.();
+    atlasSetAuditLibraryStatus(
+      "The database audit library could not be loaded.",
+    );
+    throw error;
+  } finally {
+    atlasSetAuditLibraryLoading(false);
+  }
+}
+let atlasAuditLoadSequence = 0;
+async function atlasLoadDatabaseAudit(id) {
+  const sequence = ++atlasAuditLoadSequence;
+  return atlasMeasure?.("atlas.audit.load", async () => {
+    const payload = await atlasAuditApi(
+      `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
+    );
+    if (sequence !== atlasAuditLoadSequence) return null;
+    atlasApplyLoadedAudit(payload, "database", { targetPage: "overview" });
+    scheduleAutosave({ database: false });
+    return payload;
+  });
+}
+const ATLAS_DATABASE_WRITE_DELAY_MS = 2500;
+const ATLAS_DATABASE_MAX_DIRTY_MS = 20000;
+const atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator = {
+  auditId: "",
+  editGeneration: 0,
+  acknowledgedGeneration: 0,
+  dirtySince: 0,
+  trailingTimer: null,
+  maximumTimer: null,
+  inFlight: null,
+  conflict: false,
+  error: null,
+  pendingReason: "",
+};
+function atlasClearDatabaseWriteTimers() {
+  clearTimeout(atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.trailingTimer);
+  clearTimeout(atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.maximumTimer);
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.trailingTimer = null;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.maximumTimer = null;
+}
+function atlasResetDatabaseWriteState(
+  auditId = state.audit?.id || "",
+  options = {},
+) {
+  atlasClearDatabaseWriteTimers();
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.auditId = auditId;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration = 0;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration = options.acknowledged
+    ? 0
+    : -1;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.dirtySince = 0;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.inFlight = null;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.conflict = false;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.error = null;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.pendingReason = "";
+}
+function atlasDatabaseWriteMatchesActiveAudit() {
+  return (
+    !!state.audit?.id &&
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.auditId === state.audit.id
+  );
+}
+function atlasHasPendingDatabaseWrite() {
+  return (
+    atlasDatabaseWriteMatchesActiveAudit() &&
+    (atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.inFlight ||
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration >
+        atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration)
+  );
+}
+function atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(message) {
+  if (e.saveStatus) e.saveStatus.textContent = message;
+}
+function atlasPatchDatabaseAuditListEntry(payload, snapshot) {
+  const audit = payload?.audit || snapshot;
+  if (!audit?.id) return;
+  const current = (state.databaseAudits || []).find(
+    (item) => item.id === audit.id,
+  );
+  const entry = {
+    ...(current || {}),
+    id: audit.id,
+    name: audit.name,
+    purpose: audit.purpose || "",
+    status: String(audit.status || "").trim() || "Draft",
+    assignments: audit.assignments || current?.assignments,
+    currentRevisionId:
+      payload?.revision?.id || current?.currentRevisionId || null,
+    currentRevisionNumber:
+      payload?.revision?.number || current?.currentRevisionNumber || 0,
+    updatedAt:
+      payload?.revision?.createdAt ||
+      current?.updatedAt ||
+      new Date().toISOString(),
+    updatedByUsername:
+      payload?.revision?.createdByUsername || current?.updatedByUsername || "",
+  };
+  if (current) Object.assign(current, entry);
+  else state.databaseAudits.push(entry);
+  renderMyAudits?.();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  updateDashboardMetrics?.();
+}
+function atlasApplyAuditSaveMetadata(payload, snapshot, sentGeneration) {
+  if (!payload?.revision?.id)
+    throw new Error(
+      "The database save response did not include revision metadata.",
+    );
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration = Math.max(
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration,
+    sentGeneration,
+  );
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.error = null;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.conflict = false;
+  atlasPatchDatabaseAuditListEntry(payload, snapshot);
+  if (state.audit?.id !== snapshot.id) return;
+  state.auditPersistence.auditId = snapshot.id;
+  state.auditPersistence.revisionId = payload.revision.id;
+  state.auditPersistence.revisionNumber = payload.revision.number || 0;
+  state.auditPersistence.access =
+    payload.access || state.auditPersistence.access || null;
+  state.auditPersistence.conflict = null;
+  state.activeAuditValue = `database:${snapshot.id}`;
+  state.activeAuditBaseline = JSON.stringify(snapshot);
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  updateDashboardMetrics?.();
+}
+function atlasMarkDatabaseDirty(reason = "edit") {
+  if (
+    !hasSelectedAudit?.() ||
+    !state.audit?.id ||
+    state.autosavePaused ||
+    $("deleteAuditBtn")?.matches('[aria-busy="true"]')
+  )
+    return;
+  if (!atlasDatabaseWriteMatchesActiveAudit())
+    atlasResetDatabaseWriteState(state.audit.id);
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration += 1;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.pendingReason = reason;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.error = null;
+  if (!atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.dirtySince)
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.dirtySince = Date.now();
+  const needsCreate =
+    !state.auditPersistence?.revisionId ||
+    state.auditPersistence.auditId !== state.audit.id;
+  if (needsCreate) {
+    queueMicrotask(() =>
+      atlasFlushDatabaseWrite("Created audit").catch((error) =>
+        status?.(`Database create failed: ${error.message}`, "bad"),
+      ),
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+  atlasScheduleDatabaseWrite(reason);
+}
+function atlasScheduleDatabaseWrite(reason = "edit") {
+  if (
+    !atlasDatabaseWriteMatchesActiveAudit() ||
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.conflict
+  )
+    return;
+  clearTimeout(atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.trailingTimer);
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.trailingTimer = setTimeout(
+    () =>
+      atlasFlushDatabaseWrite(`Autosaved after ${reason}`).catch((error) =>
+        status?.(`Database save failed: ${error.message}`, "bad"),
+      ),
+    ATLAS_DATABASE_WRITE_DELAY_MS,
+  );
+  if (!atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.maximumTimer) {
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.maximumTimer = setTimeout(
+      () =>
+        atlasFlushDatabaseWrite("Maximum dirty interval").catch((error) =>
+          status?.(`Database save failed: ${error.message}`, "bad"),
+        ),
+      ATLAS_DATABASE_MAX_DIRTY_MS,
+    );
+  }
+  atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus("Changes pending database save.");
+}
+async function atlasPerformDatabaseWrite(changeSummary) {
+  capture?.();
+  const auditId = state.audit.id;
+  const snapshot = structuredClone(state.audit);
+  const sentGeneration = atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration;
+  const exists =
+    state.auditPersistence.auditId === auditId &&
+    !!state.auditPersistence.revisionId;
+  const expectedRevisionId = exists ? state.auditPersistence.revisionId : null;
+  state.auditPersistence.saving = true;
+  atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(
+    exists ? "Saving to database…" : "Creating database audit…",
+  );
+  try {
+    const payload = await atlasAuditApi(
+      exists ? `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}` : "/api/audits",
+      {
+        method: exists ? "PUT" : "POST",
+        body: JSON.stringify({
+          audit: snapshot,
+          expectedRevisionId,
+          changeSummary: changeSummary || null,
+        }),
+      },
+    );
+    atlasApplyAuditSaveMetadata(payload, snapshot, sentGeneration);
+    atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(
+      `Saved to database as revision ${payload.revision.number}.`,
+    );
+    status?.(
+      `Saved ${snapshot.name} as revision ${payload.revision.number}.`,
+      "ok",
+    );
+    return true;
+  } catch (error) {
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.error = error;
+    if (error.status === 409) {
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.conflict = true;
+      state.auditPersistence.conflict = {
+        currentRevisionId: error.currentRevisionId,
+      };
+      atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(
+        "Database save conflict. Review the conflict before retrying.",
+      );
+      atlasOpenConflictDialog?.(error);
+      return false;
+    }
+    atlasSetDatabaseSaveStatus(`Database save failed: ${error.message}`);
+    throw error;
+  } finally {
+    if (state.audit?.id === auditId) state.auditPersistence.saving = false;
+  }
+}
+async function atlasFlushDatabaseWrite(reason = "explicit save") {
+  if (!hasSelectedAudit?.() || !state.audit?.id) return true;
+  if (!atlasDatabaseWriteMatchesActiveAudit())
+    atlasResetDatabaseWriteState(state.audit.id);
+  atlasClearDatabaseWriteTimers();
+  if (atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.conflict) return false;
+  if (atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.inFlight) {
+    await atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.inFlight;
+    if (atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.conflict) return false;
+    if (
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration <=
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration
+    )
+      return true;
+  }
+  const needsCreate =
+    !state.auditPersistence?.revisionId ||
+    state.auditPersistence.auditId !== state.audit.id;
+  if (
+    !needsCreate &&
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration <=
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration &&
+    !auditHasUnsavedChanges()
+  )
+    return true;
+  const write = atlasPerformDatabaseWrite(reason);
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.inFlight = write;
+  let result;
+  try {
+    result = await write;
+  } finally {
+    if (atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.inFlight === write)
+      atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.inFlight = null;
+  }
+  if (!result) return false;
+  if (
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration >
+    atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.acknowledgedGeneration
+  ) {
+    return atlasFlushDatabaseWrite("Saved edits made during database write");
+  }
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.dirtySince = 0;
+  return true;
+}
+async function atlasCreateCurrentAudit(reason = "Created audit") {
+  if (!state.audit?.id) return false;
+  atlasResetDatabaseWriteState(state.audit.id);
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.editGeneration = 1;
+  atlasDatabaseWriteCoordinator.dirtySince = Date.now();
+  return atlasFlushDatabaseWrite(reason);
+}
+async function atlasSaveCurrentAudit(changeSummary = "") {
+  return atlasFlushDatabaseWrite(changeSummary || "Explicit save");
+}
+function atlasIsDatabaseAuditDirty() {
+  if (!hasSelectedAudit?.() || !state.audit?.id) return false;
+  const needsCreate =
+    !state.auditPersistence?.revisionId ||
+    state.auditPersistence.auditId !== state.audit.id;
+  return (
+    needsCreate || atlasHasPendingDatabaseWrite() || auditHasUnsavedChanges()
+  );
+}
+async function atlasSaveIfDirty(reason = "navigation") {
+  if (!atlasIsDatabaseAuditDirty()) return true;
+  return atlasFlushDatabaseWrite(`Saved on ${reason}`);
+}
+async function atlasNavigateToSection(section) {
+  const target = pageForSection(section);
+  const current = document.querySelector(".page.active")?.dataset.page || "";
+  if (target === current) return;
+  showSection(target);
+  if (atlasIsDatabaseAuditDirty())
+    atlasScheduleDatabaseWrite("page navigation");
+}
+function atlasSaveOnPageHide() {
+  if (
+    $("deleteAuditBtn")?.matches('[aria-busy="true"]') ||
+    !atlasIsDatabaseAuditDirty() ||
+    !state.auditPersistence?.revisionId
+  )
+    return;
+  capture?.();
+  const auditId = state.auditPersistence.auditId;
+  const body = JSON.stringify({
+    audit: structuredClone(state.audit),
+    expectedRevisionId: state.auditPersistence.revisionId,
+    changeSummary: "Saved on window close",
+  });
+  fetch(`/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}`, {
+    method: "PUT",
+    credentials: "same-origin",
+    keepalive: true,
+    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
+    body,
+  }).catch(() => {});
+}

+function atlasAuditDocumentsFromJson(json) {
+  const candidates = Array.isArray(json?.flows)
+    ? json.flows
+    : Array.isArray(json?.audits)
+      ? json.audits
+      : Array.isArray(json)
+        ? json
+        : [json];
+  return candidates
+    .map((item) => item?.audit || item)
+    .filter((item) => item && typeof item === "object" && !Array.isArray(item));
+}
+async function atlasImportAuditDocuments(
+  documents,
+  summary = "Imported JSON audit",
+) {
+  const flushed = await atlasSaveIfDirty("audit import");
+  if (!flushed)
+    throw new Error("Resolve the current audit save before importing.");
+  const normalized = documents.map((document) =>
+    normalizeLoadedAudit(document, "database-import"),
+  );
+  const payload = await atlasAuditApi("/api/audits/import", {
+    method: "POST",
+    body: JSON.stringify({ audits: normalized, changeSummary: summary }),
+  });
+  await atlasRefreshDatabaseAudits();
+  await refreshSaved?.();
+  renderAuditLibrarySelect?.();
+  renderActiveAuditSelect?.();
+  updateDashboardMetrics?.();
+  return payload;
+}
+async function atlasImportAuditDocument(
+  document,
+  summary = "Imported JSON audit",
+) {
+  return atlasImportAuditDocuments([document], summary);
+}
+async function atlasImportAuditJsonFile(file) {
+  const json = JSON.parse(await file.text());
+  const documents = atlasAuditDocumentsFromJson(json);
+  if (!documents.length)
+    throw new Error(
+      "The selected JSON file does not contain an audit or saved audit bundle.",
+    );
+  const result = await atlasImportAuditDocuments(
+    documents,
+    `Imported from ${file.name}`,
+  );
+  const summary = $("auditImportSummary");
+  const imported = result.imported?.length || 0;
+  const skipped = result.skipped?.length || 0;
+  const failed = result.failed?.length || 0;
+  if (summary)
+    summary.textContent = `Import complete: ${imported} imported, ${skipped} unchanged, ${failed} failed.`;
+  if (failed)
+    status(
+      `Imported ${imported} audit(s); ${failed} failed. Review the import summary.`,
+      "warn",
+    );
+  else status(`Imported ${imported} audit(s) into the database.`, "ok");
+  return result;
+}
+async function atlasArchiveCurrentAudit() {
+  const archiveButton = $("deleteAuditBtn");
+  if (archiveButton?.matches('[aria-busy="true"]')) return false;
+  if (
+    !hasSelectedAudit?.() ||
+    !state.auditPersistence?.revisionId ||
+    state.auditPersistence.auditId !== state.audit?.id
+  )
+    throw new Error("Select a saved database audit before deleting it.");
+  if (!state.auditPersistence.access?.canArchive)
+    throw new Error("You do not have permission to delete this audit.");
+  if (
+    !confirm(
+      `Delete ${state.audit.name}? This audit will move to Recently Deleted and can be restored by an authorized administrator.`,
+    )
+  )
+    return false;
+
+  const auditId = state.audit.id;
+  const auditName = state.audit.name;
+  const previousAutosavePaused = state.autosavePaused;
+  let archived = false;
+  if (archiveButton) {
+    archiveButton.disabled = true;
+    archiveButton.setAttribute("aria-busy", "true");
+    archiveButton.textContent = "Deleting audit...";
+  }
+  state.autosavePaused = true;
+  clearTimeout(autosaveTimer);
+  atlasAuditLoadSequence += 1;
+  try {
+    const flushed = await atlasSaveIfDirty("archive");
+    if (!flushed)
+      throw new Error(
+        "Resolve the current database save conflict before deleting this audit.",
+      );
+    if (state.audit?.id !== auditId)
+      throw new Error(
+        "The active audit changed before deletion could complete.",
+      );
+
+    atlasClearDatabaseWriteTimers();
+    await atlasAuditApi(`/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}`, {
+      method: "DELETE",
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        expectedRevisionId: state.auditPersistence.revisionId,
+      }),
+    });
+    archived = true;
+    atlasAutosaveDirty = false;
+    atlasAutosaveSavedRevision = atlasAutosaveRevision;
+    await dbDelete(ATLAS_AUTOSAVE_ID);
+    await atlasRefreshDatabaseAudits({ render: false });
+    state.audit = defaultAudit();
+    state.auditPersistence = {
+      auditId: null,
+      revisionId: null,
+      revisionNumber: 0,
+      access: null,
+      saving: false,
+      conflict: null,
+    };
+    state.activeAuditValue = "";
+    state.pendingActiveAuditValue = "";
+    clearAuditSelection();
+    atlasResetDatabaseWriteState("");
+    atlasMarkAllPagesDirty?.();
+    showSection("my-audits");
+    renderAll();
+    status(`${auditName} was moved to Recently Deleted.`, "ok");
+    return true;
+  } finally {
+    state.autosavePaused = previousAutosavePaused;
+    if (archiveButton) {
+      archiveButton.removeAttribute("aria-busy");
+      archiveButton.textContent = "Delete Audit";
+      archiveButton.disabled = false;
+    }
+    if (!archived && hasSelectedAudit?.()) scheduleAutosave();
+  }
+}
+async function atlasInitAuditDatabase(options = {}) {
+  await atlasRefreshDatabaseAudits(options);
+}

+// Minimal profile-cache API. Avatar refreshes remain presentation state and do not save audits.
+async function atlasSearchCachedUsers(query = "", options = {}) {
+  const q = String(query || "").trim();
+  return atlasAuditApi(
+    `/api/user-profiles?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&size=${Math.min(25, options.size || 20)}`,
+    { signal: options.signal },
+  );
+}
+async function atlasSearchDirectoryProfiles(query, options = {}) {
+  const q = String(query || "").trim();
+  if (q.length < 2) return { items: [] };
+  return atlasAuditApi(
+    `/api/user-profiles/directory?q=${encodeURIComponent(q)}&page=${options.page || 1}&size=${Math.min(25, options.size || 10)}`,
+    { signal: options.signal },
+  );
+}
+async function atlasResolveUserProfiles(users, options = {}) {
+  const identities = (users || [])
+    .map((user) => ({
+      id: String(user?.id || "").trim(),
+      username: String(user?.username || "").trim(),
+    }))
+    .filter((user) => user.id || user.username);
+  return atlasAuditApi("/api/user-profiles/resolve", {
+    method: "POST",
+    body: JSON.stringify({ users: identities }),
+    signal: options.signal,
+  });
+}
+const atlasProfileHydrationApplyBase = atlasApplyLoadedAudit;
+atlasApplyLoadedAudit = function atlasApplyLoadedAuditWithProfileHydration(
+  payload,
+  source = "database",
+  options = {},
+) {
+  const result = atlasProfileHydrationApplyBase(payload, source, options);
+  queueMicrotask(() => atlasHydrateAssignedUserProfiles?.());
+  return result;
+};

+async function atlasRefreshDeletedAudits() {
+  if (!state.currentUser?.access?.canManageDeletedAudits) return [];
+  state.deletedAuditsStatus = "loading";
+  renderMyAudits();
+  try {
+    const p = await atlasAuditApi("/api/admin/audits/deleted");
+    state.deletedAudits = Array.isArray(p.audits) ? p.audits : [];
+    state.deletedAuditsStatus = "ready";
+    state.deletedAuditsError = "";
+    renderMyAudits();
+    return state.deletedAudits;
+  } catch (e) {
+    state.deletedAuditsStatus = "error";
+    state.deletedAuditsError = e.message;
+    renderMyAudits();
+    throw e;
+  }
+}
+async function atlasRestoreDeletedAudit(id) {
+  const a = (state.deletedAudits || []).find((x) => x.id === id);
+  if (!a || !confirm(`Restore "${a.name}" to the active Audit Library?`))
+    return;
+  await atlasAuditApi(`/api/admin/audits/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/restore`, {
+    method: "POST",
+  });
+  await Promise.all([
+    atlasRefreshDeletedAudits(),
+    atlasRefreshDatabaseAudits(),
+  ]);
+  status("Audit restored.", "ok");
+}
+async function atlasPermanentlyDeleteAudit(id) {
+  const a = (state.deletedAudits || []).find((x) => x.id === id);
+  if (!a || !confirm(`Permanently delete "${a.name}"? This cannot be undone.`))
+    return;
+  await atlasAuditApi(`/api/admin/audits/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`, {
+    method: "DELETE",
+  });
+  await atlasRefreshDeletedAudits();
+  status("Audit permanently deleted.", "ok");
+}

+/** Phase 6 unified detached read-only history browser. Classic script. */
+const historyView = {
+  active: false,
+  auditId: null,
+  kind: null,
+  revisionId: null,
+  publicationId: null,
+  publicationVersion: null,
+  document: null,
+  metadata: null,
+  returnPage: "overview",
+  revisions: [],
+  activity: [],
+  publications: [],
+  activityCursor: null,
+  activityComplete: false,
+  requestGeneration: 0,
+};
+function atlasHistoryAuditId() {
+  return state?.auditPersistence?.auditId || state?.audit?.id || null;
+}
+function atlasHistoryClone(v) {
+  return v == null ? null : JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(v));
+}
+function atlasHistoryPage() {
+  return document.querySelector(".page.active")?.dataset.page || "overview";
+}
+function atlasHistoryEventLabel(t) {
+  return (
+    {
+      "approval.submission_requested": "Submitted for approval",
+      "approval.request_approved": "Approval granted",
+      "approval.request_denied": "Approval denied",
+      "approval.request_invalidated": "Approval request invalidated",
+      "approval.invalidated_by_restoration":
+        "Approval invalidated by restoration",
+      "workflow.approved_content_edited": "Approved content edited",
+      "workflow.submitted_content_edited": "Submitted content edited",
+      "audit.restored": "Audit restored",
+      "step.restored": "Step restored",
+      "audit.published": "Publication created",
+      "audit.published_unlocked": "Published audit unlocked",
+      "publication.sent_to_recently_deleted":
+        "Publication sent to Recently Deleted",
+    }[t] || String(t || "Activity event").replace(/[._]/g, " ")
+  );
+}
+function atlasHistoryTime(x) {
+  return x.eventAt || x.createdAt || x.publishedAt || x.deletedAt || "";
+}
+function atlasHistoryTimeline() {
+  const events = historyView.activity.map((x) => ({
+      ...x,
+      kind: "activity",
+      title: atlasHistoryEventLabel(x.eventType),
+      sortId: Number(x.id) || 0,
+    })),
+    rids = new Set(),
+    pids = new Set();
+  events.forEach((x) => {
+    if (x.sourceRevisionId) rids.add(Number(x.sourceRevisionId));
+    if (x.resultingRevisionId) rids.add(Number(x.resultingRevisionId));
+    if (x.publicationId) pids.add(Number(x.publicationId));
+  });
+  const revisions = historyView.revisions
+    .filter((x) => !rids.has(Number(x.id)))
+    .map((x) => ({
+      ...x,
+      kind: "revision",
+      title:
+        Number(x.number) === 1
+          ? "Audit created"
+          : `Working revision ${x.number}`,
+      sortId: Number(x.id) || 0,
+    }));
+  const publications = historyView.publications
+    .filter((x) => !pids.has(Number(x.id)))
+    .map((x) => ({
+      ...x,
+      kind: "publication",
+      title: `Publication v${x.versionNumber}`,
+      sortId: Number(x.id) || 0,
+    }));
+  const current = {
+    kind: "current",
+    id: "current",
+    title: window.ATLASWorkflow?.isPublishedLocked?.()
+      ? "Current locked state"
+      : "Current working state",
+    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
+    sortId: Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,
+  };
+  return [...events, ...revisions, ...publications, current].sort(
+    (a, b) =>
+      (Date.parse(atlasHistoryTime(b)) || 0) -
+        (Date.parse(atlasHistoryTime(a)) || 0) ||
+      b.sortId - a.sortId ||
+      `${a.kind}:${a.id}`.localeCompare(`${b.kind}:${b.id}`),
+  );
+}
+function atlasHistoryRenderTimeline() {
+  const h = document.getElementById("atlasHistoryTimeline");
+  if (!h) return;
+  h.innerHTML =
+    atlasHistoryTimeline()
+      .map(
+        (x) =>
+          `<button class="history-entry" type="button" role="listitem" data-history-kind="${esc(x.kind)}" data-history-id="${esc(x.id)}" ${x.kind === "current" ? 'aria-current="true"' : ""}><span class="history-entry-title">${esc(x.title)}</span><span class="history-entry-meta">${esc(x.actorUsername || x.createdByFullName || x.createdByUsername || x.publisherUsername || "")} ${atlasHistoryTime(x) ? `· ${esc(new Date(atlasHistoryTime(x)).toLocaleString())}` : ""}</span></button>`,
+      )
+      .join("") || '<p class="hint">No history records are available.</p>';
+  document.getElementById("atlasHistoryMore").hidden =
+    historyView.activityComplete;
+}
+function atlasHistoryRenderSelectors() {
+  const r = document.getElementById("atlasRevisionSelector"),
+    p = document.getElementById("atlasPublicationSelector");
+  if (r) {
+    r.innerHTML =
+      '<option value="">Select revision</option>' +
+      historyView.revisions
+        .slice()
+        .sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number)
+        .map(
+          (x) =>
+            `<option value="${x.id}">Revision ${esc(x.number)} · ${esc(x.changeType || "")}</option>`,
+        )
+        .join("");
+    r.value =
+      historyView.kind === "revision"
+        ? String(historyView.revisionId || "")
+        : "";
+  }
+  if (p) {
+    p.innerHTML =
+      '<option value="">Select publication</option>' +
+      historyView.publications
+        .slice()
+        .sort((a, b) => a.versionNumber - b.versionNumber)
+        .map(
+          (x) =>
+            `<option value="${x.versionNumber}">v${esc(x.versionNumber)} · ${esc(x.versionTitle || "")}</option>`,
+        )
+        .join("");
+    p.value =
+      historyView.kind === "publication"
+        ? String(historyView.publicationVersion || "")
+        : "";
+  }
+  atlasHistoryUpdateNavigation();
+}
+function atlasHistoryUpdateNavigation() {
+  const pubs = historyView.kind === "publication",
+    list = pubs
+      ? historyView.publications
+          .slice()
+          .sort((a, b) => a.versionNumber - b.versionNumber)
+      : historyView.revisions.slice().sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number),
+    id = pubs ? historyView.publicationId : historyView.revisionId,
+    i = list.findIndex((x) => Number(x.id) === Number(id));
+  for (const [n, d] of [
+    ["atlasRevisionPrevious", pubs || i <= 0],
+    ["atlasRevisionNext", pubs || i < 0 || i >= list.length - 1],
+    ["atlasPublicationPrevious", !pubs || i <= 0],
+    ["atlasPublicationNext", !pubs || i < 0 || i >= list.length - 1],
+  ]) {
+    const e = document.getElementById(n);
+    if (e) e.disabled = d;
+  }
+  document.getElementById("atlasHistoryCompare").disabled =
+    !historyView.document;
+  const restore = document.getElementById("atlasHistoryRestore");
+  restore.hidden =
+    historyView.kind !== "revision" ||
+    !window.ATLASWorkflow?.can?.("canRestoreAudit");
+}
+function atlasHistoryRenderDocument() {
+  document.getElementById("atlasHistoryDocument").textContent =
+    historyView.document
+      ? JSON.stringify(historyView.document, null, 2)
+      : "Select a timeline entry, revision, or publication.";
+  const m = historyView.metadata || {};
+  document.getElementById("atlasHistoryMetadata").innerHTML = Object.entries(m)
+    .filter(([, v]) => v != null && typeof v !== "object")
+    .slice(0, 10)
+    .map(
+      ([k, v]) =>
+        `<div><span class="hint">${esc(k.replace(/([A-Z])/g, " $1"))}</span><div class="workflow-value">${esc(v)}</div></div>`,
+    )
+    .join("");
+  document.getElementById("atlasHistoryViewerHeading")?.focus();
+  atlasHistoryUpdateNavigation();
+  atlasHistoryRenderTimeline();
+}
+async function atlasHistorySelectRevision(id) {
+  const auditId = historyView.auditId,
+    g = ++historyView.requestGeneration,
+    r = await atlasAuditApi(
+      `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}/revisions/${encodeURIComponent(id)}`,
+    );
+  if (
+    !historyView.active ||
+    g !== historyView.requestGeneration ||
+    auditId !== historyView.auditId
+  )
+    return;
+  historyView.kind = "revision";
+  historyView.revisionId = Number(id);
+  historyView.publicationId = null;
+  historyView.publicationVersion = null;
+  historyView.document = atlasHistoryClone(r.document);
+  historyView.metadata = {
+    number: r.number,
+    changeType: r.changeType,
+    changeSummary: r.changeSummary,
+    createdByUsername: r.createdByUsername,
+    createdAt: r.createdAt,
+  };
+  atlasHistoryRenderSelectors();
+  atlasHistoryRenderDocument();
+}
+async function atlasHistorySelectPublication(version) {
+  const auditId = historyView.auditId,
+    g = ++historyView.requestGeneration,
+    p = await atlasAuditApi(
+      `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}/publications/${encodeURIComponent(version)}`,
+    );
+  if (
+    !historyView.active ||
+    g !== historyView.requestGeneration ||
+    auditId !== historyView.auditId
+  )
+    return;
+  historyView.kind = "publication";
+  historyView.publicationId = Number(p.id);
+  historyView.publicationVersion = Number(
+    p.version_number || p.versionNumber || version,
+  );
+  historyView.revisionId = null;
+  historyView.document = atlasHistoryClone(p.snapshot);
+  historyView.metadata = {
+    versionNumber: historyView.publicationVersion,
+    versionTitle: p.version_title || p.versionTitle,
+    publisherUsername: p.publisher_username || p.publisherUsername,
+    publishedAt: p.published_at || p.publishedAt,
+    deletionStatus: p.deletion_status || p.deletionStatus,
+  };
+  atlasHistoryRenderSelectors();
+  atlasHistoryRenderDocument();
+}
+async function atlasHistoryLoad(more = false) {
+  const auditId = historyView.auditId,
+    g = ++historyView.requestGeneration,
+    before =
+      more && historyView.activityCursor
+        ? `&beforeId=${encodeURIComponent(historyView.activityCursor)}`
+        : "";
+  document.getElementById("atlasHistoryStatus").textContent =
+    "Loading history…";
+  try {
+    const [r, a, p] = await Promise.all([
+      atlasAuditApi(`/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}/revisions`),
+      atlasAuditApi(
+        `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}/activity?limit=50${before}`,
+      ),
+      atlasAuditApi(
+        `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}/publications?limit=100`,
+      ),
+    ]);
+    if (
+      !historyView.active ||
+      g !== historyView.requestGeneration ||
+      auditId !== historyView.auditId
+    )
+      return;
+    historyView.revisions = r.revisions || [];
+    const batch = a.activity || [];
+    historyView.activity = more ? [...historyView.activity, ...batch] : batch;
+    historyView.activityCursor = batch.length
+      ? batch[batch.length - 1].id
+      : historyView.activityCursor;
+    historyView.activityComplete = batch.length < 50;
+    historyView.publications = p.publications || [];
+    atlasHistoryRenderSelectors();
+    atlasHistoryRenderTimeline();
+    document.getElementById("atlasHistoryStatus").textContent =
+      `${historyView.revisions.length} revisions, ${historyView.activity.length} activities, ${historyView.publications.length} publications loaded.`;
+  } catch (e) {
+    document.getElementById("atlasHistoryStatus").textContent = e.message;
+  }
+}
+async function atlasOpenUnifiedHistory(kind = null) {
+  if (!window.ATLASWorkflow?.feature?.("history"))
+    return status("History is not enabled for this rollout stage.", "warn");
+  const id = atlasHistoryAuditId();
+  if (!id) return status("Save this audit before opening history.", "warn");
+  historyView.active = true;
+  historyView.auditId = id;
+  historyView.returnPage =
+    atlasHistoryPage() === "history" ? "overview" : atlasHistoryPage();
+  historyView.kind = null;
+  historyView.document = null;
+  showSection("history");
+  await atlasHistoryLoad(false);
+  if (kind === "publication" && historyView.publications[0])
+    await atlasHistorySelectPublication(
+      historyView.publications[0].versionNumber,
+    );
+  else if (historyView.revisions[0])
+    await atlasHistorySelectRevision(historyView.revisions[0].id);
+}
+function atlasHistoryReturnToCurrent() {
+  historyView.active = false;
+  historyView.requestGeneration++;
+  historyView.kind = null;
+  historyView.revisionId = null;
+  historyView.publicationId = null;
+  historyView.document = null;
+  showSection(historyView.returnPage || "overview");
+}
+async function atlasHistoryCompareCurrent() {
+  if (historyView.kind === "revision")
+    return atlasViewAuditRevision(historyView.revisionId, true);
+  if (historyView.kind === "publication") {
+    const p = await atlasAuditApi(
+      `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(historyView.auditId)}/previews/publications/${encodeURIComponent(historyView.publicationVersion)}`,
+    );
+    atlasShowHistoryModal(
+      "Publication comparison",
+      atlasStructuredComparisonHtml(p),
+    );
+  }
+}
+function atlasHistoryMove(kind, delta) {
+  const list =
+      kind === "revision"
+        ? historyView.revisions.slice().sort((a, b) => a.number - b.number)
+        : historyView.publications
+            .slice()
+            .sort((a, b) => a.versionNumber - b.versionNumber),
+    id =
+      kind === "revision" ? historyView.revisionId : historyView.publicationId,
+    i = list.findIndex((x) => Number(x.id) === Number(id)),
+    next = list[i + delta];
+  if (next)
+    return kind === "revision"
+      ? atlasHistorySelectRevision(next.id)
+      : atlasHistorySelectPublication(next.versionNumber);
+}
+document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
+  const x = e.target.closest("[data-history-kind]");
+  if (!x) return;
+  const kind = x.dataset.historyKind,
+    id = x.dataset.historyId;
+  if (kind === "revision") atlasHistorySelectRevision(id);
+  else if (kind === "publication") {
+    const p = historyView.publications.find((v) => String(v.id) === String(id));
+    if (p) atlasHistorySelectPublication(p.versionNumber);
+  } else if (kind === "activity") {
+    const a = historyView.activity.find((v) => String(v.id) === String(id));
+    if (a?.publicationVersion)
+      atlasHistorySelectPublication(a.publicationVersion);
+    else if (a?.resultingRevisionId || a?.sourceRevisionId)
+      atlasHistorySelectRevision(a.resultingRevisionId || a.sourceRevisionId);
+  } else if (kind === "current") atlasHistoryReturnToCurrent();
+});
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasHistoryReturn")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", atlasHistoryReturnToCurrent);
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasHistoryRefresh")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () => atlasHistoryLoad(false));
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasHistoryMore")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () => atlasHistoryLoad(true));
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasRevisionSelector")
+  ?.addEventListener(
+    "change",
+    (e) => e.target.value && atlasHistorySelectRevision(e.target.value),
+  );
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasPublicationSelector")
+  ?.addEventListener(
+    "change",
+    (e) => e.target.value && atlasHistorySelectPublication(e.target.value),
+  );
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasRevisionPrevious")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () => atlasHistoryMove("revision", -1));
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasRevisionNext")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () => atlasHistoryMove("revision", 1));
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasPublicationPrevious")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () => atlasHistoryMove("publication", -1));
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasPublicationNext")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () => atlasHistoryMove("publication", 1));
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasHistoryCompare")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () =>
+    atlasHistoryCompareCurrent().catch((e) => status(e.message, "bad")),
+  );
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasHistoryRestore")
+  ?.addEventListener(
+    "click",
+    () =>
+      historyView.kind === "revision" &&
+      atlasRestoreAuditRevision(historyView.revisionId),
+  );
+window.ATLASHistory = {
+  open: atlasOpenUnifiedHistory,
+  returnToCurrent: atlasHistoryReturnToCurrent,
+  refresh: atlasHistoryLoad,
+  state: historyView,
+};
+atlasOpenAuditHistory = function () {
+  return atlasOpenUnifiedHistory();
+};
