+/** Display Fields page. */
+const atlasOriginalRequirementsFieldRows = requirementsFieldRows;
+function atlasDisplayPart(value) {
+  return String(value || "")
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase();
+}
+function atlasDisplayKey(value) {
+  if (value?.canonicalKey) return atlasDisplayPart(value.canonicalKey);
+  return `${atlasDisplayPart(value?.sourceKey || value?.sourceFile || value?.uniqueId || "calculated field")}::${atlasDisplayPart(value?.fieldName || value?.fieldTitle || value?.name)}`;
+}
+function atlasDisplayCreatedFieldContext(row) {
+  const title = atlasDisplayPart(
+    row?.fieldTitle || row?.fieldName || row?.name,
+  );
+  if (!title || typeof atlasCreatedFieldEntries !== "function") return null;
+  const matches = atlasCreatedFieldEntries({ includeUnavailable: true }).filter(
+    (item) => atlasDisplayPart(item.fieldName || item.rawFieldName) === title,
+  );
+  if (matches.length !== 1) return null;
+  const created = matches[0],
+    step = stepById?.(created.creatorStepId),
+    referenceSource = step?.parentId
+      ? atlasPickerReferenceSource?.(stepById?.(step.parentId)) || ""
+      : "",
+    identity = referenceSource
+      ? requirementsSourceIdentity(referenceSource)
+      : {
+          sourceKey: "calculated-field",
+          sourceFile: "Calculated Field",
+          alias: "Calculated Field",
+        };
+  return {
+    canonicalKey: `calculated:${created.creatorStepId}`,
+    creatorStepId: created.creatorStepId,
+    identity,
+    sourceColor: referenceSource
+      ? atlasSelectedSourceColor?.(identity.sourceKey || identity.sourceFile) ||
+        created.sourceColor ||
+        "#7da2d8"
+      : "#7da2d8",
+  };
+}
+function atlasDisplayCanonicalKey(row, calculated) {
+  const context = calculated ? atlasDisplayCreatedFieldContext(row) : null;
+  return context?.canonicalKey || atlasDisplayKey(row);
+}
+function atlasDisplayPreferences() {
+  if (!Array.isArray(state.audit.displayFields)) state.audit.displayFields = [];
+  return state.audit.displayFields;
+}
+function atlasDisplayLogicKeys() {
+  return new Set(
+    requirementsLogicFieldReferences().map((item) =>
+      atlasDisplayKey({
+        sourceFile:
+          requirementsSourceIdentity(item.sourceFile).sourceKey ||
+          item.sourceFile,
+        fieldName: item.fieldName,
+      }),
+    ),
+  );
+}
+function atlasDisplayCatalogRow(preference) {
+  const identity = requirementsSourceIdentity(
+    preference.sourceFile || preference.sourceKey,
+  );
+  const field = (
+    fieldsForSource?.(identity.sourceFile || preference.sourceFile) || []
+  ).find((item) =>
+    [item.rawFieldName, item.fieldName, item.name, item.label].some(
+      (value) =>
+        atlasDisplayPart(value) === atlasDisplayPart(preference.fieldName),
+    ),
+  );
+  return {
+    uniqueId:
+      identity.sourceKey || preference.sourceKey || preference.sourceFile || "",
+    sourceFile: identity.sourceFile || preference.sourceFile || "",
+    fieldTitle:
+      field?.rawFieldName ||
+      field?.fieldName ||
+      field?.name ||
+      preference.fieldName ||
+      "",
+    vanityLabel:
+      field?.auditSpecificVanityLabel ||
+      field?.vanityLabel ||
+      field?.globalVanityLabel ||
+      field?.label ||
+      preference.fieldName ||
+      "",
+    displayFormat:
+      field?.displayFormat || field?.formatting || field?.format || "",
+    dataCategory: field?.dataCategory || field?.category || "",
+    notes: "Display-only field",
+  };
+}
+function atlasDisplayRows(options = {}) {
+  const base = atlasOriginalRequirementsFieldRows(options),
+    prefs = atlasDisplayPreferences(),
+    logic = atlasDisplayLogicKeys(),
+    rows = new Map();
+  base.forEach((row, index) => {
+    const calculated =
+        !row.uniqueId || atlasDisplayPart(row.uniqueId) === "calculated field",
+      context = calculated ? atlasDisplayCreatedFieldContext(row) : null,
+      key = context?.canonicalKey || atlasDisplayKey(row),
+      legacyKey = atlasDisplayKey(row),
+      matching = prefs.filter(
+        (item) =>
+          atlasDisplayCanonicalKey(item, calculated) === key ||
+          atlasDisplayKey(item) === legacyKey,
+      ),
+      saved = matching.length === 1 ? matching[0] : null,
+      identity = calculated
+        ? context?.identity || {
+            sourceKey: "calculated-field",
+            sourceFile: "Calculated Field",
+            alias: "Calculated Field",
+          }
+        : requirementsSourceIdentity(row.uniqueId || row.sourceFile),
+      sourceColor = calculated
+        ? context?.sourceColor || "#7da2d8"
+        : atlasSelectedSourceColor?.(
+            identity.sourceKey || identity.sourceFile,
+          ) || "#7da2d8";
+    if (rows.has(key)) return;
+    rows.set(key, {
+      ...row,
+      sourceFile: calculated
+        ? "Calculated Field"
+        : identity.sourceFile || row.uniqueId || "",
+      sourceAlias: calculated
+        ? "Calculated Field"
+        : identity.alias || row.uniqueId || "",
+      key,
+      canonicalKey: context?.canonicalKey || "",
+      creatorStepId: context?.creatorStepId || "",
+      calculated,
+      sourceColor,
+      usedInLogic: calculated || logic.has(legacyKey),
+      manuallyAttached: false,
+      displayed: saved ? saved.displayed !== false : true,
+      order: saved?.order ?? index,
+    });
+  });
+  prefs.forEach((pref, index) => {
+    const row = atlasDisplayCatalogRow(pref),
+      calculated =
+        atlasDisplayPart(pref.sourceFile) === "calculated field" ||
+        atlasDisplayPart(pref.sourceKey) === "calculated-field" ||
+        atlasDisplayPart(pref.canonicalKey).startsWith("calculated:"),
+      context = calculated ? atlasDisplayCreatedFieldContext(row) : null,
+      key = context?.canonicalKey || atlasDisplayKey(pref);
+    if (rows.has(key)) return;
+    const identity = calculated
+        ? context?.identity || {
+            sourceKey: "calculated-field",
+            sourceFile: "Calculated Field",
+            alias: "Calculated Field",
+          }
+        : requirementsSourceIdentity(pref.sourceKey || pref.sourceFile),
+      sourceColor = calculated
+        ? context?.sourceColor || "#7da2d8"
+        : atlasSelectedSourceColor?.(
+            identity.sourceKey || identity.sourceFile,
+          ) || "#7da2d8";
+    rows.set(key, {
+      ...row,
+      sourceFile: calculated ? "Calculated Field" : row.sourceFile,
+      sourceAlias: calculated
+        ? "Calculated Field"
+        : identity.alias || row.sourceFile,
+      key,
+      canonicalKey: context?.canonicalKey || pref.canonicalKey || "",
+      creatorStepId: context?.creatorStepId || "",
+      calculated,
+      sourceColor,
+      usedInLogic: calculated || logic.has(atlasDisplayKey(pref)),
+      manuallyAttached: !logic.has(atlasDisplayKey(pref)) && !calculated,
+      displayed: pref.displayed !== false,
+      order: pref.order ?? base.length + index,
+    });
+  });
+  return [...rows.values()]
+    .sort(
+      (a, b) => a.order - b.order || a.fieldTitle.localeCompare(b.fieldTitle),
+    )
+    .map((row, index) => ({
+      ...row,
+      rowNumber: index + 1,
+      display: row.displayed ? "Yes" : "No",
+    }));
+}
+requirementsFieldRows = function requirementsFieldRowsWithDisplaySelection(
+  options = {},
+) {
+  const rows = atlasDisplayRows(options);
+  return options.includeHidden ? rows : rows.filter((row) => row.displayed);
+};
+function atlasSaveDisplayField(row, displayed) {
+  const prefs = atlasDisplayPreferences(),
+    key = atlasDisplayKey(row),
+    existing = prefs.find((item) => atlasDisplayKey(item) === key),
+    value = {
+      canonicalKey: row.canonicalKey || "",
+      sourceKey: row.uniqueId || row.sourceFile || "",
+      sourceFile: row.sourceFile || row.uniqueId || "",
+      fieldName: row.fieldTitle,
+      displayed: !!displayed,
+      order: row.order ?? prefs.length,
+    };
+  existing ? Object.assign(existing, value) : prefs.push(value);
+}
+function renderDisplayFieldsPage() {
+  const host = $("displayFieldsTable");
+  if (!host) return;
+  const rows = requirementsFieldRows({
+    includeHidden: true,
+    includeNotes: false,
+  });
+  const pill = (value, row, kind) => {
+    const classes = [
+      "display-field-pill",
+      `${kind}-pill`,
+      row.calculated ? "calculated-field-pill" : "",
+    ]
+      .filter(Boolean)
+      .join(" ");
+    const badge =
+      row.calculated && kind !== "source"
+        ? '<span class="display-field-pill-badge">Calculated</span>'
+        : "";
+    return `<span class="${classes}" style="--display-field-color:${esc(row.sourceColor || "#7da2d8")}">${esc(value)}${badge}</span>`;
+  };
+  host.innerHTML = rows.length
+    ? `<div class="display-fields-table-wrap"><table class="display-fields-table"><thead><tr><th scope="col" aria-label="Reorder"></th><th>Source</th><th>Field Title</th><th>Vanity Label</th><th>Display Format</th><th>Data Category</th><th>Used in Logic</th><th>Displayed</th></tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map((row) => `<tr draggable="true" data-display-field-row="${esc(row.key)}"><td><span class="display-field-drag-handle" draggable="true" tabindex="0" role="button" aria-label="Reorder ${esc(row.vanityLabel || row.fieldTitle)}" title="Drag to reorder or use Alt+Up and Alt+Down">⋮⋮</span></td><td>${pill(row.sourceAlias || row.uniqueId || "Calculated Field", row, "source")}</td><td>${pill(row.fieldTitle, row, "field")}</td><td>${esc(row.vanityLabel)}</td><td>${esc(row.displayFormat)}</td><td>${esc(row.dataCategory)}</td><td>${row.usedInLogic ? "Yes" : "No"}</td><td><label class="display-fields-switch"><input type="checkbox" role="switch" data-display-field-toggle="${esc(row.key)}" aria-label="Display ${esc(row.vanityLabel || row.fieldTitle)}" ${row.displayed ? "checked" : ""}><span class="display-fields-switch-track" aria-hidden="true"></span><span>${row.displayed ? "Displayed" : "Hidden"}</span></label></td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table></div>`
+    : `<div class="empty-state"><strong>No fields are available.</strong><p>Add logic fields or select a display-only field from an included source.</p></div>`;
+  const enabled = (state.audit.sources || []).length > 0,
+    button = $("addDisplayFieldBtn");
+  if (button) {
+    button.disabled = !enabled;
+    button.title = enabled ? "" : "Add a source to this audit first.";
+  }
+}
+function atlasDisplayPickerSources() {
+  return (state.audit.sources || []).map((source) =>
+    requirementsSourceIdentity(source),
+  );
+}
+function atlasDisplayPickerEntries() {
+  const selectedKeys = new Set(
+    atlasDisplayRows({ includeHidden: true }).map((row) => row.key),
+  );
+  return atlasDisplayPickerSources().flatMap((identity) => {
+    const sourceFile = identity.sourceFile || identity.sourceKey || "";
+    const selectedSource = (state.audit.sources || []).find((source) =>
+      [source.name, source.sourceFile, source.sourceKey, source.alias]
+        .filter(Boolean)
+        .includes(sourceFile),
+    );
+    return (fieldsForSource?.(sourceFile) || []).map((field) => {
+      const fieldName =
+        field.rawFieldName ||
+        field.fieldName ||
+        field.name ||
+        field.label ||
+        "";
+      const key = atlasDisplayKey({
+        sourceKey: identity.sourceKey,
+        sourceFile,
+        fieldName,
+      });
+      return {
+        key,
+        label:
+          field.auditSpecificVanityLabel ||
+          field.vanityLabel ||
+          field.globalVanityLabel ||
+          field.label ||
+          fieldName,
+        rawName: fieldName,
+        sourceKey: identity.sourceKey || sourceFile,
+        sourceLabel:
+          identity.alias || sourceFile || identity.sourceKey || "Other",
+        sourceColor:
+          selectedSource?.color ||
+          atlasSelectedSourceColor?.(sourceFile) ||
+          "#7da2d8",
+        custom: Boolean(field.isCreatedField),
+        badge: field.isCreatedField ? "Custom" : "",
+        disabled: selectedKeys.has(key),
+        pickerSource: sourceFile,
+        pickerField: fieldName,
+      };
+    });
+  });
+}
+function atlasOpenDisplayPicker() {
+  if (!window.ATLASVisualPicker?.open) {
+    console.error("ATLAS Display Fields: shared Visual Picker is unavailable.");
+    status?.(
+      "The field picker is unavailable. Reload the page and try again.",
+      "error",
+    );
+    return false;
+  }
+  return window.ATLASVisualPicker.open({
+    mode: "field",
+    title: "Visual Field Picker",
+    guidance: "Select a field from a source included in this audit.",
+    searchPlaceholder: "Search selected sources and fields...",
+    entries: atlasDisplayPickerEntries(),
+    sort: "source",
+    closeOnSelect: false,
+    onSelect(entry) {
+      if (!entry) return;
+      atlasAddDisplayField(entry.pickerSource, entry.pickerField);
+    },
+  });
+}
+function atlasAddDisplayField(sourceFile, fieldName) {
+  const identity = atlasDisplayPickerSources().find((source) =>
+    [source.sourceFile, source.sourceKey, source.alias]
+      .filter(Boolean)
+      .includes(sourceFile),
+  );
+  const field = identity
+    ? (fieldsForSource?.(identity.sourceFile || sourceFile) || []).find(
+        (item) =>
+          [item.rawFieldName, item.fieldName, item.name, item.label].some(
+            (value) => atlasDisplayPart(value) === atlasDisplayPart(fieldName),
+          ),
+      )
+    : null;
+  const resolvedFieldName =
+    field?.rawFieldName ||
+    field?.fieldName ||
+    field?.name ||
+    field?.label ||
+    "";
+  if (!identity || !field || !resolvedFieldName) {
+    console.error(
+      "ATLAS Display Fields: rejected a stale or invalid picker entry.",
+      {
+        sourceAvailable: Boolean(identity),
+        fieldAvailable: Boolean(field),
+      },
+    );
+    status?.(
+      "That field is no longer available. Reopen the picker and try again.",
+      "error",
+    );
+    return false;
+  }
+  const key = atlasDisplayKey({
+    sourceKey: identity.sourceKey,
+    sourceFile: identity.sourceFile || sourceFile,
+    fieldName: resolvedFieldName,
+  });
+  if (
+    atlasDisplayRows({ includeHidden: true }).some((row) => row.key === key)
+  ) {
+    status?.("That field is already included in Display Fields.", "error");
+    return false;
+  }
+  const row = {
+    uniqueId: identity.sourceKey || sourceFile,
+    sourceFile: identity.sourceFile || sourceFile,
+    fieldTitle: resolvedFieldName,
+    order: atlasDisplayPreferences().length,
+  };
+  atlasSaveDisplayField(row, true);
+  scheduleAutosave?.();
+  atlasInvalidatePages?.(["display-fields", "preview", "save"]);
+  renderDisplayFieldsPage();
+  renderRequirementsFieldsPreview?.();
+  window.ATLASVisualPicker.close("select");
+  status?.(`Added ${resolvedFieldName} to displayed fields.`, "ok");
+  return true;
+}
+function atlasPersistDisplayFieldOrder(rows) {
+  rows.forEach((row, order) =>
+    atlasSaveDisplayField({ ...row, order }, row.displayed),
+  );
+  scheduleAutosave?.();
+  atlasInvalidatePages?.(["display-fields", "preview", "save"]);
+}
+function atlasMoveDisplayField(sourceKey, targetKey) {
+  const rows = requirementsFieldRows({
+      includeHidden: true,
+      includeNotes: false,
+    }),
+    from = rows.findIndex((row) => row.key === sourceKey),
+    to = rows.findIndex((row) => row.key === targetKey);
+  if (from < 0 || to < 0 || from === to) return false;
+  const [moved] = rows.splice(from, 1);
+  rows.splice(to, 0, moved);
+  atlasPersistDisplayFieldOrder(rows);
+  renderDisplayFieldsPage();
+  renderRequirementsFieldsPreview?.();
+  return true;
+}
+let atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey = "";
+document.addEventListener("dragstart", (event) => {
+  const handle = event.target.closest?.(".display-field-drag-handle"),
+    row = handle?.closest("[data-display-field-row]");
+  if (!row) return;
+  atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey = row.dataset.displayFieldRow || "";
+  event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "move";
+  event.dataTransfer.setData("text/plain", atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey);
+  row.classList.add("display-field-dragging");
+});
+document.addEventListener("dragover", (event) => {
+  const row = event.target.closest?.("[data-display-field-row]");
+  if (!row || !atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey) return;
+  event.preventDefault();
+  document
+    .querySelectorAll(".display-field-drop-target")
+    .forEach((item) => item.classList.remove("display-field-drop-target"));
+  row.classList.add("display-field-drop-target");
+});
+document.addEventListener("drop", (event) => {
+  const row = event.target.closest?.("[data-display-field-row]");
+  if (!row || !atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey) return;
+  event.preventDefault();
+  atlasMoveDisplayField(
+    atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey,
+    row.dataset.displayFieldRow,
+  );
+  atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey = "";
+});
+document.addEventListener("dragend", () => {
+  atlasDraggedDisplayFieldKey = "";
+  document
+    .querySelectorAll(".display-field-dragging, .display-field-drop-target")
+    .forEach((item) =>
+      item.classList.remove(
+        "display-field-dragging",
+        "display-field-drop-target",
+      ),
+    );
+});
+document.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
+  const handle = event.target.closest?.(".display-field-drag-handle");
+  if (!handle || !event.altKey || !["ArrowUp", "ArrowDown"].includes(event.key))
+    return;
+  const row = handle.closest("[data-display-field-row]"),
+    rows = [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-display-field-row]")],
+    index = rows.indexOf(row),
+    target = rows[index + (event.key === "ArrowUp" ? -1 : 1)];
+  if (!target) return;
+  event.preventDefault();
+  const key = row.dataset.displayFieldRow;
+  if (atlasMoveDisplayField(key, target.dataset.displayFieldRow))
+    [...document.querySelectorAll("[data-display-field-row]")]
+      .find((item) => item.dataset.displayFieldRow === key)
+      ?.querySelector(".display-field-drag-handle")
+      ?.focus();
+});
+document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+  if (event.target.closest("#addDisplayFieldBtn")) atlasOpenDisplayPicker();
+});
+document.addEventListener("change", (event) => {
+  if (!event.target.matches("[data-display-field-toggle]")) return;
+  const row = requirementsFieldRows({
+    includeHidden: true,
+    includeNotes: false,
+  }).find((item) => item.key === event.target.dataset.displayFieldToggle);
+  if (!row) {
+    event.target.checked = !event.target.checked;
+    status?.(
+      "That Display Field is no longer available. Refresh and try again.",
+      "warn",
+    );
+    return;
+  }
+  if (!event.target.checked && row.manuallyAttached) {
+    event.target.checked = true;
+    const remove = confirm(
+      `Remove ${row.vanityLabel || row.fieldTitle} from Display?\n\nThis will also remove the field from the Display Fields list.`,
+    );
+    if (!remove) {
+      event.target.focus();
+      return;
+    }
+    const prefs = atlasDisplayPreferences();
+    const matches = prefs
+      .map((item, index) => ({ item, index }))
+      .filter(({ item }) => atlasDisplayKey(item) === row.key);
+    if (matches.length !== 1) {
+      status?.(
+        matches.length
+          ? "This Display Field has ambiguous saved preferences and was not removed."
+          : "The saved Display Field preference could not be found.",
+        "warn",
+      );
+      event.target.focus();
+      return;
+    }
+    prefs.splice(matches[0].index, 1);
+    scheduleAutosave?.();
+    atlasInvalidatePages?.(["display-fields", "preview", "save"]);
+    renderDisplayFieldsPage();
+    renderRequirementsFieldsPreview?.();
+    status?.(
+      `Removed ${row.vanityLabel || row.fieldTitle} from displayed fields.`,
+      "ok",
+    );
+    $("addDisplayFieldBtn")?.focus();
+    return;
+  }
+  atlasSaveDisplayField(row, event.target.checked);
+  scheduleAutosave?.();
+  atlasInvalidatePages?.(["preview", "save"]);
+  renderDisplayFieldsPage();
+  renderRequirementsFieldsPreview?.();
+});
+const atlasOriginalRenderPage = atlasRenderPage;
+atlasRenderPage = function atlasRenderPageWithDisplayFields(
+  page,
+  options = {},
+) {
+  const target = pageForSection?.(page) || page;
+  if (target === "display-fields") {
+    renderDisplayFieldsPage();
+    atlasPageRenderState.dirty.delete(target);
+    atlasPageRenderState.initialized.add(target);
+    return;
+  }
+  return atlasOriginalRenderPage(page, options);
+};
+const atlasStepsFlowIndex = AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES.findIndex(
+  (item) => item.page === "steps",
+);
+if (
+  atlasStepsFlowIndex >= 0 &&
+  !AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES.some((item) => item.page === "display-fields")
+) {
+  AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES[atlasStepsFlowIndex].nextLabel = "Display Fields";
+  AUDIT_FLOW_PAGES.splice(atlasStepsFlowIndex + 1, 0, {
+    page: "display-fields",
+    label: "Display Fields",
+    nextLabel: "Requirements Preview",
+  });
+}

+================================================================================
+BEGIN FILE: js/23-atlas-audit-issues.js
+================================================================================
+
+/**
+ * ATLAS adapter for the portable Audit Issue engine.
+ *
+ * Owns ATLAS context normalization, named evaluators, catalog loading,
+ * transient caching/invalidation, legacy validation compatibility, and the
+ * shared floating/Readiness issue presentation. It does not navigate, mutate
+ * audits, or persist issue results.
+ */
+(function initializeAtlasAuditIssues(global) {
+  "use strict";
+
+  const CATALOG_URL = "./catalogs/audit-issue-rules.json";
+  let catalog = null;
+  let catalogError = null;
+  let catalogPromise = null;
+  let generation = 0;
+  let cache = { generation: -1, signature: "", result: null };
+
+  const string = (value) => (value == null ? "" : String(value));
+  const blank = (value) => !string(value).trim();
+  const array = (value) => (Array.isArray(value) ? value : []);
+  const object = (value) =>
+    value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value) ? value : {};
+
+  function assignmentEntries(assignments, role) {
+    return array(object(assignments)[role]);
+  }
+
+  function sourceIdentity(source) {
+    return string(
+      object(source).sourceKey ||
+        object(source).sourceFile ||
+        object(source).alias ||
+        object(source).name,
+    ).trim();
+  }
+
+  function fieldIdentity(field) {
+    const item = object(field);
+    return `${string(item.sourceKey || item.sourceFile || item.source).trim()}::${string(item.rawFieldName || item.fieldName || item.name).trim()}`;
+  }
+
+  function conditionRows(step) {
+    if (typeof global.parseStepConditions === "function") {
+      try {
+        return array(global.parseStepConditions(step));
+      } catch (_error) {}
+    }
+    const params = object(step.params);
+    if (params.conditions_json) {
+      try {
+        return array(JSON.parse(params.conditions_json));
+      } catch (_error) {
+        return [{ __parseError: true }];
+      }
+    }
+    return array(step.conditions);
+  }
+
+  function meaningfulAction(step) {
+    const item = object(step);
+    const params = object(item.params);
+    const type = string(params.then_action_type || params.action_type).trim();
+    if (string(item.action).trim()) return true;
+    if (type === "do_not_display") return true;
+    if (type === "display_text")
+      return !blank(params.then_text) && !blank(params.then_output_column);
+    if (type === "set_column_value")
+      return (
+        !blank(params.then_target_column) && !blank(params.then_value_field)
+      );
+    if (type === "set_column_calculation")
+      return (
+        !blank(params.then_target_column) && !blank(params.then_value_field)
+      );
+    if (type === "set_column_string_transform")
+      return (
+        !blank(params.then_target_column) &&
+        !blank(params.then_string_source_field) &&
+        !blank(params.then_string_operation)
+      );
+    if (type === "freeform") return !blank(params.then_action);
+    return false;
+  }
+
+  function stepNeedsAction(step) {
+    const type = string(step.step_type || step.type).trim();
+    return ["if_then", "else", "flag_records", "filter_rows"].includes(type);
+  }
+
+  function descendantHasAction(step, stepsByParent, visited = new Set()) {
+    if (!step || visited.has(step.id)) return false;
+    visited.add(step.id);
+    return array(stepsByParent.get(step.id)).some(
+      (child) =>
+        child.enabled !== false &&
+        (meaningfulAction(child) ||
+          descendantHasAction(child, stepsByParent, visited)),
+    );
+  }
+
+  function buildContext(
+    auditInput = (
+      typeof hasSelectedAudit === "function"
+        ? hasSelectedAudit()
+        : Boolean(state?.auditSelected)
+    )
+      ? state.audit
+      : null,
+  ) {
+    const audit = object(auditInput);
+    const sources = array(audit.sources);
+    const fields = array(audit.fields);
+    const steps = array(audit.steps);
+    const displayFields = array(audit.displayFields);
+    const catalogSources = array(global.repoLibraryState?.sourceFiles);
+    const sourceIdentityMap = Object.create(null);
+    const registerSourceIdentity = (value, canonical) => {
+      const key = string(value).trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
+      if (!key || !canonical) return;
+      if (!(key in sourceIdentityMap)) sourceIdentityMap[key] = canonical;
+      else if (sourceIdentityMap[key] !== canonical)
+        sourceIdentityMap[key] = null;
+    };
+    const canonicalSource = (sourceLike) => {
+      if (typeof global.atlasResolveSourceIdentity === "function") {
+        const resolved = global.atlasResolveSourceIdentity(
+          sourceLike,
+          catalogSources,
+        );
+        if (resolved?.ambiguous) return "";
+        return string(resolved?.sourceKey || resolved?.sourceFile).trim();
+      }
+      return typeof sourceLike === "string"
+        ? string(sourceLike).trim()
+        : sourceIdentity(sourceLike);
+    };
+    catalogSources.forEach((source) => {
+      const canonical = canonicalSource(source);
+      [source.sourceKey, source.sourceFile, source.alias, source.name].forEach(
+        (value) => registerSourceIdentity(value, canonical),
+      );
+    });
+    sources.forEach((source) => {
+      const canonical = canonicalSource(source);
+      [source.sourceKey, source.sourceFile, source.alias, source.name].forEach(
+        (value) => registerSourceIdentity(value, canonical),
+      );
+    });
+    const canonicalForValue = (value) => {
+      const raw = string(value).trim();
+      const key = raw.toLocaleLowerCase();
+      if (key in sourceIdentityMap) return sourceIdentityMap[key] || "";
+      const canonical = canonicalSource(raw);
+      if (canonical) registerSourceIdentity(raw, canonical);
+      return canonical;
+    };
+    const sourceIds = new Set(
+      sources.map((source) => canonicalSource(source)).filter(Boolean),
+    );
+    const knownSourceIds = new Set(
+      catalogSources.map((source) => canonicalSource(source)).filter(Boolean),
+    );
+    const knownFieldIds = new Set();
+    catalogSources.forEach((source) => {
+      const canonical = canonicalSource(source);
+      array(source.fields).forEach((field) => {
+        const fieldName = string(
+          field.rawFieldName || field.fieldName || field.name || field.label,
+        ).trim();
+        if (canonical && fieldName)
+          knownFieldIds.add(`${canonical}::${fieldName}`);
+      });
+    });
+    fields.forEach((field) => {
+      const item = object(field);
+      const canonical = canonicalForValue(
+        item.sourceKey || item.sourceFile || item.source,
+      );
+      const fieldName = string(
+        item.rawFieldName || item.fieldName || item.name,
+      ).trim();
+      if (canonical && fieldName)
+        knownFieldIds.add(`${canonical}::${fieldName}`);
+    });
+
+    const stepsById = new Map();
+    const stepsByParent = new Map();
+    steps.forEach((step, index) => {
+      const id = string(step.id).trim();
+      if (id && !stepsById.has(id)) stepsById.set(id, step);
+      const parent = string(step.parentId).trim();
+      if (!stepsByParent.has(parent)) stepsByParent.set(parent, []);
+      stepsByParent.get(parent).push(step);
+    });
+
+    const normalizedSteps = steps.map((step, index) => {
+      const params = object(step.params);
+      const conditions = conditionRows(step).map(
+        (condition, conditionIndex) => ({
+          ...object(condition),
+          __index: conditionIndex,
+        }),
+      );
+      return {
+        id: string(step.id).trim(),
+        index,
+        title: string(step.title).trim(),
+        type: string(step.step_type || step.type).trim(),
+        enabled: step.enabled !== false,
+        parentId: string(step.parentId).trim(),
+        branchType: string(step.branchType || "root").trim(),
+        source: string(step.source || params.source_file).trim(),
+        field: string(step.field || params.field_name).trim(),
+        action: string(step.action || params.then_action).trim(),
+        params: { ...params },
+        conditions,
+        hasMeaningfulAction: meaningfulAction(step),
+        descendantHasMeaningfulAction: descendantHasAction(step, stepsByParent),
+      };
+    });
+
+    const supportedRelationshipJoinTypes = new Set([
+      "INNER JOIN",
+      "LEFT JOIN",
+      "RIGHT JOIN",
+      "FULL OUTER JOIN",
+    ]);
+    const joinRelationships = normalizedSteps.flatMap((step) => {
+      const params = step.params;
+      const joinType = string(params.join_type).trim().toUpperCase();
+      if (
+        !step.enabled ||
+        step.type !== "join" ||
+        !supportedRelationshipJoinTypes.has(joinType) ||
+        blank(params.left_source) ||
+        blank(params.right_source) ||
+        blank(params.left_field) ||
+        blank(params.right_field)
+      )
+        return [];
+      const left = canonicalForValue(params.left_source);
+      const right = canonicalForValue(params.right_source);
+      if (
+        !left ||
+        !right ||
+        left === right ||
+        !sourceIds.has(left) ||
+        !sourceIds.has(right)
+      )
+        return [];
+      return [[left, right]];
+    });
+    return {
+      audit: {
+        name: string(audit.name),
+        purpose: string(audit.purpose || audit.description),
+        assignments: {
+          assigned: assignmentEntries(audit.assignments, "assigned"),
+          backup: assignmentEntries(audit.assignments, "backup"),
+          developer: assignmentEntries(audit.assignments, "developer"),
+        },
+        sources: sources.map((source) => ({
+          ...object(source),
+          identity: sourceIdentity(source),
+          canonicalIdentity: canonicalSource(source),
+        })),
+        fields: fields.map((field) => ({
+          ...object(field),
+          identity: fieldIdentity(field),
+        })),
+        steps: normalizedSteps,
+        displayFields: displayFields.map((field) => ({ ...object(field) })),
+      },
+      knownSourceIds: [...knownSourceIds],
+      knownFieldIds: [...knownFieldIds],
+      selectedSourceIds: [...sourceIds],
+      sourceIdentityMap: { ...sourceIdentityMap },
+      joinRelationships,
+      workbookWarnings: array(global.workbookState?.warnings).map(string),
+    };
+  }
+
+  function issue(instanceId, target = {}, values = {}) {
+    return { instanceId: string(instanceId), target, ...values };
+  }
+
+  const evaluators = {
+    missingTextValue(context, config) {
+      const value =
+        config.path === "audit.name"
+          ? context.audit.name
+          : context.audit.purpose;
+      return blank(value)
+        ? [issue(config.path, { page: "overview", field: config.path })]
+        : [];
+    },
+    missingAssignment(context, config) {
+      return array(context.audit.assignments[config.role]).length
+        ? []
+        : [
+            issue(config.role, {
+              page: "overview",
+              field: `assignments.${config.role}`,
+            }),
+          ];
+    },
+    missingSources(context) {
+      return context.audit.sources.length
+        ? []
+        : [issue("sources", { page: "fields" })];
+    },
+    missingSteps(context) {
+      if (!context.audit.sources.length) return [];
+      return context.audit.steps.length
+        ? []
+        : [issue("steps", { page: "steps" })];
+    },
+    workbookWarnings(context) {
+      return context.workbookWarnings.map((message, index) =>
+        issue(index, { page: "review" }, { summary: message }),
+      );
+    },
+    sourceAndFieldIntegrity(context) {
+      const knownSources = new Set(context.knownSourceIds);
+      const knownFields = new Set(context.knownFieldIds);
+      const selectedSources = new Set(context.selectedSourceIds);
+      const issues = [];
+      context.audit.sources.forEach((source, index) => {
+        if (!source.identity)
+          issues.push(
+            issue(
+              `source-${index}-identity`,
+              { page: "fields" },
+              {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary: "A selected source has no usable identity.",
+              },
+            ),
+          );
+        else if (
+          knownSources.size &&
+          !knownSources.has(source.canonicalIdentity || source.identity)
+        )
+          issues.push(
+            issue(
+              `source-${index}-missing`,
+              { page: "fields" },
+              {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "A selected source is no longer available in the source catalog.",
+              },
+            ),
+          );
+      });
+      context.audit.steps.forEach((step) => {
+        const references = [];
+        if (step.source || step.field)
+          references.push({
+            source: step.source,
+            field: step.field,
+            location: "step",
+          });
+        step.conditions.forEach((condition) => {
+          references.push({
+            source: condition.sourceFile || step.source,
+            field: condition.fieldName || condition.field,
+            location: `condition-${condition.id || condition.__index}`,
+          });
+          if ((condition.valueMode || "values") === "field")
+            references.push({
+              source: condition.compareSourceFile,
+              field: condition.compareFieldName,
+              location: `compare-${condition.id || condition.__index}`,
+            });
+        });
+        references.forEach((reference) => {
+          if (!reference.source || !reference.field) return;
+          const target = { page: "steps", stepId: step.id };
+          const sourceKey = string(reference.source).trim().toLocaleLowerCase();
+          const canonicalSource = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
+            context.sourceIdentityMap || {},
+            sourceKey,
+          )
+            ? context.sourceIdentityMap[sourceKey]
+            : string(reference.source).trim();
+          if (selectedSources.size && !selectedSources.has(canonicalSource))
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${step.id}-${reference.location}-source`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "Logic references a source that is not selected for this audit.",
+              }),
+            );
+          if (knownSources.size && !knownSources.has(canonicalSource))
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${step.id}-${reference.location}-source-catalog`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "Logic references a source that is no longer available.",
+              }),
+            );
+          if (
+            knownFields.size &&
+            !knownFields.has(`${canonicalSource}::${reference.field}`)
+          )
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${step.id}-${reference.location}-field`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "Logic references a field that is no longer available for its source.",
+              }),
+            );
+        });
+      });
+      return issues;
+    },
+    hierarchyIntegrity(context) {
+      const ids = new Set(
+        context.audit.steps.map((step) => step.id).filter(Boolean),
+      );
+      const issues = [];
+      context.audit.steps.forEach((step) => {
+        if (!step.id)
+          issues.push(
+            issue(
+              `missing-id-${step.index}`,
+              { page: "steps" },
+              {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary: "A logic step has no stable ID.",
+              },
+            ),
+          );
+        if (step.parentId && !ids.has(step.parentId))
+          issues.push(
+            issue(
+              `${step.id}-missing-parent`,
+              { page: "steps", stepId: step.id },
+              {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "A logic step references a parent that no longer exists.",
+              },
+            ),
+          );
+        if (step.parentId && step.branchType === "root")
+          issues.push(
+            issue(
+              `${step.id}-nested-root`,
+              { page: "steps", stepId: step.id },
+              {
+                severity: "warning",
+                summary: "A nested step is still marked as top-level.",
+              },
+            ),
+          );
+        if (!step.parentId && step.branchType !== "root")
+          issues.push(
+            issue(
+              `${step.id}-orphan-branch`,
+              { page: "steps", stepId: step.id },
+              {
+                severity: "warning",
+                summary: "A top-level step is marked as a child branch.",
+              },
+            ),
+          );
+        const seen = new Set([step.id]);
+        let parentId = step.parentId;
+        while (parentId) {
+          if (seen.has(parentId)) {
+            issues.push(
+              issue(
+                `${step.id}-cycle`,
+                { page: "steps", stepId: step.id },
+                {
+                  severity: "critical",
+                  summary: "The logic hierarchy contains a cycle.",
+                },
+              ),
+            );
+            break;
+          }
+          seen.add(parentId);
+          parentId =
+            context.audit.steps.find((candidate) => candidate.id === parentId)
+              ?.parentId || "";
+        }
+      });
+      return issues;
+    },
+    conditionIntegrity(context) {
+      const issues = [];
+      context.audit.steps.forEach((step) => {
+        step.conditions.forEach((condition) => {
+          const target = {
+            page: "steps",
+            stepId: step.id,
+            conditionId: condition.id || "",
+            field: "condition",
+          };
+          const key = `${step.id}-${condition.id || condition.__index}`;
+          if (condition.__parseError) {
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${key}-parse`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary: "Condition configuration could not be parsed.",
+              }),
+            );
+            return;
+          }
+          const field = condition.fieldName || condition.field;
+          if (blank(field))
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${key}-field`, target, { severity: "critical" }),
+            );
+          if (blank(condition.operator))
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${key}-operator`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary: "An audit condition has no comparison selected.",
+              }),
+            );
+          const mode = condition.valueMode || "values";
+          if (mode === "field") {
+            if (blank(condition.compareSourceFile))
+              issues.push(
+                issue(`${key}-compare-source`, target, {
+                  severity: "critical",
+                  summary: "A field comparison has no comparison source.",
+                }),
+              );
+            if (blank(condition.compareFieldName))
+              issues.push(
+                issue(`${key}-compare-field`, target, {
+                  severity: "critical",
+                  summary: "A field comparison has no comparison field.",
+                }),
+              );
+          } else if (mode === "expression" && blank(condition.expression)) {
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${key}-expression`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary: "A condition expression is blank.",
+              }),
+            );
+          } else if (
+            mode === "values" &&
+            blank(condition.compareValue || condition.value)
+          ) {
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${key}-value`, target, {
+                severity: "warning",
+                summary: "A condition has no comparison value.",
+              }),
+            );
+          }
+          const values = string(condition.compareValue || condition.value)
+            .split(/\r?\n|,/)
+            .map((value) => value.trim())
+            .filter(Boolean);
+          if (new Set(values).size !== values.length)
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${key}-duplicates`, target, {
+                severity: "warning",
+                summary: "A condition contains duplicate comparison values.",
+              }),
+            );
+        });
+      });
+      return issues;
+    },
+    missingAction(context) {
+      return context.audit.steps.flatMap((step) => {
+        if (
+          !step.enabled ||
+          !stepNeedsAction(step) ||
+          step.hasMeaningfulAction ||
+          step.descendantHasMeaningfulAction
+        )
+          return [];
+        return [
+          issue(step.id, { page: "steps", stepId: step.id, field: "action" }),
+        ];
+      });
+    },
+    joinIntegrity(context) {
+      return context.audit.steps.flatMap((step) => {
+        if (step.type !== "join") return [];
+        const p = step.params;
+        const target = { page: "steps", stepId: step.id, field: "join" };
+        const issues = [];
+        if (blank(p.join_type))
+          issues.push(
+            issue(`${step.id}-type`, target, { severity: "warning" }),
+          );
+        else if (
+          ![
+            "INNER JOIN",
+            "LEFT JOIN",
+            "RIGHT JOIN",
+            "FULL OUTER JOIN",
+            "UNION",
+          ].includes(p.join_type)
+        )
+          issues.push(
+            issue(`${step.id}-unsupported-type`, target, {
+              severity: "critical",
+              summary: "A join uses an unsupported join type.",
+            }),
+          );
+        if (blank(p.left_source))
+          issues.push(
+            issue(`${step.id}-left-source`, target, {
+              severity: "critical",
+              summary: "A join has no left source.",
+            }),
+          );
+        if (blank(p.right_source))
+          issues.push(
+            issue(`${step.id}-right-source`, target, {
+              severity: "critical",
+              summary: "A join has no right source.",
+            }),
+          );
+        if (blank(p.left_field))
+          issues.push(
+            issue(`${step.id}-left-field`, target, {
+              severity: "critical",
+              summary: "A join has no left key.",
+            }),
+          );
+        if (blank(p.right_field))
+          issues.push(
+            issue(`${step.id}-right-field`, target, {
+              severity: "critical",
+              summary: "A join has no right key.",
+            }),
+          );
+        return issues;
+      });
+    },
+    createdFieldIntegrity(context) {
+      const creators = new Map(
+        context.audit.steps
+          .filter((step) => step.type === "create_column")
+          .map((step) => [step.id, step]),
+      );
+      const positions = new Map(
+        context.audit.steps.map((step) => [step.id, step.index]),
+      );
+      const issues = [];
+      context.audit.steps.forEach((step) => {
+        const refs = [];
+        Object.entries(step.params).forEach(([key, value]) => {
+          if (key.endsWith("_field_ref") && value?.kind === "created")
+            refs.push(value);
+        });
+        step.conditions.forEach((condition) => {
+          if (condition.fieldRef?.kind === "created")
+            refs.push(condition.fieldRef);
+          if (condition.compareFieldRef?.kind === "created")
+            refs.push(condition.compareFieldRef);
+        });
+        refs.forEach((ref, index) => {
+          const target = { page: "steps", stepId: step.id };
+          if (!creators.has(ref.creatorStepId))
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${step.id}-${index}-removed`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "A created-field reference points to a removed Create Column step.",
+              }),
+            );
+          else if ((positions.get(ref.creatorStepId) ?? Infinity) >= step.index)
+            issues.push(
+              issue(`${step.id}-${index}-forward`, target, {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "A created field is referenced before its Create Column step.",
+              }),
+            );
+        });
+      });
+      return issues;
+    },
+    createdColumnName(context) {
+      const names = new Map();
+      const issues = [];
+      context.audit.steps
+        .filter((step) => step.type === "create_column")
+        .forEach((step) => {
+          const name = string(step.params.column_name || step.field).trim();
+          const target = {
+            page: "steps",
+            stepId: step.id,
+            field: "column_name",
+          };
+          if (!name) issues.push(issue(`${step.id}-blank`, target));
+          else {
+            const key = name.toLocaleLowerCase();
+            if (names.has(key))
+              issues.push(
+                issue(`${step.id}-duplicate`, target, {
+                  summary: `Created column "${name}" duplicates another created column name.`,
+                }),
+              );
+            else names.set(key, step.id);
+          }
+        });
+      return issues;
+    },
+    mathIntegrity(context) {
+      if (typeof global.atlasValidateMathOperations !== "function") return [];
+      const issues = [];
+      context.audit.steps.forEach((step) => {
+        const p = step.params;
+        const groups = [];
+        if (
+          step.type === "create_column" &&
+          p.value_mode === "Source field value"
+        )
+          groups.push(p.source_math_json || []);
+        if (
+          step.type === "if_then" &&
+          p.then_action_type === "set_column_calculation"
+        )
+          groups.push(p.then_math_json || []);
+        step.conditions
+          .filter((condition) => condition.valueMode === "field")
+          .forEach((condition) => groups.push(condition.compareMathJson || []));
+        groups.forEach((value, index) => {
+          array(global.atlasValidateMathOperations(value)).forEach(
+            (problem, problemIndex) =>
+              issues.push(
+                issue(
+                  `${step.id}-${index}-${problemIndex}`,
+                  { page: "steps", stepId: step.id },
+                  {
+                    severity:
+                      problem.level === "error" ? "critical" : "warning",
+                    summary: problem.message,
+                  },
+                ),
+              ),
+          );
+        });
+      });
+      return issues;
+    },
+    stringTransformIntegrity(context) {
+      if (typeof global.atlasValidateStringTransform !== "function") return [];
+      return context.audit.steps.flatMap((step) => {
+        const p = step.params;
+        const groups = [];
+        if (
+          step.type === "create_column" &&
+          p.value_mode === "String transformation"
+        )
+          groups.push([p, ""]);
+        if (
+          step.type === "if_then" &&
+          p.then_action_type === "set_column_string_transform"
+        )
+          groups.push([p, "then_"]);
+        return groups.flatMap(([value, prefix], groupIndex) =>
+          array(global.atlasValidateStringTransform(value, prefix)).map(
+            (problem, index) =>
+              issue(
+                `${step.id}-${groupIndex}-${index}`,
+                { page: "steps", stepId: step.id },
+                {
+                  severity: problem.level === "error" ? "critical" : "warning",
+                  summary: problem.message,
+                },
+              ),
+          ),
+        );
+      });
+    },
+    displayFieldIntegrity(context) {
+      const seen = new Set();
+      return context.audit.displayFields.flatMap((field, index) => {
+        const key =
+          string(field.key || field.sourceKey || field.sourceFile) +
+          "::" +
+          string(field.rawFieldName || field.fieldName || field.name);
+        if (!key.replaceAll(":", ""))
+          return [
+            issue(
+              `${index}-invalid`,
+              { page: "display-fields" },
+              {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary:
+                  "A Display Field preference has no valid field identity.",
+              },
+            ),
+          ];
+        if (seen.has(key))
+          return [
+            issue(
+              `${index}-duplicate`,
+              { page: "display-fields" },
+              {
+                severity: "warning",
+                summary: "A Display Field is selected more than once.",
+              },
+            ),
+          ];
+        seen.add(key);
+        return [];
+      });
+    },
+    noDisplayFields(context) {
+      if (!context.audit.sources.length || !context.audit.steps.length)
+        return [];
+      return context.audit.displayFields.length
+        ? []
+        : [issue("display-fields", { page: "display-fields" })];
+    },
+    invalidFieldRelationship(context) {
+      const selectedSources = new Set(context.selectedSourceIds);
+      const adjacency = new Map();
+      array(context.joinRelationships).forEach((relationship) => {
+        const left = string(relationship?.[0]).trim();
+        const right = string(relationship?.[1]).trim();
+        if (!left || !right || left === right) return;
+        if (!adjacency.has(left)) adjacency.set(left, new Set());
+        if (!adjacency.has(right)) adjacency.set(right, new Set());
+        adjacency.get(left).add(right);
+        adjacency.get(right).add(left);
+      });
+      const canonicalForReference = (value) => {
+        const raw = string(value).trim();
+        if (!raw) return "";
+        const key = raw.toLocaleLowerCase();
+        return Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
+          context.sourceIdentityMap || {},
+          key,
+        )
+          ? context.sourceIdentityMap[key] || ""
+          : "";
+      };
+      const sourcesAreConnected = (left, right) => {
+        if (left === right) return true;
+        const pending = [left];
+        const visited = new Set();
+        while (pending.length) {
+          const current = pending.shift();
+          if (!current || visited.has(current)) continue;
+          if (current === right) return true;
+          visited.add(current);
+          (adjacency.get(current) || []).forEach((next) => {
+            if (!visited.has(next)) pending.push(next);
+          });
+        }
+        return false;
+      };
+      return context.audit.steps.flatMap((step) => {
+        if (!step.enabled || step.type !== "if_then") return [];
+        return step.conditions.flatMap((condition) => {
+          if (
+            condition.__parseError ||
+            (condition.valueMode || "values") !== "field"
+          )
+            return [];
+          const sourceValue = condition.sourceFile || step.source;
+          const compareSourceValue = condition.compareSourceFile;
+          const field = condition.fieldName || condition.field;
+          const compareField = condition.compareFieldName;
+          if (
+            blank(sourceValue) ||
+            blank(compareSourceValue) ||
+            blank(field) ||
+            blank(compareField) ||
+            blank(condition.operator)
+          )
+            return [];
+          const source = canonicalForReference(sourceValue);
+          const compareSource = canonicalForReference(compareSourceValue);
+          if (
+            !source ||
+            !compareSource ||
+            !selectedSources.has(source) ||
+            !selectedSources.has(compareSource) ||
+            sourcesAreConnected(source, compareSource)
+          )
+            return [];
+          const conditionId = string(condition.id).trim();
+          return [
+            issue(
+              `${step.id}-${conditionId || condition.__index}-${source}-${compareSource}`,
+              {
+                page: "steps",
+                stepId: step.id,
+                conditionId,
+                field: "condition",
+              },
+              {
+                severity: "critical",
+                summary: `${sourceValue} and ${compareSourceValue} are not connected by a direct or indirect JOIN.`,
+              },
+            ),
+          ];
+        });
+      });
+    },
+  };
+
+  function currentAuditKey() {
+    const audit = (
+      typeof hasSelectedAudit === "function"
+        ? hasSelectedAudit()
+        : Boolean(state?.auditSelected)
+    )
+      ? state.audit
+      : null;
+    return string(audit?.id || audit?.name).trim();
+  }
+
+  function focusAfterNavigation(selector, fallbackSelector = "") {
+    global.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+      const target =
+        document.querySelector(selector) ||
+        (fallbackSelector ? document.querySelector(fallbackSelector) : null);
+      if (!target) return;
+      if (
+        !target.hasAttribute("tabindex") &&
+        !/^(INPUT|SELECT|TEXTAREA|BUTTON|A)$/.test(target.tagName)
+      )
+        target.tabIndex = -1;
+      target.focus({ preventScroll: false });
+      target.scrollIntoView?.({ block: "center", behavior: "smooth" });
+    });
+  }
+
+  async function navigateTo(section) {
+    if (typeof global.atlasNavigateToSection === "function")
+      await global.atlasNavigateToSection(section);
+    else if (typeof global.showSection === "function")
+      global.showSection(section);
+  }
+
+  async function openOverviewTarget(entry, selector) {
+    await navigateTo("overview");
+    focusAfterNavigation(selector, "#page-overview");
+    return Boolean(document.querySelector(selector));
+  }
+
+  let activeFix = null;
+  const auditIdentity = () =>
+    string(state?.audit?.id || state?.activeAuditValue || state?.audit?.name);
+
+  function freshIssue(key, auditKey) {
+    if (auditKey !== auditIdentity()) return null;
+    return current().issues.find((item) => item.stableKey === key) || null;
+  }
+
+  function closeFixDialog(restore = true) {
+    const prior = activeFix;
+    activeFix = null;
+    prior?.root?.remove();
+    if (restore && prior?.trigger?.isConnected) prior.trigger.focus?.();
+  }
+
+  function safeText(value) {
+    return string(value).replace(
+      /[&<>"']/g,
+      (character) =>
+        ({
+          "&": "&amp;",
+          "<": "&lt;",
+          ">": "&gt;",
+          '"': "&quot;",
+          "'": "&#39;",
+        })[character],
+    );
+  }
+
+  function openFixShell(entry, trigger, title, body) {
+    closeFixDialog(false);
+    const root = document.createElement("div");
+    root.className = "atlas-issue-fix-backdrop";
+    root.innerHTML = `<section class="atlas-issue-fix-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="atlas-fix-title" tabindex="-1"><header class="atlas-issue-fix-header"><div><h2 id="atlas-fix-title">${safeText(title)}</h2><p class="hint">${safeText(entry.summary)}</p></div><button class="btn ghost small" type="button" data-fix-cancel>Cancel</button></header><div>${body}</div><p class="atlas-issue-fix-error" role="alert" data-fix-error></p></section>`;
+    document.body.append(root);
+    activeFix = {
+      root,
+      trigger,
+      key: entry.stableKey,
+      auditKey: auditIdentity(),
+    };
+    root.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+      if (event.target === root || event.target.closest("[data-fix-cancel]"))
+        closeFixDialog();
+    });
+    root.addEventListener("keydown", (event) => {
+      if (event.key === "Escape") {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        closeFixDialog();
+        return;
+      }
+      if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
+      const controls = [
+        ...root.querySelectorAll(
+          'button:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
+        ),
+      ].filter(
+        (control) =>
+          !control.hidden && control.getAttribute("aria-hidden") !== "true",
+      );
+      if (!controls.length) {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        root.querySelector("[role=dialog]")?.focus();
+        return;
+      }
+      const first = controls[0];
+      const last = controls[controls.length - 1];
+      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        last.focus();
+      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
+        event.preventDefault();
+        first.focus();
+      }
+    });
+    requestAnimationFrame(() =>
+      root.querySelector("textarea,input,button")?.focus(),
+    );
+    return activeFix;
+  }
+
+  function completeFix(message) {
+    closeFixDialog();
+    invalidate();
+    status?.(message, "ok");
+  }
+
+  const fixActions = {
+    editAuditPurpose(entry, trigger) {
+      const fix = openFixShell(
+        entry,
+        trigger,
+        "Add Audit Description",
+        '<label>Audit Description<textarea data-fix-purpose></textarea></label><div class="atlas-issue-fix-actions"><button class="btn ghost" type="button" data-fix-cancel>Cancel</button><button class="btn primary" type="button" data-fix-save>Save description</button></div>',
+      );
+      const input = fix.root.querySelector("[data-fix-purpose]");
+      input.value = string(state.audit?.purpose);
+      fix.root.querySelector("[data-fix-save]").onclick = () => {
+        if (!freshIssue(fix.key, fix.auditKey)) {
+          closeFixDialog();
+          invalidate();
+          status?.(
+            "The audit or issue changed. Reopen the fix and try again.",
+            "warn",
+          );
+          return;
+        }
+        const value = input.value.trim();
+        if (!value) {
+          fix.root.querySelector("[data-fix-error]").textContent =
+            "Enter an Audit Description before saving.";
+          input.focus();
+          return;
+        }
+        state.audit.purpose = value;
+        const owner = document.querySelector("#auditPurpose");
+        if (owner) owner.value = value;
+        atlasInvalidatePages?.(["overview", "review"]);
+        scheduleAutosave?.();
+        completeFix("Audit Description updated.");
+      };
+      return true;
+    },
+    addAssignment(entry, trigger) {
+      const role =
+        string(entry.target?.field).split(".").pop() ||
+        string(entry.instanceId);
+      const labels = {
+        assigned: "Assigned Analyst",
+        backup: "Backup Analyst",
+        developer: "Developer",
+      };
+      const api = global.ATLASAssignmentEditor;
+      if (!labels[role] || typeof api?.open !== "function")
+        throw Object.assign(new Error("Assignment adapter unavailable."), {
+          userMessage:
+            "The assignment selector is unavailable. Open Audit Overview to update the assignment.",
+        });
+      const auditKey = auditIdentity();
+      const issueKey = entry.stableKey;
+      return api.open(role, {
+        trigger,
+        validateSelection() {
+          return Boolean(freshIssue(issueKey, auditKey));
+        },
+        onAssigned() {
+          invalidate();
+          status?.(`${labels[role]} updated.`, "ok");
+        },
+      });
+    },
+    addSource(entry, trigger) {
+      if (
+        !global.ATLASVisualPicker ||
+        typeof global.ATLASVisualPicker.open !== "function" ||
+        typeof global.sourceCatalogEntries !== "function" ||
+        typeof global.addSourceFileToAudit !== "function"
+      )
+        throw Object.assign(new Error("Source adapter unavailable."), {
+          userMessage:
+            "The source selector is unavailable. Open Sources to add the required source.",
+        });
+      const auditKey = auditIdentity();
+      const entries = global.sourceCatalogEntries().map((item) => ({
+        key: string(item.sourceKey || item.sourceFile),
+        label: string(
+          global.sourceCatalogDisplayName?.(item) ||
+            item.alias ||
+            item.sourceFile,
+        ),
+        rawName: string(item.sourceFile || item.sourceKey),
+        sourceKey: string(item.sourceKey || item.sourceFile),
+        sourceLabel: string(
+          global.sourceCatalogDisplayName?.(item) || item.sourceFile,
+        ),
+        sourceColor: "#667085",
+      }));
+      return global.ATLASVisualPicker.open({
+        mode: "source",
+        title: "Add Source",
+        entries,
+        onSelect(item) {
+          if (!freshIssue(entry.stableKey, auditKey)) {
+            invalidate();
+            status?.(
+              "The audit or issue changed. Reopen the source selector and try again.",
+              "warn",
+            );
+            return;
+          }
+          if (global.addSourceFileToAudit(item.sourceKey || item.key)) {
+            invalidate();
+            status?.("Audit source updated.", "ok");
+            trigger?.focus?.();
+          }
+        },
+      });
+    },
+  };
+
+  const jumpActions = {
+    openAuditName(entry) {
+      return openOverviewTarget(entry, "#auditName");
+    },
+    openAuditPurpose(entry) {
+      return openOverviewTarget(entry, "#auditPurpose");
+    },
+    async openAssignmentRole(entry) {

+        string(entry.instanceId);

+        {
+          assigned: '[data-open-assignment-picker="assigned"]',
+          backup: '[data-open-assignment-picker="backup"]',
+          developer: '[data-open-assignment-picker="developer"]',
+        }[role] || '[data-open-assignment-picker="assigned"]';
+      return openOverviewTarget(entry, selector);
+    },
+    async openSources() {
+      await navigateTo("fields");
+      focusAfterNavigation("#sourceFieldSearch", "#sourceFieldBrowser");
+      return true;
+    },
+    async openLogicTarget(entry) {
+      const stepId = string(entry.target?.stepId);
+      await navigateTo("steps");
+      if (stepId && typeof global.atlasRevealLogicStep === "function") {
+        const revealed = global.atlasRevealLogicStep(stepId, {
+          highlight: true,
+          includeSelectedStep: true,
+          includeLogicTable: true,
+          focus: false,
+        });
+        if (!revealed) {
+          focusAfterNavigation("#stepsList", "#page-steps");
+          return false;
+        }
+        global.requestAnimationFrame(() => {
+          const root = document.querySelector(
+            `[data-live-editor-step-id="${CSS.escape(stepId)}"]`,
+          );
+          const field = string(entry.target?.field);
+          const target =
+            (field === "action" &&
+              root?.querySelector(
+                '[name="then_action_type"], [data-param="then_action_type"]',
+              )) ||
+            (field === "join" &&
+              root?.querySelector(
+                '[name="join_type"], [data-param="join_type"]',

+            root?.querySelector(

+      const selector = key

+        : "#addDisplayFieldBtn";

+      await navigateTo("review");
+      focusAfterNavigation("#validationPanel", "#page-review");
+      return true;
