+
+  function signatureFor(context) {
+    return JSON.stringify(context);
+  }
+
+  function current() {
+    const active =
+      typeof hasSelectedAudit === "function"
+        ? hasSelectedAudit()
+        : Boolean(state?.auditSelected);
+    if (!active)
+      return Object.freeze({
+        status: "ok",
+        counts: Object.freeze({ ok: 1, warning: 0, critical: 0, total: 0 }),
+        issues: Object.freeze([]),
+      });
+    if (catalogError) {
+      return Object.freeze({
+        status: "warning",
+        counts: Object.freeze({ ok: 0, warning: 1, critical: 0, total: 1 }),
+        issues: Object.freeze([
+          {
+            ruleId: "system.catalog",
+            instanceId: "load",
+            stableKey: "system|catalog|load",
+            severity: "warning",
+            category: "system",
+            priority: -1,
+            title: "Audit issue rules unavailable",
+            summary: "Audit issue rules could not be loaded.",
+            detail: string(catalogError.message),
+            target: {},
+            canJump: false,
+            canFix: false,
+            jumpAction: null,
+            fixAction: null,
+            actionData: {},
+          },
+        ]),
+      });
+    }
+    if (!catalog || !global.AuditIssueEngine?.create)
+      return Object.freeze({
+        status: "ok",
+        counts: Object.freeze({ ok: 1, warning: 0, critical: 0, total: 0 }),
+        issues: Object.freeze([]),
+      });
+    const context = buildContext();
+    const signature = signatureFor(context);
+    if (
+      cache.result &&
+      cache.generation === generation &&
+      cache.signature === signature
+    )
+      return cache.result;
+    const engine = global.AuditIssueEngine.create({
+      evaluators,
+      jumpActions,
+      fixActions,
+    });
+    cache = {
+      generation,
+      signature,
+      result: engine.evaluate(context, catalog.rules),
+    };
+    return cache.result;
+  }
+
+  function invalidate() {
+    generation += 1;
+    cache = { generation: -1, signature: "", result: null };
+    scheduleIssueRender();
+    return generation;
+  }
+
+  function legacyIssues() {
+    return current().issues.map((entry) => ({
+      level: entry.severity === "critical" ? "error" : "warn",
+      message: entry.summary,
+      code: entry.ruleId,
+      stepId: entry.target?.stepId || "",
+      conditionId: entry.target?.conditionId || "",
+    }));
+  }
+
+  function loadCatalog() {
+    if (catalogPromise) return catalogPromise;
+    catalogPromise = (
+      typeof global.fetchJsonGracefully === "function"
+        ? global.fetchJsonGracefully(CATALOG_URL)
+        : fetch(CATALOG_URL).then((response) => {
+            if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}`);
+            return response.json();
+          })
+    )
+      .then((value) => {
+        if (!value || !Array.isArray(value.rules))
+          throw new Error("Rule catalog is missing a rules array.");
+        catalog = value;
+        catalogError = null;
+        invalidate();
+        global.renderValidationPanel?.();
+        return value;
+      })
+      .catch((error) => {
+        catalogError = error;
+        invalidate();
+        global.renderValidationPanel?.();
+        return null;
+      });
+    return catalogPromise;
+  }
+
+  let uiBound = false;
+  let renderQueued = false;
+  let lastFocusedElement = null;
+  let renderedAuditKey = "";
+  const filters = { severity: "all" };
+  const readinessFilters = { severity: "all" };
+
+  function scheduleIssueRender() {
+    if (typeof document === "undefined") return;
+    if (renderQueued) return;
+    renderQueued = true;
+    const enqueue =
+      global.requestAnimationFrame ||
+      (global.setTimeout
+        ? (callback) => global.setTimeout(callback, 0)
+        : (callback) => callback());
+    enqueue(() => {
+      renderQueued = false;
+      renderIssueSurfaces();
+    });
+  }
+
+  function uiElements() {
+    return {
+      root: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-root"),
+      trigger: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-trigger"),
+      triggerText: document.querySelector(".atlas-audit-issues__trigger-text"),
+      panel: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-panel"),
+      backdrop: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-backdrop"),
+      close: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-close"),
+      list: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-list"),
+      count: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-count"),
+      refresh: document.getElementById("atlas-audit-issues-refresh"),
+      readinessSummary: document.getElementById(
+        "atlas-readiness-issue-summary",
+      ),
+      readinessCategories: document.getElementById(
+        "atlas-readiness-category-status",
+      ),
+      readinessFilters: document.querySelector(".readiness-issue-filters"),
+      readinessList: document.getElementById("validationPanel"),
+      readinessRefresh: document.getElementById(
+        "atlas-readiness-issues-refresh",
+      ),
+    };
+  }
+
+  function stateLabel(result) {
+    if (result.status === "critical" || result.counts?.critical)
+      return "critical";
+    if (result.status === "warning" || result.counts?.warning) return "warning";
+    return "ok";
+  }
+
+  function summaryText(result) {
+    const critical = Number(result.counts?.critical || 0);
+    const warning = Number(result.counts?.warning || 0);
+    return `${critical} critical, ${warning} warning, ${critical + warning} total issues.`;
+  }
+
+  function appendText(element, tag, text, className) {
+    const child = document.createElement(tag);
+    if (className) child.className = className;
+    child.textContent = text;
+    element.appendChild(child);
+    return child;
+  }
+
+  function issueCategories(issues) {
+    const workflowOrder = new Map([
+      ["sources", 100],
+      ["logic", 200],
+      ["display-fields", 300],
+    ]);
+    return [
+      ...new Set(
+        issues.map(
+          (entry) => string(entry.category || "general").trim() || "general",
+        ),
+      ),
+    ].sort((left, right) => {
+      const leftOrder = workflowOrder.get(left);
+      const rightOrder = workflowOrder.get(right);
+      if (leftOrder != null && rightOrder != null)
+        return leftOrder - rightOrder;
+      if (leftOrder != null) return 1;
+      if (rightOrder != null) return -1;
+      return left.localeCompare(right);
+    });
+  }
+
+  function categoryLabel(category) {
+    if (category === "display-fields") return "Display Fields";
+    return category.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + category.slice(1);
+  }
+
+  function renderIssueCards(container, result, filterState, includeGroups) {
+    if (!container) return;
+    container.replaceChildren();
+    if (result.error) {
+      const message = appendText(
+        container,
+        "div",
+        "Audit issues could not be evaluated. Refresh after the rule catalog and evaluators are available.",
+        "atlas-audit-issues__state atlas-audit-issues__state--error",
+      );
+      message.setAttribute("role", "alert");
+      return;
+    }
+    const issues = array(result.issues).filter(
+      (entry) =>
+        filterState.severity === "all" ||
+        entry.severity === filterState.severity,
+    );
+    if (!issues.length) {
+      appendText(
+        container,
+        "p",
+        array(result.issues).length
+          ? "No issues match the selected filters."
+          : "No warning or critical audit issues were found.",
+        "atlas-audit-issues__state",
+      );
+      return;
+    }
+    const groups = includeGroups ? issueCategories(issues) : [""];
+    groups.forEach((category) => {
+      const group = document.createElement("section");
+      group.className = "atlas-audit-issues__group";
+      if (includeGroups)
+        appendText(
+          group,
+          "h3",
+          categoryLabel(category),
+          "atlas-audit-issues__group-title",
+        );
+      issues
+        .filter((entry) => !category || entry.category === category)
+        .forEach((entry) => {
+          const card = document.createElement("article");
+          card.className = `atlas-audit-issue-card atlas-audit-issue-card--${entry.severity}`;
+          card.dataset.issueId = string(entry.id || entry.ruleId);
+          const heading = appendText(
+            card,
+            "h4",
+            string(entry.title || entry.summary || "Audit issue"),
+            "atlas-audit-issue-card__title",
+          );
+          const severity = appendText(
+            heading,
+            "span",
+            string(entry.severity || "warning"),
+            "atlas-audit-issue-card__severity",
+          );
+          severity.setAttribute(
+            "aria-label",
+            `Severity ${string(entry.severity || "warning")}`,
+          );
+          appendText(
+            card,
+            "p",
+            string(entry.summary || entry.detail || "Review this audit issue."),
+            "atlas-audit-issue-card__summary",
+          );
+          if (entry.detail && entry.detail !== entry.summary)
+            appendText(
+              card,
+              "p",
+              string(entry.detail),
+              "atlas-audit-issue-card__detail",
+            );
+          const context = [
+            entry.page || entry.owningPage,
+            entry.target?.stepId && `Step ${entry.target.stepId}`,
+            entry.target?.conditionId &&
+              `Condition ${entry.target.conditionId}`,
+          ]
+            .filter(Boolean)
+            .join(" · ");
+          if (context)
+            appendText(card, "p", context, "atlas-audit-issue-card__context");
+          const actions = document.createElement("div");
+          actions.className = "atlas-audit-issue-card__actions";
+          if (
+            entry.canFix &&
+            typeof fixActions[entry.fixAction] === "function"
+          ) {
+            const fix = appendText(
+              actions,
+              "button",
+              "Fix",
+              "btn primary small",
+            );
+            fix.type = "button";
+            fix.dataset.atlasIssueFix = entry.stableKey;
+          }
+          if (
+            entry.canJump &&
+            typeof jumpActions[entry.jumpAction] === "function"
+          ) {
+            const jump = appendText(
+              actions,
+              "button",
+              "Jump to issue",
+              "btn secondary small",
+            );
+            jump.type = "button";
+            jump.dataset.atlasIssueJump = entry.stableKey;
+          }
+          if (actions.childElementCount) card.appendChild(actions);
+          group.appendChild(card);
+        });
+      container.appendChild(group);
+    });
+  }
+
+  function updateSeverityButtons(container, filterState, result) {
+    if (!container) return;
+    const critical = Number(result.counts?.critical || 0);
+    const warning = Number(result.counts?.warning || 0);
+    const total = critical + warning;
+    container
+      .querySelectorAll("[data-atlas-issue-severity]")
+      .forEach((button) => {
+        const severity = button.dataset.atlasIssueSeverity;
+        const count =
+          severity === "critical"
+            ? critical
+            : severity === "warning"
+              ? warning
+              : total;
+        const label =
+          severity === "critical"
+            ? "Critical"
+            : severity === "warning"
+              ? "Warning"
+              : "All";
+        button.textContent = `${label} (${count})`;
+        const selected = filterState.severity === severity;
+        button.classList.toggle("is-active", selected);
+        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
+      });
+  }
+
+  function renderIssueSurfaces() {
+    const elements = uiElements();
+    if (!elements.root && !elements.readinessList) return;
+    if (elements.root) bindIssueUI(elements);
+    const active =
+      typeof hasSelectedAudit === "function"
+        ? hasSelectedAudit()
+        : Boolean(state?.auditSelected);
+    const activePage =
+      document.querySelector(".page.active")?.dataset.page ||
+      global.localStorage?.getItem?.("atlasAlignActiveSection") ||
+      "my-audits";
+    const floatingSurfaceEligible =
+      active &&
+      [
+        "overview",
+        "fields",
+        "steps",
+        "display-fields",
+        "preview",
+        "review",
+        "save",
+      ].includes(activePage);
+    if (elements.root) elements.root.hidden = !floatingSurfaceEligible;
+    if (!floatingSurfaceEligible) closeIssuePanel(false);
+    if (!active) {
+      closeIssuePanel(false);
+      if (elements.readinessSummary)
+        elements.readinessSummary.textContent =
+          "No active audit. Select an audit to review readiness.";
+      if (elements.readinessList) elements.readinessList.replaceChildren();
+      return;
+    }
+    renderedAuditKey = currentAuditKey();
+    const result = current();
+    const status = stateLabel(result);
+    if (elements.root) elements.root.dataset.status = status;
+    const criticalCount = Number(result.counts?.critical || 0);
+    const warningCount = Number(result.counts?.warning || 0);
+    const totalCount = criticalCount + warningCount;
+    if (elements.count) elements.count.textContent = String(totalCount);
+    elements.root
+      ?.querySelectorAll("[data-atlas-issue-severity]")
+      .forEach((button) => {
+        const severity = button.dataset.atlasIssueSeverity;
+        const count =
+          severity === "critical"
+            ? criticalCount
+            : severity === "warning"
+              ? warningCount
+              : totalCount;
+        const label =
+          severity === "critical"
+            ? "Critical"
+            : severity === "warning"
+              ? "Warning"
+              : "All";
+        button.textContent = `${label} (${count})`;
+        const selected = filters.severity === severity;
+        button.classList.toggle("is-active", selected);
+        button.setAttribute("aria-pressed", String(selected));
+      });
+    const statusText = `${status === "ok" ? "Ready" : status === "critical" ? "Critical audit issues" : "Audit warnings"}. ${summaryText(result)}`;
+    elements.trigger?.setAttribute("aria-label", statusText);
+    if (elements.triggerText) elements.triggerText.textContent = statusText;
+    renderIssueCards(elements.list, result, filters, true);
+    if (elements.readinessSummary)
+      elements.readinessSummary.textContent = summaryText(result);
+    updateSeverityButtons(elements.readinessFilters, readinessFilters, result);
+    if (elements.readinessCategories)
+      elements.readinessCategories.textContent =
+        issueCategories(array(result.issues))
+          .map(
+            (category) =>
+              `${category}: ${array(result.issues).filter((entry) => entry.category === category).length}`,
+          )
+          .join("; ") || "All categories clear.";
+    renderIssueCards(elements.readinessList, result, readinessFilters, true);
+  }
+
+  function focusableInPanel(panel) {
+    return array(
+      panel?.querySelectorAll(
+        'button:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [href], [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])',
+      ),
+    );
+  }
+
+  function openIssuePanel() {
+    const elements = uiElements();
+    if (!elements.panel || !elements.trigger) return;
+    lastFocusedElement = document.activeElement;
+    elements.panel.hidden = false;
+    if (elements.backdrop) elements.backdrop.hidden = false;
+    elements.trigger.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
+    document.body.classList.add("atlas-audit-issues-open");
+    elements.close?.focus();
+  }
+
+  function closeIssuePanel(restoreFocus = true) {
+    const elements = uiElements();
+    if (!elements.panel || elements.panel.hidden) return;
+    elements.panel.hidden = true;
+    if (elements.backdrop) elements.backdrop.hidden = true;
+    elements.trigger?.setAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
+    document.body.classList.remove("atlas-audit-issues-open");
+    if (restoreFocus && lastFocusedElement?.isConnected)
+      lastFocusedElement.focus();
+  }
+
+  function handlePanelKeydown(event) {
+    const panel = uiElements().panel;
+    if (!panel || panel.hidden) return;
+    if (event.key === "Escape") {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      closeIssuePanel();
+      return;
+    }
+    if (event.key !== "Tab") return;
+    const focusable = focusableInPanel(panel);
+    if (!focusable.length) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      panel.focus();
+      return;
+    }
+    const first = focusable[0],
+      last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
+    if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      last.focus();
+    } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
+      event.preventDefault();
+      first.focus();
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function executeFix(stableKey, trigger) {
+    if (renderedAuditKey !== currentAuditKey()) {
+      status?.(
+        "The active audit changed. Audit issues were refreshed before applying the fix.",
+        "warn",
+      );
+      invalidate();
+      return false;
+    }
+    const entry = current().issues.find((item) => item.stableKey === stableKey);
+    const action = entry && fixActions[entry.fixAction];
+    if (!entry || !entry.canFix || typeof action !== "function") {
+      status?.("This audit issue no longer has an available fix.", "warn");
+      invalidate();
+      return false;
+    }
+    try {
+      const opened = Boolean(await action(entry, trigger));
+      if (!opened)
+        status?.(
+          "The remediation workflow could not be opened. Use Jump to complete the update in the owning page.",
+          "warn",
+        );
+      return opened;
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error("ATLAS Audit Issues: fix action failed safely.", {
+        ruleId: entry.ruleId,
+        message: string(error?.message),
+      });
+      status?.(
+        string(error?.userMessage) ||
+          "The remediation workflow could not be opened. Use Jump to complete the update in the owning page.",
+        "bad",
+      );
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  async function executeJump(stableKey) {
+    if (!stableKey) return false;
+    if (!renderedAuditKey || renderedAuditKey !== currentAuditKey()) {
+      if (uiElements().summary)
+        uiElements().summary.textContent =
+          "The active audit changed. Refresh issues before continuing.";
+      invalidate();
+      return false;
+    }
+    const entry = current().issues.find((item) => item.stableKey === stableKey);
+    const action = entry && jumpActions[entry.jumpAction];
+    if (!entry || !entry.canJump || typeof action !== "function") return false;
+    closeIssuePanel(false);
+    try {
+      return Boolean(await action(entry));
+    } catch (error) {
+      console.error("ATLAS Audit Issues: jump action failed safely.", {
+        ruleId: entry.ruleId,
+        message: string(error?.message),
+      });
+      await navigateTo(entry.target?.page || "review");
+      return false;
+    }
+  }
+
+  function bindIssueUI(elements = uiElements()) {
+    if (uiBound || !elements.root) return;
+    uiBound = true;
+    elements.trigger?.addEventListener("click", openIssuePanel);
+    elements.close?.addEventListener("click", () => closeIssuePanel());
+    elements.backdrop?.addEventListener("click", () => closeIssuePanel());
+    elements.panel?.addEventListener("keydown", handlePanelKeydown);
+    elements.refresh?.addEventListener("click", invalidate);
+    elements.readinessRefresh?.addEventListener("click", invalidate);
+    document.addEventListener("input", invalidate);
+    document.addEventListener("change", invalidate);
+    document.addEventListener("click", (event) => {
+      const fix = event.target.closest("[data-atlas-issue-fix]");
+      if (fix) {
+        executeFix(fix.dataset.atlasIssueFix, fix);
+        return;
+      }
+      const jump = event.target.closest("[data-atlas-issue-jump]");
+      if (jump) {
+        executeJump(jump.dataset.atlasIssueJump);
+        return;
+      }
+      const button = event.target.closest("[data-atlas-issue-severity]");
+      if (!button) return;
+      const filterState =
+        button.dataset.atlasIssueSurface === "readiness"
+          ? readinessFilters
+          : filters;
+      filterState.severity = button.dataset.atlasIssueSeverity;
+      scheduleIssueRender();
+    });
+  }
+
+  global.ATLASAuditIssues = Object.freeze({
+    buildContext,
+    current,
+    invalidate,
+    legacyIssues,
+    loadCatalog,
+    catalogReady: loadCatalog(),
+    render: scheduleIssueRender,
+    jumpToIssue: executeJump,
+  });
+  global.atlasMarkLogicIssuesDirty = invalidate;
+  global.atlasLogicIssues = () => current().issues;
+  scheduleIssueRender();
+})(window);
+

+/* Phase 5 browser workflow and published-lock coordinator. Classic script. */
+let atlasWorkflowSummary = null;
+let atlasWorkflowAuditId = null;
+let atlasWorkflowFeatures = Object.freeze({});
+let atlasWorkflowLoadState = "idle";
+let atlasWorkflowLoadError = null;
+let atlasWorkflowLoadSequence = 0;
+function atlasWorkflowFeature(name) {
+  return Boolean(atlasWorkflowFeatures?.[name]);
+}
+function atlasApplyWorkflowFeatureVisibility() {
+  const pageFlags = {
+    inbox: "reads",
+    history: "history",
+    "recently-deleted-publications": "publicationDeletion",
+  };
+  for (const [section, flag] of Object.entries(pageFlags))
+    document
+      .querySelector(`[data-section="${section}"]`)
+      ?.toggleAttribute("hidden", !atlasWorkflowFeature(flag));
+}
+function atlasActiveAuditId() {
+  return state?.audit?._database?.id || state?.audit?.id || null;
+}
+function atlasAuditIsPublishedLocked() {
+  return Boolean(
+    atlasWorkflowSummary &&
+    atlasWorkflowSummary.auditId === atlasActiveAuditId() &&
+    atlasWorkflowSummary.workflowStatus === "Published" &&
+    atlasWorkflowSummary.publishedLocked,
+  );
+}
+function atlasWorkflowCan(name) {
+  return Boolean(atlasWorkflowSummary?.capabilities?.[name]);
+}
+async function atlasLoadWorkflowSummary() {
+  const auditId = atlasActiveAuditId();
+  const sequence = ++atlasWorkflowLoadSequence;
+  if (!auditId) {
+    atlasWorkflowSummary = null;
+    atlasWorkflowAuditId = null;
+    atlasWorkflowLoadState = "idle";
+    atlasWorkflowLoadError = null;
+    atlasRenderWorkflowCard();
+    atlasApplyPublishedLock();
+    return null;
+  }
+  atlasWorkflowSummary = null;
+  atlasWorkflowAuditId = auditId;
+  atlasWorkflowLoadState = "loading";
+  atlasWorkflowLoadError = null;
+  atlasRenderWorkflowCard();
+  atlasApplyPublishedLock();
+  try {
+    const summary = await atlasAuditApi(
+      `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(auditId)}/workflow`,
+    );
+    if (
+      sequence !== atlasWorkflowLoadSequence ||
+      auditId !== atlasActiveAuditId()
+    )
+      return null;
+    atlasWorkflowSummary = summary;
+    atlasWorkflowFeatures = Object.freeze({ ...(summary.features || {}) });
+    atlasWorkflowAuditId = auditId;
+    atlasWorkflowLoadState = "ready";
+    atlasApplyWorkflowFeatureVisibility();
+    atlasRenderWorkflowCard();
+    atlasRenderPublicationFlow();
+    atlasApplyPublishedLock();
+    return summary;
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (
+      sequence !== atlasWorkflowLoadSequence ||
+      auditId !== atlasActiveAuditId()
+    )
+      return null;
+    atlasWorkflowSummary = null;
+    atlasWorkflowAuditId = auditId;
+    atlasWorkflowLoadError = error;
+    atlasWorkflowLoadState = error.status === 403 ? "unavailable" : "error";
+    atlasRenderWorkflowCard();
+    atlasRenderPublicationFlow();
+    atlasApplyPublishedLock();
+    status(error.message, "bad");
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+function atlasWorkflowText(value, fallback = "Not available") {
+  return value == null || value === "" ? fallback : String(value);
+}
+function atlasRenderWorkflowCard() {
+  const host = document.getElementById("atlasWorkflowCardBody");
+  if (!host) return;
+  const activeAuditId = atlasActiveAuditId();
+  const w = atlasWorkflowSummary;
+  if (
+    atlasWorkflowAuditId === activeAuditId &&
+    atlasWorkflowLoadState === "loading"
+  ) {
+    host.innerHTML = '<p class="hint" role="status">Loading workflow...</p>';
+    return;
+  }
+  if (
+    atlasWorkflowAuditId === activeAuditId &&
+    atlasWorkflowLoadState === "unavailable"
+  ) {
+    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" role="status">Workflow is unavailable. ${esc(atlasWorkflowLoadError?.message || "This workflow feature is not enabled.")}</p>`;
+    return;
+  }
+  if (
+    atlasWorkflowAuditId === activeAuditId &&
+    atlasWorkflowLoadState === "error"
+  ) {
+    host.innerHTML = `<p class="hint" role="status">Workflow could not be loaded. ${esc(atlasWorkflowLoadError?.message || "Try Refresh again.")}</p>`;
+    return;
+  }
+  if (!w || w.auditId !== activeAuditId) {
+    host.innerHTML =
+      '<p class="hint">Load a database audit to view workflow details.</p>';
+    return;
+  }
+  const analysts =
+    state.audit?.assignments?.assignedAnalysts ||
+    state.audit?.assignments?.assigned ||
+    [];
+  const analystNames =
+    analysts
+      .map((a) => a.fullName || a.displayName || a.username)
+      .filter(Boolean)
+      .join(", ") || "None assigned";
+  host.innerHTML = `<div class="workflow-grid">
+    <div><span class="hint">State</span><div class="workflow-value">${esc(w.workflowStatus)}</div></div>
+    <div><span class="hint">Assigned Analysts</span><div class="workflow-value">${esc(analystNames)}</div></div>
+    <div><span class="hint">Working revision</span><div class="workflow-value">${esc(w.currentRevisionNumber)} (ID ${esc(w.currentRevisionId)})</div></div>
+    <div><span class="hint">Pending request</span><div class="workflow-value">${esc(atlasWorkflowText(w.currentRequestId))}</div></div>
+    <div><span class="hint">Approval</span><div class="workflow-value">${esc(atlasWorkflowText(w.currentApprovalId))}</div></div>
+    <div><span class="hint">Publication</span><div class="workflow-value">${esc(atlasWorkflowText(w.currentPublicationId))}</div></div>
+    <div><span class="hint">Unpublished changes</span><div class="workflow-value">${w.workingFromPublicationId ? "Yes" : "No"}</div></div>
+  </div><div class="workflow-actions">
+    ${atlasWorkflowCan("canSubmit") ? '<button class="btn primary" data-workflow-action="submit" type="button">Submit for Approval</button>' : ""}
+    ${w.currentRequestId ? '<button class="btn secondary" data-workflow-action="view-request" type="button">View Approval Request</button>' : ""}
+    ${atlasWorkflowCan("canApprove") && w.currentRequestId ? '<button class="btn primary" data-workflow-action="approve" type="button">Approve</button><button class="btn danger" data-workflow-action="deny" type="button">Deny</button>' : ""}
+    ${atlasWorkflowCan("canPublish") ? '<button class="btn primary" data-workflow-action="publish" type="button">Publish Version</button>' : ""}
+    ${atlasWorkflowCan("canUnlock") ? '<button class="btn secondary" data-workflow-action="unlock" type="button">Unlock Audit</button>' : ""}
+    ${atlasWorkflowCan("canViewHistory") ? '<button class="btn secondary" data-workflow-action="history" type="button">View Audit History</button><button class="btn secondary" data-workflow-action="publications" type="button">View Published Versions</button>' : ""}
+    ${atlasWorkflowCan("canDeletePublication") ? '<button class="btn secondary" data-workflow-action="deleted-publications" type="button">Administer Deleted Publications</button>' : ""}
+  </div>`;
+}
+function atlasWorkflowDialog(title, body, actions = "") {
+  const host =
+    document.getElementById("atlasWorkflowDialogHost") || document.body;
+  const previous = document.activeElement;
+  const wrap = document.createElement("div");
+  wrap.className = "workflow-dialog-backdrop";
+  wrap.innerHTML = `<section class="workflow-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="atlasWorkflowDialogTitle"><h2 id="atlasWorkflowDialogTitle">${esc(title)}</h2><div>${body}</div><div class="workflow-dialog-actions">${actions}<button class="btn secondary" data-close-workflow-dialog type="button">Close</button></div></section>`;
+  host.appendChild(wrap);
+  const close = () => {
+    wrap.remove();
+    previous?.focus?.();
+  };
+  wrap.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
+    if (e.target === wrap || e.target.closest("[data-close-workflow-dialog]"))
+      close();
+  });
+  wrap.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
+    if (e.key === "Escape") close();
+  });
+  wrap.querySelector("input,textarea,select,button")?.focus();
+  return { wrap, close };
+}
+async function atlasWorkflowPreviewRequest() {
+  const w = await atlasLoadWorkflowSummary();
+  if (!w?.currentRequestId)
+    throw new Error("No current approval request is available.");
+  return atlasAuditApi(
+    `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(w.auditId)}/previews/approval-requests/${encodeURIComponent(w.currentRequestId)}`,
+  );
+}
+async function atlasShowApprovalReview(mode = "view") {
+  const p = await atlasWorkflowPreviewRequest();
+  const comparison =
+    typeof atlasStructuredComparisonHtml === "function"
+      ? atlasStructuredComparisonHtml(p.comparison)
+      : `<pre>${esc(JSON.stringify(p.comparison, null, 2))}</pre>`;
+  const response =
+    mode === "view"
+      ? ""
+      : `<label>${mode === "deny" ? "Denial response (required)" : "Reviewer comments"}<textarea id="atlasReviewerResponse" ${mode === "deny" ? "required" : ""}></textarea></label>`;
+  const action =
+    mode === "view"
+      ? ""
+      : `<button class="btn ${mode === "deny" ? "danger" : "primary"}" data-confirm-decision="${mode}" type="button">${mode === "deny" ? "Deny" : "Approve"}</button>`;
+  const dialog = atlasWorkflowDialog(
+    "Approval request review",
+    `<p class="hint">Submitted revision ${esc(p.source?.revisionNumber || p.sourceRevisionNumber || "")}</p>${comparison}${response}`,
+    action,
+  );
+  dialog.wrap
+    .querySelector("[data-confirm-decision]")
+    ?.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
+      const text =
+        dialog.wrap.querySelector("#atlasReviewerResponse")?.value.trim() || "";
+      if (mode === "deny" && !text) {
+        status("A denial response is required.", "bad");
+        return;
+      }
+      e.currentTarget.disabled = true;
+      try {
+        const w = await atlasLoadWorkflowSummary();
+        await atlasAuditApi(
+          `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(w.auditId)}/approval-requests/${encodeURIComponent(w.currentRequestId)}/${mode}`,
+          {
+            method: "POST",
+            body: JSON.stringify({
+              expectedRevisionId: w.currentRevisionId,
+              reviewerResponse: text,
+            }),
+          },
+        );
+        dialog.close();
+        await atlasLoadWorkflowSummary();
+        window.ATLASInbox?.refresh?.();
+        status(`Request ${mode === "approve" ? "approved" : "denied"}.`, "ok");
+      } catch (error) {
+        e.currentTarget.disabled = false;
+        status(error.message, "bad");
+      }
+    });
+}
+async function atlasSubmitForApproval() {
+  if (typeof atlasSaveIfDirty === "function") await atlasSaveIfDirty();
+  const w = await atlasLoadWorkflowSummary();
+  if (!w || !atlasWorkflowCan("canSubmit"))
+    throw new Error("Submission is not currently available.");
+  const dialog = atlasWorkflowDialog(
+    "Submit for Approval",
+    `<label>Approver username<input id="atlasSubmitApprover" required></label><label>Message<textarea id="atlasSubmitMessage"></textarea></label>`,
+    '<button class="btn primary" data-confirm-submit type="button">Submit</button>',
+  );
+  dialog.wrap
+    .querySelector("[data-confirm-submit]")
+    .addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
+      const username = dialog.wrap
+        .querySelector("#atlasSubmitApprover")
+        .value.trim();
+      if (!username) {
+        status("Select an approver.", "bad");
+        return;
+      }
+      e.currentTarget.disabled = true;
+      try {
+        await atlasAuditApi(
+          `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(w.auditId)}/submit`,
+          {
+            method: "POST",
+            body: JSON.stringify({
+              expectedRevisionId: w.currentRevisionId,
+              selectedApprover: { username },
+              requesterMessage: dialog.wrap
+                .querySelector("#atlasSubmitMessage")
+                .value.trim(),
+            }),
+          },
+        );
+        dialog.close();
+        await atlasLoadWorkflowSummary();
+        window.ATLASInbox?.refresh?.();
+        status("Audit submitted for approval.", "ok");
+      } catch (error) {
+        e.currentTarget.disabled = false;
+        status(error.message, "bad");
+      }
+    });
+}
+async function atlasUnlockAudit() {
+  const w = await atlasLoadWorkflowSummary();
+  const dialog = atlasWorkflowDialog(
+    "Unlock published audit",
+    `<p>The existing publication remains immutable. Unlocking creates a Draft Revision that requires fresh approval.</p><label>Unlock reason<input id="atlasUnlockReason" required></label><label><input id="atlasUnlockConfirm" type="checkbox"> I understand the publication remains immutable.</label>`,
+    '<button class="btn danger" data-confirm-unlock type="button">Unlock Audit</button>',
+  );
+  dialog.wrap
+    .querySelector("[data-confirm-unlock]")
+    .addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
+      const reason = dialog.wrap
+        .querySelector("#atlasUnlockReason")
+        .value.trim();
+      if (
+        !reason ||
+        !dialog.wrap.querySelector("#atlasUnlockConfirm").checked
+      ) {
+        status("Provide a reason and confirm publication immutability.", "bad");
+        return;
+      }
+      e.currentTarget.disabled = true;
+      try {
+        await atlasAuditApi(
+          `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(w.auditId)}/unlock`,
+          {
+            method: "POST",
+            body: JSON.stringify({
+              expectedRevisionId: w.currentRevisionId,
+              expectedPublicationId: w.currentPublicationId,
+              reason,
+            }),
+          },
+        );
+        dialog.close();
+        await atlasLoadWorkflowSummary();
+        status("Audit unlocked as Draft Revision.", "ok");
+      } catch (error) {
+        e.currentTarget.disabled = false;
+        status(error.message, "bad");
+      }
+    });
+}
+function atlasApplyPublishedLock() {
+  const locked = atlasAuditIsPublishedLocked();
+  document.body.classList.toggle("atlas-published-locked", locked);
+  document
+    .querySelectorAll(
+      "#page-overview input,#page-overview textarea,#page-overview select,#page-fields input,#page-fields textarea,#page-fields select,#page-steps input,#page-steps textarea,#page-steps select,#page-display-fields input,#page-display-fields select",
+    )
+    .forEach((el) => {
+      if (locked) {
+        el.dataset.atlasWorkflowDisabled = String(el.disabled);
+        el.disabled = true;
+      } else if (el.dataset.atlasWorkflowDisabled !== undefined) {
+        el.disabled = el.dataset.atlasWorkflowDisabled === "true";
+        delete el.dataset.atlasWorkflowDisabled;
+      }
+    });
+  document
+    .querySelectorAll("[data-atlas-readonly-notice]")
+    .forEach((el) => el.remove());
+  if (locked) {
+    [
+      "page-overview",
+      "page-fields",
+      "page-steps",
+      "page-display-fields",
+    ].forEach((id) => {
+      const page = document.getElementById(id);
+      if (page) {
+        const n = document.createElement("div");
+        n.dataset.atlasReadonlyNotice = "";
+        n.className = "workflow-readonly";
+        n.setAttribute("role", "status");
+        n.textContent =
+          "Published audit: this view is read-only. History, publications, navigation, and exports remain available.";
+        page.prepend(n);
+      }
+    });
+  }
+}
+function atlasGuardPublishedMutation(event) {
+  if (!atlasAuditIsPublishedLocked()) return;
+  if (
+    !event.target.closest(
+      "#page-overview,#page-fields,#page-steps,#page-display-fields",
+    )
+  )
+    return;
+  if (
+    event.target.closest(
+      "[data-workflow-action='history'],[data-workflow-action='publications']",
+    )
+  )
+    return;
+  event.preventDefault();
+  event.stopImmediatePropagation();
+  status(
+    "Published audits are read-only. Unlock the audit to create a Draft Revision.",
+    "bad",
+  );
+}
+document.addEventListener("click", atlasGuardPublishedMutation, true);
+document.addEventListener("input", atlasGuardPublishedMutation, true);
+document.addEventListener("change", atlasGuardPublishedMutation, true);
+document.addEventListener("drop", atlasGuardPublishedMutation, true);
+document.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
+  const a = e.target.closest("[data-workflow-action]");
+  if (!a) return;
+  try {
+    const action = a.dataset.workflowAction;
+    if (action === "submit") await atlasSubmitForApproval();
+    else if (action === "view-request") await atlasShowApprovalReview();
+    else if (action === "approve" || action === "deny")
+      await atlasShowApprovalReview(action);
+    else if (action === "publish") showSection("save");
+    else if (action === "unlock") await atlasUnlockAudit();
+    else if (action === "history") await atlasOpenAuditHistory();
+    else if (action === "publications")
+      await window.ATLASHistory?.open?.("publication");
+  } catch (error) {
+    status(error.message, "bad");
+  }
+});
+document
+  .getElementById("atlasWorkflowRefresh")
+  ?.addEventListener("click", () => atlasLoadWorkflowSummary());
+window.ATLASWorkflow = {
+  refresh: atlasLoadWorkflowSummary,
+  isPublishedLocked: atlasAuditIsPublishedLocked,
+  render: atlasRenderWorkflowCard,
+  showApprovalReview: atlasShowApprovalReview,
+  feature: atlasWorkflowFeature,
+  can: atlasWorkflowCan,
+  get summary() {

+  },

+for (const name of [
+  "scheduleAutosave",
+  "saveAutosave",
+  "atlasMarkDatabaseDirty",
+  "atlasScheduleDatabaseWrite",
+  "atlasPerformDatabaseWrite",
+  "atlasSaveOnPageHide",
+]) {
+  const original = window[name];
+  if (typeof original !== "function") continue;
+  window[name] = function (...args) {
+    if (atlasAuditIsPublishedLocked())
+      return name === "atlasPerformDatabaseWrite"
+        ? Promise.resolve(null)
+        : undefined;

+async function atlasRenderPublicationFlow() {
+  const meta = document.getElementById("atlasPublicationMetadata"),
+    snap = document.getElementById("atlasPublicationSnapshot"),
+    form = document.getElementById("atlasPublicationForm");

+  if (atlasWorkflowCan("canPublish")) {
+    try {
+      const preview = await atlasAuditApi(
+        `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(w.auditId)}/previews/approval-requests/${encodeURIComponent(w.currentRequestId)}`,
+      );

+        null,
+        2,
+      );
+    } catch (error) {
+      snap.textContent = error.message;
+    }
+  } else
+    snap.textContent =
+      "Publication is available only for an approved revision and eligible publisher.";

+      status(error.message, "bad");

+    }
+  });

+/* Phase 5 recipient-isolated Inbox UI. Classic script. */
+(function () {
+  let items = [],
+    beforeId = null,
+    filter = "all",
+    loading = false;
+  const escText = (v) =>
+    typeof esc === "function" ? esc(String(v ?? "")) : String(v ?? "");
+  function matches(i) {
+    if (filter === "unread") return i.readState === "Unread";
+    if (filter === "actionable") return i.itemStatus === "Actionable";
+    if (filter === "history") return i.itemStatus !== "Actionable";
+    return true;
+  }
+  function render() {
+    const host = document.getElementById("atlasInboxList");
+    if (!host) return;
+    const visible = items.filter(matches);
+    host.innerHTML = visible.length
+      ? visible
+          .map(
+            (i) =>
+              `<article class="inbox-item" data-read-state="${escText(i.readState)}"><div><div class="inbox-item-title">${escText(i.auditName || "Audit workflow message")}</div><div>${escText(i.itemType)} · ${escText(i.itemStatus)} · ${escText(i.readState)}</div><div class="inbox-item-meta">${escText(i.createdAt || "")}</div></div><button class="btn secondary" data-open-inbox-item="${escText(i.id)}" type="button">Open</button></article>`,
+          )
+          .join("")
+      : '<p class="hint">No messages match this filter.</p>';
+    document.getElementById("atlasInboxMore").hidden = items.length < 50;
+  }
+  async function load(reset = true) {
+    if (loading) return;
+    loading = true;
+    const statusEl = document.getElementById("atlasInboxStatus");
+    if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = "Loading Inbox…";
+    try {
+      if (reset) {
+        items = [];
+        beforeId = null;
+      }
+      const q = beforeId
+        ? `?limit=50&beforeId=${encodeURIComponent(beforeId)}`
+        : "?limit=50";
+      const payload = await atlasAuditApi(`/api/inbox${q}`);
+      const batch = Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [];
+      items.push(...batch);
+      beforeId = batch.length ? batch[batch.length - 1].id : beforeId;
+      render();
+      if (statusEl)
+        statusEl.textContent = `${items.length} message${items.length === 1 ? "" : "s"} loaded.`;
+    } catch (error) {
+      if (statusEl) statusEl.textContent = error.message;
+    } finally {
+      loading = false;
+    }
+  }
+  async function open(id, button) {
+    const item = items.find((x) => String(x.id) === String(id));
+    if (!item) return;
+    if (item.readState !== "Read") {
+      const marked = await atlasAuditApi(
+        `/api/inbox/${encodeURIComponent(id)}/read`,
+        { method: "POST", body: "{}" },
+      );
+      if (marked) item.readState = "Read";
+      render();
+    }
+    let preview = "";
+    if (item.approvalRequestId) {
+      try {
+        const p = await atlasAuditApi(
+          `/api/audits/${encodeURIComponent(item.auditId)}/previews/approval-requests/${encodeURIComponent(item.approvalRequestId)}`,
+        );
+        preview =
+          typeof atlasStructuredComparisonHtml === "function"
+            ? atlasStructuredComparisonHtml(p.comparison)
+            : `<pre>${escText(JSON.stringify(p.comparison, null, 2))}</pre>`;
+      } catch (error) {
+        preview = `<p class="hint">${escText(error.message)}</p>`;
+      }
+    }
+    const dialog = atlasWorkflowDialog(
+      "Inbox message",
+      `<p><strong>${escText(item.auditName)}</strong></p><p>${escText(item.itemType)} · ${escText(item.itemStatus)}</p>${preview}`,
+      item.itemStatus === "Actionable" && item.approvalRequestId
+        ? '<button class="btn primary" data-inbox-review-action type="button">Review action</button>'
+        : "",
+    );
+    dialog.wrap
+      .querySelector("[data-inbox-review-action]")
+      ?.addEventListener("click", () => {
+        dialog.close();
+        window.ATLASWorkflow?.showApprovalReview?.();
+      });
+  }
+  document.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
+    const f = e.target.closest("[data-inbox-filter]");
+    if (f) {
+      filter = f.dataset.inboxFilter;
+      document
+        .querySelectorAll("[data-inbox-filter]")
+        .forEach(
+          (x) =>
+            (x.className = `btn small ${x === f ? "primary" : "secondary"}`),
+        );
+      render();
+      return;
+    }
+    const o = e.target.closest("[data-open-inbox-item]");
+    if (o)
+      open(o.dataset.openInboxItem, o).catch((error) =>
+        status(error.message, "bad"),
+      );
+  });
+  document
+    .getElementById("atlasInboxRefresh")
+    ?.addEventListener("click", () => load(true));
+  document
+    .getElementById("atlasInboxMore")
+    ?.addEventListener("click", () => load(false));
+  window.ATLASInbox = { refresh: () => load(true) };
+  load(true);
+})();
+
+
+================================================================================
+END FILE: js/25-inbox.js

+================================================================================
+BEGIN FILE: build-css.mjs

+import fs from "node:fs";
+import path from "node:path";
+import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
+
+const currentFile = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
+const root = path.dirname(currentFile);
+const cssRoot = path.join(root, "css");
+const manifestPath = path.join(cssRoot, "manifest.json");
+const args = new Set(process.argv.slice(2));
+const checkOnly = args.has("--check");
+const noDiscover = args.has("--no-discover");
+const acceptDeletions = args.has("--accept-deletions");
+const knownArgs = new Set(["--check", "--no-discover", "--accept-deletions"]);
+for (const arg of args)
+  if (!knownArgs.has(arg)) throw new Error(`Unknown option: ${arg}`);
+
+const BEGIN_RE = /\/\*\s*ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:(u\d+):BEGIN\s*\*\//g;
+const END_RE = /\/\*\s*ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:(u\d+):END\s*\*\//g;
+const INSERT_RE =
+  /\/\*\s*ATLAS-INSERT-(AFTER|BEFORE):(u\d+)\s*\*\/|\/\*\s*ATLAS-INSERT:END\s*\*\//i;
+
+function readJson(file) {
+  return JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file, "utf8"));
+}
+
+function safeProjectPath(relativeFile) {
+  if (
+    typeof relativeFile !== "string" ||
+    !relativeFile.startsWith("css/") ||
+    !relativeFile.endsWith(".css")
+  ) {
+    throw new Error(`Invalid CSS source path in manifest: ${relativeFile}`);
+  }
+  const absolute = path.resolve(root, relativeFile);
+  const expectedRoot = `${path.resolve(cssRoot)}${path.sep}`;
+  if (!absolute.startsWith(expectedRoot))
+    throw new Error(`CSS source path escapes css/: ${relativeFile}`);
+  return absolute;
+}
+
+function stripCommentsAndWhitespace(value) {
+  return value.replace(/\/\*[\s\S]*?\*\//g, "").trim();
+}
+
+function validateCssStructure(source, label) {
+  let depth = 0;
+  let quote = null;
+  let comment = false;
+  for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i += 1) {
+    if (comment) {
+      if (source[i] === "*" && source[i + 1] === "/") {
+        comment = false;
+        i += 1;
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (quote) {
+      if (source[i] === "\\") {
+        i += 1;
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (source[i] === quote) quote = null;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (source[i] === "/" && source[i + 1] === "*") {
+      comment = true;
+      i += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (source[i] === '"' || source[i] === "'") {
+      quote = source[i];
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (source[i] === "{") depth += 1;
+    if (source[i] === "}") {
+      depth -= 1;
+      if (depth < 0)
+        throw new Error(`${label} has an unmatched closing brace.`);
+    }
+  }
+  if (comment) throw new Error(`${label} has an unterminated comment.`);
+  if (quote) throw new Error(`${label} has an unterminated string.`);
+  if (depth !== 0) throw new Error(`${label} has unbalanced braces.`);
+}
+
+function splitTopLevelUnits(source, label) {
+  const units = [];
+  let start = 0;
+  let depth = 0;
+  let quote = null;
+  let comment = false;
+  for (let i = 0; i < source.length; i += 1) {
+    if (comment) {
+      if (source[i] === "*" && source[i + 1] === "/") {
+        comment = false;
+        i += 1;
+      }
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (quote) {
+      if (source[i] === "\\") {
+        i += 1;
+        continue;
+      }
+      if (source[i] === quote) quote = null;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (source[i] === "/" && source[i + 1] === "*") {
+      comment = true;
+      i += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (source[i] === '"' || source[i] === "'") {
+      quote = source[i];
+      continue;
+    }
+    if (source[i] === "{") depth += 1;
+    else if (source[i] === "}") {
+      depth -= 1;
+      if (depth < 0)
+        throw new Error(`${label} has an unmatched closing brace.`);
+      if (depth === 0) {
+        let end = i + 1;
+        while (end < source.length && /\s/.test(source[end])) end += 1;
+        units.push({ start, end, text: source.slice(start, end) });
+        start = end;
+        i = end - 1;
+      }
+    } else if (source[i] === ";" && depth === 0) {
+      let end = i + 1;
+      while (end < source.length && /\s/.test(source[end])) end += 1;
+      units.push({ start, end, text: source.slice(start, end) });
+      start = end;
+      i = end - 1;
+    }
+  }
+  if (comment || quote || depth !== 0) validateCssStructure(source, label);
+  if (start < source.length)
+    units.push({ start, end: source.length, text: source.slice(start) });
+  return units.filter((unit) => stripCommentsAndWhitespace(unit.text) !== "");
+}
+
+function parseSourceFile(relativeFile, source) {
+  const tokens = [];
+  const occupied = [];
+  BEGIN_RE.lastIndex = 0;
+  let match;
+  while ((match = BEGIN_RE.exec(source))) {
+    const id = match[1];
+    END_RE.lastIndex = BEGIN_RE.lastIndex;
+    const endMatch = END_RE.exec(source);
+    if (!endMatch || endMatch[1] !== id)
+      throw new Error(
+        `Missing or mismatched ${id} end marker in ${relativeFile}.`,
+      );
+    const duplicateEnd = source
+      .slice(BEGIN_RE.lastIndex, endMatch.index)
+      .match(/ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:u\d+:END/);
+    if (duplicateEnd)
+      throw new Error(
+        `Unexpected source-unit end marker inside ${id} in ${relativeFile}.`,
+      );
+    tokens.push({
+      type: "existing",
+      id,
+      file: relativeFile,
+      start: match.index,
+      end: END_RE.lastIndex,
+      content: source.slice(BEGIN_RE.lastIndex, endMatch.index),
+    });
+    occupied.push([match.index, END_RE.lastIndex]);
+    BEGIN_RE.lastIndex = END_RE.lastIndex;
+  }
+
+  END_RE.lastIndex = 0;
+  while ((match = END_RE.exec(source))) {
+    if (
+      !occupied.some(
+        ([start, end]) => match.index >= start && match.index < end,
+      )
+    ) {
+      throw new Error(`Orphan ${match[1]} end marker in ${relativeFile}.`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  let cursor = 0;
+  const outside = [];
+  for (const item of tokens) {
+    if (cursor < item.start)
+      outside.push({
+        start: cursor,
+        end: item.start,
+        text: source.slice(cursor, item.start),
+      });
+    cursor = item.end;
+  }
+  if (cursor < source.length)
+    outside.push({
+      start: cursor,
+      end: source.length,
+      text: source.slice(cursor),
+    });
+
+  const newUnits = [];
+  for (const segment of outside) {
+    for (const unit of splitTopLevelUnits(segment.text, relativeFile)) {
+      const absoluteStart = segment.start + unit.start;
+      const absoluteEnd = segment.start + unit.end;
+      const before = source.slice(0, absoluteStart);
+      const directiveMatches = [
+        ...before.matchAll(new RegExp(INSERT_RE.source, "gi")),
+      ];
+      const lastDirective = directiveMatches.at(-1);
+      let directive = null;
+      if (
+        lastDirective &&
+        stripCommentsAndWhitespace(
+          before.slice(lastDirective.index + lastDirective[0].length),
+        ) === ""
+      ) {
+        directive = lastDirective[0].includes("ATLAS-INSERT:END")
+          ? { type: "end" }
+          : { type: lastDirective[1].toLowerCase(), id: lastDirective[2] };
+      }
+      newUnits.push({
+        type: "new",
+        file: relativeFile,
+        start: absoluteStart,
+        end: absoluteEnd,
+        content: unit.text.replace(new RegExp(INSERT_RE.source, "gi"), ""),
+        directive,
+      });
+    }
+  }
+  return { relativeFile, source, existing: tokens, newUnits };
+}
+
+function nextUnitNumber(manifest) {
+  const numbers = manifest.units
+    .map(({ id }) => Number.parseInt(String(id).slice(1), 10))
+    .filter(Number.isFinite);
+  return Math.max(0, ...numbers, Number(manifest.nextUnitNumber || 1) - 1) + 1;
+}
+
+function insertManifestUnit(units, entry, placement) {
+  if (placement.type === "end") {
+    units.push(entry);
+    return;
+  }
+  const index = units.findIndex(({ id }) => id === placement.id);
+  if (index < 0)
+    throw new Error(`Insertion anchor ${placement.id} does not exist.`);
+  units.splice(placement.type === "before" ? index : index + 1, 0, entry);
+}
+
+function inferPlacement(parsed, newUnit, manifest) {
+  if (newUnit.directive) return newUnit.directive;
+  const previous = parsed.existing
+    .filter((item) => item.end <= newUnit.start)
+    .at(-1);
+  if (previous) return { type: "after", id: previous.id };
+  const next = parsed.existing.find((item) => item.start >= newUnit.end);
+  if (next) return { type: "before", id: next.id };
+  const configured = manifest.files?.[parsed.relativeFile]?.defaultInsert;
+  if (configured === "end") return { type: "end" };
+  const configuredMatch = /^(before|after):(u\d+)$/i.exec(configured || "");
+  if (configuredMatch)
+    return { type: configuredMatch[1].toLowerCase(), id: configuredMatch[2] };
+  throw new Error(
+    `Cannot place new CSS in ${parsed.relativeFile}. Add /* ATLAS-INSERT-AFTER:u#### */, /* ATLAS-INSERT-BEFORE:u#### */, or configure manifest.files["${parsed.relativeFile}"].defaultInsert.`,
+  );
+}
+
+function atomicWrite(file, content) {
+  const temporary = `${file}.tmp-${process.pid}`;
+  fs.writeFileSync(temporary, content, "utf8");
+  fs.renameSync(temporary, file);
+}
+
+const manifest = readJson(manifestPath);
+if (!Array.isArray(manifest.units))
+  throw new Error("manifest.units must be an array.");
+const manifestIds = new Set();
+for (const unit of manifest.units) {
+  if (!/^u\d+$/.test(unit.id)) throw new Error(`Invalid unit id: ${unit.id}`);
+  if (manifestIds.has(unit.id))
+    throw new Error(`Duplicate manifest unit id: ${unit.id}`);
+  manifestIds.add(unit.id);
+  safeProjectPath(unit.file);
+}
+
+const sourceFiles = new Set(manifest.units.map(({ file }) => file));
+if (manifest.files)
+  for (const file of Object.keys(manifest.files)) sourceFiles.add(file);
+for (const name of fs.readdirSync(cssRoot))
+  if (name.endsWith(".css")) sourceFiles.add(`css/${name}`);
+
+const parsedFiles = new Map();
+const foundUnits = new Map();
+for (const relativeFile of [...sourceFiles].sort()) {
+  const absolute = safeProjectPath(relativeFile);
+  if (!fs.existsSync(absolute))
+    throw new Error(`Missing CSS source file: ${relativeFile}`);
+  const parsed = parseSourceFile(
+    relativeFile,
+    fs.readFileSync(absolute, "utf8"),
+  );
+  parsedFiles.set(relativeFile, parsed);
+  for (const item of parsed.existing) {
+    if (foundUnits.has(item.id))
+      throw new Error(
+        `Duplicate source unit ${item.id} in ${foundUnits.get(item.id).file} and ${relativeFile}.`,
+      );
+    foundUnits.set(item.id, item);
+  }
+}
+
+const missing = manifest.units.filter(({ id }) => !foundUnits.has(id));
+if (missing.length && !acceptDeletions) {
+  throw new Error(
+    `Manifest units missing from source files: ${missing.map(({ id }) => id).join(", ")}. Re-run with --accept-deletions to confirm removal.`,
+  );
+}
+if (missing.length)
+  manifest.units = manifest.units.filter(({ id }) => foundUnits.has(id));
+
+for (const unit of manifest.units) {
+  const found = foundUnits.get(unit.id);
+  if (found && unit.file !== found.file) unit.file = found.file;
+}
+
+const discovered = [];
+let nextNumber = nextUnitNumber(manifest);
+for (const parsed of parsedFiles.values()) {
+  const orderedNew = [...parsed.newUnits].sort((a, b) => a.start - b.start);
+  for (const newUnit of orderedNew) {
+    if (noDiscover)
+      throw new Error(
+        `Unmarked CSS detected in ${parsed.relativeFile}. Remove --no-discover or add source-unit markers.`,
+      );
+    const id = `u${String(nextNumber).padStart(4, "0")}`;
+    nextNumber += 1;
+    const placement = inferPlacement(parsed, newUnit, manifest);
+    insertManifestUnit(
+      manifest.units,
+      { id, file: parsed.relativeFile },
+      placement,
+    );
+    newUnit.id = id;
+    discovered.push({ id, file: parsed.relativeFile, placement });
+    parsed.existing.push({
+      type: "existing",
+      id,
+      file: parsed.relativeFile,
+      start: newUnit.start,
+      end: newUnit.end,
+      content: newUnit.content,
+    });
+  }
+}
+manifest.schemaVersion = Math.max(2, Number(manifest.schemaVersion || 1));
+manifest.nextUnitNumber = nextNumber;
+
+const rewrittenSources = new Map();
+for (const parsed of parsedFiles.values()) {
+  if (!parsed.newUnits.length) continue;
+  let rewritten = parsed.source;
+  for (const unit of [...parsed.newUnits].sort((a, b) => b.start - a.start)) {
+    const wrapped = `/* ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:${unit.id}:BEGIN */${unit.content}/* ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:${unit.id}:END */`;
+    rewritten = `${rewritten.slice(0, unit.start)}${wrapped}${rewritten.slice(unit.end)}`;
+  }
+  rewrittenSources.set(parsed.relativeFile, rewritten);
+}
+
+const sourceCache = new Map();
+for (const [relativeFile, rewritten] of rewrittenSources)
+  sourceCache.set(relativeFile, rewritten);
+function sourceFor(relativeFile) {
+  if (!sourceCache.has(relativeFile))
+    sourceCache.set(
+      relativeFile,
+      fs.readFileSync(safeProjectPath(relativeFile), "utf8"),
+    );
+  return sourceCache.get(relativeFile);
+}
+
+const emitted = new Set();
+const output = manifest.units
+  .map(({ id, file }) => {
+    if (emitted.has(id))
+      throw new Error(`Unit ${id} would be emitted more than once.`);
+    emitted.add(id);
+    const source = sourceFor(file);
+    const begin = `/* ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:${id}:BEGIN */`;
+    const end = `/* ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:${id}:END */`;
+    const start = source.indexOf(begin);
+    if (start < 0) throw new Error(`Missing ${id} begin marker in ${file}.`);
+    const contentStart = start + begin.length;
+    const finish = source.indexOf(end, contentStart);
+    if (finish < 0) throw new Error(`Missing ${id} end marker in ${file}.`);
+    if (source.indexOf(begin, contentStart) >= 0)
+      throw new Error(`Duplicate ${id} begin marker in ${file}.`);
+    return source.slice(contentStart, finish);
+  })
+  .join("");
+
+validateCssStructure(output, manifest.source || "styles.css");
+if (/ATLAS-SOURCE-UNIT:/.test(output))
+  throw new Error("Generated stylesheet contains source-management markers.");
+
+if (checkOnly) {
+  console.log(
+    `CSS check passed. ${manifest.units.length} units would be emitted.`,
+  );
+  if (discovered.length) {
+    console.log(`Discovered ${discovered.length} new CSS unit(s):`);
+    for (const item of discovered)
+      console.log(
+        `  ${item.id}  ${item.file}  ${item.placement.type}${item.placement.id ? `:${item.placement.id}` : ""}`,
+      );
+  }
+  if (missing.length)
+    console.log(`Would remove ${missing.length} confirmed missing unit(s).`);
+  process.exit(0);
+}
+
+for (const [relativeFile, contents] of rewrittenSources)
+  atomicWrite(safeProjectPath(relativeFile), contents);
+atomicWrite(manifestPath, `${JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)}\n`);
+atomicWrite(path.join(root, manifest.source || "styles.css"), output);
+console.log(
+  `Built ${manifest.source || "styles.css"} from ${manifest.units.length} ordered source units.`,
+);
+if (discovered.length)
+  console.log(
+    `Discovered, marked, and registered ${discovered.length} new CSS unit(s).`,
+  );
+if (missing.length)
+  console.log(
+    `Removed ${missing.length} confirmed missing unit(s) from the manifest.`,
+  );
+
+
+================================================================================
+END FILE: build-css.mjs
+================================================================================
+

+import test from "node:test";

+import { upsertUserProfilesWithClient } from "../src/user-profile-repository.js";

+const routesSource = readFileSync(

+  "utf8",
+);
+
+test("Disney directory route is read-only", () => {
+  const start = routesSource.indexOf('router.get("/directory"');
+  const end = routesSource.indexOf('router.post("/resolve"', start);
+  const route = routesSource.slice(start, end);
+  assert.ok(start >= 0 && end > start);
+  assert.doesNotMatch(route, /upsertUserProfiles|BEGIN|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE/);
+  assert.match(route, /studioShareJson/);
+  assert.match(route, /res\.json\(\{ \.\.\.payload, items \}\)/);
+});
+
+test("assignment profiles are normalized and deduplicated across roles", () => {
+  const profiles = assignmentProfiles({
+    assigned: [{ id: "1", username: "ALPHA", fullName: "Alpha One" }],
+    backup: [{ id: "1", username: "alpha", fullName: "Alpha One" }],
+    developer: [
+      { id: "2", username: "beta", fullName: "Beta Two" },
+      { id: "", username: "legacy" },
+    ],
+  });
+  assert.deepEqual(
+    profiles.map(({ id, username }) => ({ id, username })),
+    [
+      { id: "1", username: "ALPHA" },
+      { id: "2", username: "beta" },
+    ],
+  );
+});
+
+test("client-scoped profile upsert does not open or commit an independent transaction", async () => {
+  const statements = [];
+  const client = {
+    query: async (sql) => {
+      statements.push(sql);
+      return { rows: [] };
+    },
+  };
+  const profiles = await upsertUserProfilesWithClient(client, [
+    { id: "1", username: "alpha", fullName: "Alpha One" },
+  ]);
+  assert.equal(profiles.length, 1);
+  assert.equal(statements.length, 1);
+  assert.match(statements[0], /INSERT INTO atlas_user_profiles/);
+  assert.doesNotMatch(statements.join("\n"), /BEGIN|COMMIT|ROLLBACK/);
+});
+
+test("audit save invokes assignment profile upsert before commit", () => {
+  const source = readFileSync(
+    new URL("../src/audit-repository.js", import.meta.url),
+    "utf8",
+  );
+  const start = source.indexOf("export async function saveAudit");
+  const end = source.indexOf("export async function listAuditRevisions", start);
+  const save = source.slice(start, end);
+  const upsert = save.lastIndexOf("await upsertUserProfilesWithClient(");
+  const commit = save.lastIndexOf('await client.query("COMMIT")');
+  assert.ok(upsert >= 0);
+  assert.ok(commit > upsert);
+  assert.match(save, /assignmentProfiles\(document\.assignments\)/);
+  assert.match(save, /catch \(error\) \{[\s\S]*ROLLBACK/);
+});
+

+BEGIN FILE: test/audit-authorization.test.js
+================================================================================
+
+import test from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import { auditAccessForUser } from "../src/audit-authorization.js";
+const audit = (status = "Draft") => ({
+  workflowStatus: status,
+  assignments: { assigned: [{ id: "analyst", username: "analyst" }] },
+});
+test("disabled users receive no workflow capabilities", () => {
+  const x = auditAccessForUser(
+    { id: "analyst", username: "analyst", disabled: true },
+    audit(),
+  );
+  assert.equal(x.canSubmit, false);
+  assert.equal(x.canRead, false);
+});
+test("assigned analyst may submit but cannot approve publish or unlock", () => {
+  const u = {
+    id: "analyst",
+    username: "analyst",
+    roles: ["atlas-admin-team"],
+    roleResolutionStatus: "resolved",
+  };
+  assert.equal(auditAccessForUser(u, audit()).canSubmit, true);
+  assert.equal(
+    auditAccessForUser(u, audit("Pending Approval"), { selectedApprover: u })
+      .canApprove,
+    false,
+  );
+  assert.equal(auditAccessForUser(u, audit("Approved")).canPublish, false);
+});
+test("verified non-assigned admin team receives state-specific capabilities", () => {
+  const u = {
+    id: "reviewer",
+    username: "reviewer",
+    resolvedRoleSlugs: ["atlas-admin-team"],
+    roleResolutionStatus: "resolved",
+  };
+  assert.equal(
+    auditAccessForUser(u, audit("Pending Approval"), { selectedApprover: u })
+      .canApprove,
+    true,
+  );
+  assert.equal(auditAccessForUser(u, audit("Approved")).canPublish, true);
+  assert.equal(auditAccessForUser(u, audit("Published")).canUnlock, true);
+});
+test("role resolution failure closes privileged workflow capabilities", () => {
+  const u = {
+    id: "reviewer",
+    username: "reviewer",
+    resolvedRoleSlugs: ["atlas-admin-team"],
+    roleResolutionStatus: "unavailable",
+  };
+  assert.equal(auditAccessForUser(u, audit("Approved")).canPublish, false);
+});
+test("align admin can delete publication even when assigned", () => {
+  const u = {
+    id: "analyst",
+    username: "analyst",
+    resolvedRoleSlugs: ["atlas-align-admin"],
+    roleResolutionStatus: "resolved",
+  };
+  assert.equal(
+    auditAccessForUser(u, audit("Published")).canDeletePublication,
+    true,
+  );
+});
+
+

+END FILE: test/audit-authorization.test.js

+================================================================================
+BEGIN FILE: test/workflow-feature-flags.test.js
+================================================================================
+
+import test from "node:test";
+import assert from "node:assert/strict";
+import {
+  workflowFeatureFlags,
+  reduceWorkflowCapabilities,
+  requireWorkflowFeature,
+} from "../src/workflow-feature-flags.js";
+const all = Object.fromEntries(
+  [
+    "READS",
+    "HISTORY",
+    "RESTORATION",
+    "SUBMISSION",
+    "DECISIONS",
+    "PUBLICATION",
+    "UNLOCK",
+    "PUBLICATION_DELETION",
+  ].map((x) => [`ATLAS_WORKFLOW_${x}_ENABLED`, "true"]),
+);
+test("flags fail closed and enforce rollout dependencies", () => {
+  assert.equal(workflowFeatureFlags({}).reads, false);
+  assert.equal(
+    workflowFeatureFlags({ ATLAS_WORKFLOW_PUBLICATION_ENABLED: "true" })
+      .publication,
+    false,
+  );
+  assert.equal(
+    workflowFeatureFlags({ ...all, ATLAS_WORKFLOW_DECISIONS_ENABLED: "false" })
+      .publication,
+    false,
+  );
+  assert.equal(workflowFeatureFlags(all).publicationDeletion, true);
+});
+test("flags only reduce capabilities", () => {
+  const c = reduceWorkflowCapabilities(
+    { canSubmit: true, canApprove: false, canPublish: true },
+    { submission: false, decisions: true, publication: true },
+  );
+  assert.equal(c.canSubmit, false);
+  assert.equal(c.canApprove, false);
+  assert.equal(c.canPublish, true);
+});
+test("disabled middleware rejects direct calls", () => {
+  let code, body;
+  requireWorkflowFeature("publication", { publication: false })(
+    {},
+    {
+      status(v) {
+        code = v;
+        return this;
+      },
+      json(v) {
+        body = v;
+      },
+    },
+    () => assert.fail(),
+  );
+  assert.equal(code, 403);
+  assert.match(body.error, /not enabled/);
+});
+

+================================================================================
+BEGIN FILE: tools/create-review-bundle.mjs
+================================================================================
+
+#!/usr/bin/env node
+
+import { createHash } from "node:crypto";
+import { access, readFile, stat, writeFile } from "node:fs/promises";
+import { constants as fsConstants } from "node:fs";
+import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
+import path from "node:path";
+import process from "node:process";
+
+const DEFAULT_OUTPUT = "REVIEW_BUNDLE.txt";
+const DEFAULT_TITLE = "PROJECT REVIEW BUNDLE";
+
+function printUsage() {
+  console.log(
+    `
+Create a combined project review bundle from a list of files.
+
+Usage:
+  node tools/create-review-bundle.mjs [options] [file ...]
+
+Options:
+  --files <path>    Read file paths from a text manifest
+  --output <path>   Output file name
+                    Default: ${DEFAULT_OUTPUT}
+  --title <text>    Bundle title
+                    Default: ${DEFAULT_TITLE}
+  --help            Display this help
+
+Manifest format:
+  One file path per line.
+
+  Empty lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
+
+Examples:
+  node tools/create-review-bundle.mjs \\
+    --files review-bundle-files.txt \\
+    --output ATLAS_AUDIT_ISSUES_FEATURE_REVIEW.txt \\
+    --title "ATLAS ALIGN AUDIT ISSUES FEATURE REVIEW BUNDLE"
+
+  node tools/create-review-bundle.mjs \\
+    --output SMALL_REVIEW.txt \\
+    README.md package.json styles.css
+`.trim(),
+  );
+}
+
+function parseArguments(argumentsList) {
+  const options = {
+    filesManifest: null,
+    output: DEFAULT_OUTPUT,
+    title: DEFAULT_TITLE,
+    positionalFiles: [],
+  };
+
+  for (let index = 0; index < argumentsList.length; index += 1) {
+    const argument = argumentsList[index];
+
+    if (argument === "--help" || argument === "-h") {
+      printUsage();
+      process.exit(0);
+    }
+
+    if (argument === "--files") {
+      const value = argumentsList[index + 1];
+
+      if (!value) {
+        throw new Error("--files requires a manifest path.");
+      }
+
+      options.filesManifest = value;
+      index += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    if (argument === "--output") {
+      const value = argumentsList[index + 1];
+
+      if (!value) {
+        throw new Error("--output requires a file path.");
+      }
+
+      options.output = value;
+      index += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    if (argument === "--title") {
+      const value = argumentsList[index + 1];
+
+      if (!value) {
+        throw new Error("--title requires text.");
+      }
+
+      options.title = value;
+      index += 1;
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    if (argument.startsWith("--")) {
+      throw new Error(`Unknown option: ${argument}`);
+    }
+
+    options.positionalFiles.push(argument);
+  }
+
+  return options;
+}
+
+async function fileExists(filePath) {
+  try {
+    await access(filePath, fsConstants.F_OK);
+    return true;
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+async function isRegularFile(filePath) {
+  try {
+    const fileStats = await stat(filePath);
+    return fileStats.isFile();
+  } catch {
+    return false;
+  }
+}
+
+async function readManifest(manifestPath) {
+  const manifestContents = await readFile(manifestPath, "utf8");
+
+  return manifestContents
+    .split(/\r?\n/u)
+    .map((line) => line.trim())
+    .filter((line) => line && !line.startsWith("#"));
+}
+
+function removeDuplicates(filePaths) {
+  return [...new Set(filePaths)];
+}
+
+function getGitOutput(argumentsList) {
+  try {
+    return execFileSync("git", argumentsList, {
+      cwd: process.cwd(),
+      encoding: "utf8",
+      stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "ignore"],
+    }).trimEnd();
+  } catch {
+    return null;
+  }
+}
+
+function getRepositoryFingerprint() {
+  const insideWorkTree = getGitOutput(["rev-parse", "--is-inside-work-tree"]);
+
+  if (insideWorkTree !== "true") {
+    return "Git metadata unavailable.\n";
+  }
+
+  const commit = getGitOutput(["rev-parse", "HEAD"]) || "[Unavailable]";
+  const branch =
+    getGitOutput(["branch", "--show-current"]) || "[Detached HEAD]";
+  const status = getGitOutput(["status", "--short"]);
+
+  return [
+    `Commit: ${commit}`,
+    "",
+    "Branch:",
+    branch,
+    "",
+    "Working tree status:",
+    status || "[Clean]",
+    "",
+  ].join("\n");
+}
+
+function calculateSha256(buffer) {
+  return createHash("sha256").update(buffer).digest("hex");
+}
+
+function createDivider() {
+  return "=".repeat(80);
+}
+
+function formatBytes(bytes) {
+  if (bytes === 0) {
+    return "0 B";
+  }
+
+  const units = ["B", "KB", "MB", "GB"];
+  const unitIndex = Math.min(
+    Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(1024)),
+    units.length - 1,
+  );
+  const value = bytes / 1024 ** unitIndex;
+
+  return `${value.toFixed(unitIndex === 0 ? 0 : 1)} ${units[unitIndex]}`;
+}
+
+async function collectFiles(filePaths) {
+  const results = [];
+
+  for (const filePath of filePaths) {
+    const exists = await fileExists(filePath);
+    const regularFile = exists && (await isRegularFile(filePath));
+
+    if (!regularFile) {
+      results.push({
+        filePath,
+        exists: false,
+        buffer: null,
+        sha256: null,
+      });
+      continue;
+    }
+
+    const buffer = await readFile(filePath);
+
+    results.push({
+      filePath,
+      exists: true,
+      buffer,
+      sha256: calculateSha256(buffer),
+    });
+  }
+
+  return results;
+}
+
+function buildBundle({ title, fileResults }) {
+  const divider = createDivider();
+  const lines = [];
+
+  lines.push(title);
+  lines.push(`Generated: ${new Date().toISOString()}`);
+  lines.push(`Project root: ${process.cwd()}`);
+  lines.push("");
+
+  lines.push(divider);
+  lines.push("REPOSITORY FINGERPRINT");
+  lines.push(divider);
+  lines.push("");
+  lines.push(getRepositoryFingerprint().trimEnd());
+  lines.push("");
+
+  lines.push(divider);
+  lines.push("FILE INVENTORY AND SHA-256");
+  lines.push(divider);
+  lines.push("");
+
+  for (const result of fileResults) {
+    if (result.exists) {
+      lines.push(`${result.sha256}  ${result.filePath}`);
+    } else {
+      lines.push(`MISSING ${result.filePath}`);
+    }
+  }
+
+  for (const result of fileResults) {
+    lines.push("");
+    lines.push(divider);
+    lines.push(`BEGIN FILE: ${result.filePath}`);
+    lines.push(divider);
+    lines.push("");
+
+    if (result.exists) {
+      lines.push(result.buffer.toString("utf8"));
+
+      if (
+        result.buffer.length > 0 &&
+        !result.buffer.toString("utf8").endsWith("\n")
+      ) {
+        lines.push("");
+      }
+    } else {
+      lines.push(`[MISSING FILE: ${result.filePath}]`);
+    }
+
+    lines.push("");
+    lines.push(divider);
+    lines.push(`END FILE: ${result.filePath}`);
+    lines.push(divider);
+  }
+
+  lines.push("");
+
+  return lines.join("\n");
+}
+
+async function main() {
+  const options = parseArguments(process.argv.slice(2));
+  let requestedFiles = [...options.positionalFiles];
+
+  if (options.filesManifest) {
+    const manifestFiles = await readManifest(options.filesManifest);
+    requestedFiles = [...manifestFiles, ...requestedFiles];
+  }
+
+  requestedFiles = removeDuplicates(requestedFiles);
+
+  if (requestedFiles.length === 0) {
+    throw new Error(
+      "No files were provided. Use --files <manifest> or provide file paths.",
+    );
+  }
+
+  const outputPath = path.resolve(options.output);
+  const outputRelativePath = path.relative(process.cwd(), outputPath);
+
+  requestedFiles = requestedFiles.filter((filePath) => {
+    const requestedPath = path.resolve(filePath);
+    return requestedPath !== outputPath;
+  });
+
+  if (requestedFiles.length === 0) {
+    throw new Error("The output file cannot be the only requested input.");
+  }
+
+  const fileResults = await collectFiles(requestedFiles);
+  const bundle = buildBundle({
+    title: options.title,
+    fileResults,
+  });
+
+  await writeFile(outputPath, bundle, "utf8");
+
+  const outputStats = await stat(outputPath);
+  const missingCount = fileResults.filter((result) => !result.exists).length;
+
+  console.log(`Created ${outputRelativePath || options.output}`);
+  console.log(`Size: ${formatBytes(outputStats.size)}`);
+  console.log(`Files requested: ${fileResults.length}`);
+  console.log(`Files included: ${fileResults.length - missingCount}`);
+  console.log(`Missing requested files recorded: ${missingCount}`);
+}
+
+main().catch((error) => {
+  console.error(`Error: ${error.message}`);
+  process.exitCode = 1;
+});
+
+
+================================================================================
+END FILE: tools/create-review-bundle.mjs
 ================================================================================

+async function workflowApproverCandidates(req) {
+  const stored = await getAudit(pool, req.params.auditId);
+  if (!stored)
+    throw Object.assign(new Error("Audit not found."), { status: 404 });
+  if (!auditAccessForUser(req.studioshareUser, stored.audit).canRead)
+    throw Object.assign(new Error("Audit access is required."), {
+      status: 403,
+    });
+  const q = String(req.query.q || "").trim();
+  let identities;
+  if (!q) identities = await searchUserProfiles(pool, "", 20);
+  else {
+    if (q.length < 2)
+      throw Object.assign(new Error("Enter at least two characters."), {
+        status: 400,
+      });
+    const token = cookieValue(req, "access_token");
+    const url = new URL(`${studioshareApiUrl.replace(/\/$/, "")}/core/users`);
+    url.searchParams.set("q", q);
+    url.searchParams.set("page", "1");
+    url.searchParams.set("size", "25");
+    const response = await fetch(url, {
+      headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
+    });
+    if (!response.ok)
+      throw Object.assign(new Error("User search is unavailable."), {
+        status: response.status === 429 ? 429 : 502,
+      });
+    const payload = await response.json();
+    identities = Array.isArray(payload?.items) ? payload.items : [];
+  }
+  const verified = await Promise.all(
+    identities.slice(0, 25).map(async (identity) => {
+      try {
+        return await resolveWorkflowUser(req, identity);
+      } catch (_error) {
+        return null;
+      }
+    }),
+  );
+  const seen = new Set();
+  return verified
+    .filter((user) => user?.active && user.roles?.includes("atlas-admin-team"))
+    .reduce((items, user) => {
+      const key = String(user.id || user.username).toLowerCase();
+      if (!key || seen.has(key)) return items;
+      seen.add(key);
+      const assigned = isAssignedAnalyst(user, stored.audit);
+      items.push({
+        id: user.id,
+        username: user.username,
+        fullName: user.fullName,
+        avatar: user.avatar || null,
+        eligible: !assigned,
+        ineligibilityCode: assigned ? "assigned_analyst" : null,
+        ineligibilityReason: assigned
+          ? "This person is an Assigned Analyst on this audit and cannot approve it."
+          : null,
+      });
+      return items;
+    }, []);
+}

+export async function getInboxUnreadCount(pool, { user }) {
+  const result = await pool.query(

+     WHERE read_state='Unread' AND (recipient_user_id=$1 OR (recipient_user_id IS NULL AND lower(recipient_username)=lower($2)))`,
